import React, { useState } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import { getUserIdFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";

/**
 * GoalRevisionModal — SP-04
 * ChatBot'tan gelen goal_revision aksiyonuna karşılık açılır.
 * Kullanıcıya zayıf kategoriyi güncellemesini veya devam etmesini sorar.
 *
 * Props:
 *   isOpen: bool
 *   category: string — revize önerilen kategori adı
 *   currentGoals: string[] — mevcut hedefler
 *   onClose: () => void
 *   onUpdated: (updatedGoals: string[]) => void
 */
const GoalRevisionModal = ({ isOpen, category, currentGoals = [], onClose, onUpdated }) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [resultMsg, setResultMsg] = useState("");

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const res = await axiosClient.put(`/users/${userId}/goals`, {
        newGoals: [],
        removedGoals: [category],
      });
      setResultMsg("Hedefiniz güncellendi! Yeni görevler hazırlanıyor. 🎯");
      setDone(true);
      onUpdated?.(res.data?.updatedGoals || currentGoals.filter(g => g !== category));
    } catch {
      setResultMsg("Bir hata oluştu. Tekrar dene.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeep = () => {
    setResultMsg("Harika! Bu hedefle devam ediyoruz. 💪");
    setDone(true);
    setTimeout(onClose, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-5 animate-fade-in">
        {/* Başlık */}
        <div className="text-center">
          <span className="text-4xl block mb-2">🎯</span>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white">Hedef Revizyonu</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
            LifeQuest AI bir öneri hazırladı
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Analiz özeti */}
        <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 rounded-2xl p-4">
          <p className="text-amber-200 text-sm leading-relaxed">
            <span className="font-bold text-amber-400">'{category}'</span> kategorisini
            son 2 haftadır zorlanıyor gibisin. Bu hedefi güncellemek ister misin?
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Mevcut hedefler */}
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-2 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
            Mevcut Hedeflerin
          </p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {currentGoals.map((g) => (
              <span
                key={g}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border transition-all ${
                  g.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase()
                    ? "bg-red-500/20 border-red-500/40 text-red-300 line-through"
                    : "bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-slate-300"
                }`}
              >
                {g}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          {currentGoals.some(g => g.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase()) && (
            <p className="text-xs text-red-400 mt-2">
              ↑ <span className="font-semibold">{category}</span> kaldırılacak
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Sonuç mesajı */}
        {done ? (
          <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold text-sm">{resultMsg}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleUpdate}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20"
            >
              {loading ? "Güncelleniyor..." : "✅ Evet, güncelle"}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleKeep}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 font-bold py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm transition-all border border-slate-700"
            >
              💪 Hayır, devam et
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Kapat */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="w-full text-xs text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-400 transition-colors"
        >
          Kapat
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default GoalRevisionModal;

import { useState } from "react";

/**
 * MiniTaskCard — SP-02: Chatbot içinde görev önerisi için kompakt kart.
 */
const MiniTaskCard = ({ task, onSelect, isSelected: initialSelected = false }) => {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(initialSelected);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSelect = async () => {
    if (selected || loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSelect?.(task.taskId);
      setSelected(true);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 border transition-all ${
      selected
        ? "bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/30"
        : "bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-700/50 hover:border-indigo-500/40"
    }`}>
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <h4 className="text-white font-bold text-xs leading-tight truncate">{task.title}</h4>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-indigo-500/15 text-indigo-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
              {task.categoryName}
            </span>
            {task.estimatedMinutes && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">⏱️ {task.estimatedMinutes}dk</span>
            )}
            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-bold">+{task.baseXP} XP</span>
          </div>
          {task.whyThisTask && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1 leading-tight line-clamp-1 italic">
              💡 {task.whyThisTask}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleSelect}
          disabled={selected || loading}
          className={`shrink-0 text-[11px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all ${
            selected
              ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 cursor-default"
              : "bg-indigo-600 text-white hover:bg-indigo-500 active:scale-95"
          }`}
        >
          {loading ? "⌛" : selected ? "✓ Seçildi" : "Seç"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MiniTaskCard;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import useSignalR from "../hooks/useSignalR";

const NotificationBell = () => {
    const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);

    // Fetch initial notifications
    useEffect(() => {
        const fetchNotifications = async () => {
            try {
                const response = await axiosClient.get("/notifications");
                setNotifications(response.data.grouped || {});
                setUnreadCount(response.data.unreadCount || 0);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("Failed to fetch notifications", err);
            }
        };

        fetchNotifications();
    }, []);

    // Setup SignalR — real-time notifications via useSignalR hook (MISS-007)
    useSignalR({
        onNotification: () => {
            // Re-fetch to keep grouping correct
            axiosClient.get("/notifications").then(response => {
                setNotifications(response.data.grouped || {});
                setUnreadCount(response.data.unreadCount || 0);
            });
        },
    });

    const toggleOpen = () => {
        if (!isOpen && unreadCount > 0) {
            axiosClient.patch("/notifications/mark-all-as-read").then(() => {
                setUnreadCount(0);
                // Lokal olarak hepsini okundu işaretle (Gruplanmış veride derin güncelleme)
                setNotifications(prev => {
                    const newGroups = { ...prev };
                    Object.keys(newGroups).forEach(key => {
                        newGroups[key] = newGroups[key].map(n => ({ ...n, isRead: true }));
                    });
                    return newGroups;
                });
            });
        }
        setIsOpen(!isOpen);
    };

    return (
        <div className="relative">
            <button 
                onClick={toggleOpen}
                className="relative p-2 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-full transition-colors"
                title="Bildirimler"
            >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 17h5l-1.405-1.405A2.032 2.032 0 0118 14.158V11a6.002 6.002 0 00-4-5.659V5a2 2 0 10-4 0v.341C7.67 6.165 6 8.388 6 11v3.159c0 .538-.214 1.055-.595 1.436L4 17h5m6 0v1a3 3 0 11-6 0v-1m6 0H9" />
                </svg>
                {unreadCount > 0 && (
                    <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-bounce" />
                )}
            </button>

            {isOpen && (
                <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-80 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden text-sm animate-fade-in">
                    <div className="p-3 bg-slate-700/50 border-b border-slate-600 font-semibold text-slate-100 flex justify-between">
                        Bildirimler
                        {unreadCount > 0 && <span className="text-xs bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{unreadCount} yeni</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div className="max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                        {Object.keys(notifications).length === 0 ? (
                            <div className="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Bildirim bulunmuyor.</div>
                        ) : (
                            Object.entries(notifications).map(([type, group]) => (
                                <div key={type}>
                                    <div className="bg-slate-900/50 px-4 py-2 text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest border-b border-slate-700/30">
                                        {type === 'Social' ? '🤝 SOSYAL' : type === 'System' ? '⚙️ SİSTEM' : type === 'Task' ? '⚔️ GÖREV' : `🔔 ${type.toUpperCase()}`}
                                    </div>
                                    {group.map((n, idx) => (
                                        <div key={n.id || idx} className={`p-4 border-b border-slate-700/50 hover:bg-slate-700/40 transition-colors ${!n.isRead ? 'bg-slate-700/20' : ''}`}>
                                            <h4 className="font-medium text-slate-200 mb-1">{n.title}</h4>
                                            <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs">{n.message}</p>
                                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-2 block">
                                                {new Date(n.createdAt).toLocaleString('tr-TR')}
                                            </span>
                                        </div>
                                    ))}
                                </div>
                            ))
                        )}
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

export default NotificationBell;

import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/authContext';

const PrivateRoute = ({ children }) => {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();

  if (loading) return <div>Yükleniyor...</div>;

  return user ? children : <Navigate to="/login" />;
};

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\TaskItem.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import { taskPoolApi } from "../api/moodApi";

const DIFFICULTY_COLORS = {
  Easy: "text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-400/10 border-emerald-400/20",
  Medium: "text-amber-400 bg-amber-400/10 border-amber-400/20",
  Hard: "text-rose-400 bg-rose-400/10 border-rose-400/20",
};

const TaskItem = ({
  id,
  title,
  description,
  xp,
  difficulty,
  isCompleted,
  status,
  postponedTo,
  onComplete,
  onPostpone,
  onCancelPostpone,
  onFocus,
  tags = [],
}) => {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [showDesc, setShowDesc] = useState(false);
  const [showPostpone, setShowPostpone] = useState(false);
  const [postponeReason, setPostponeReason] = useState("");
  const [touchStart, setTouchStart] = useState(null);
  const [touchEnd, setTouchEnd] = useState(null);
  const [swipeOffset, setSwipeOffset] = useState(0);

  // Swipe thresholds
  const minSwipeDistance = 50;

  const safeDifficulty = DIFFICULTY_COLORS[difficulty] ? difficulty : "Medium";

  const [showReflection, setShowReflection] = useState(false);
  const [reflectionText, setReflectionText] = useState("");
  const [customTags, setCustomTags] = useState("");

  const handleShare = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${id}/share`);
      if (res.data.success) {
        const fullUrl = `${window.location.origin}${res.data.shareUrl}`;
        const action = window.confirm(`Paylaşım linki oluşturuldu!\n\nLink: ${fullUrl}\n\nTamam'a basarak linki kopyalayabilir, İptal'e basarak e-posta ile paylaşmaya devam edebilirsiniz.`);
        
        if (action) {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl);
          alert("Bağlantı panoya kopyalandı! 📋");
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Link oluşturma hatası:", err);
    }

    const email = window.prompt("Görevi e-posta ile paylaşmak istediğiniz adresi giriniz:");
    if (!email || !email.includes("@")) return;

    try {
      const res = await axiosClient.post("/social/share-task", { recipientEmail: email, taskTitle: title, taskId: id });
      alert(res.data.message || (res.data.success ? "Paylaşıldı!" : "Hata oluştu."));
    } catch (err) {
      alert(err.response?.data?.message || "Paylaşım hatası.");
    }
  };

  const handleComplete = () => {
    if (isCompleted || isSubmitting) return;
    setShowReflection(true);
  };

  const handleFinalComplete = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting || isCompleted) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const tagsArray = customTags ? customTags.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t) : [];
      await onComplete(id, reflectionText, tagsArray);
      setShowReflection(false);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Görev tamamlama hatası:", err);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePostpone = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting || isCompleted) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const tomorrow = new Date();
      tomorrow.setDate(tomorrow.getDate() + 1);
      const dateStr = tomorrow.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      
      await taskPoolApi.postponeTask(id, dateStr, postponeReason);
      setShowPostpone(false);
      onPostpone?.(id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Erteleme hatası:", err);
      alert("Görev ertelenirken bir hata oluştu.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancelPostpone = async () => {
    if (isSubmitting) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.cancelPostponeTask(id);
      onCancelPostpone?.(id);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Erteleme iptal hatası:", err);
      alert("Erteleme iptal edilirken bir hata oluştu.");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Swipe Handlers
  const onTouchStart = (e) => {
    setTouchEnd(null);
    setTouchStart(e.targetTouches[0].clientX);
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e) => {
    const currentTouch = e.targetTouches[0].clientX;
    const offset = currentTouch - touchStart;
    
    // Limit swipe offset for visual effect
    if (Math.abs(offset) < 150) {
      setSwipeOffset(offset);
    }
    setTouchEnd(currentTouch);
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    if (!touchStart || !touchEnd) return;
    const distance = touchStart - touchEnd;
    const isLeftSwipe = distance > minSwipeDistance;
    const isRightSwipe = distance < -minSwipeDistance;

    if (isRightSwipe && !isCompleted) {
      handleComplete();
    } else if (isLeftSwipe && !isCompleted && !isPostponed) {
      setShowPostpone(true);
    }
    
    setSwipeOffset(0);
  };

  const isPostponed = status === 'Postponed';

  return (
    <div
      onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
      style={{ transform: `translateX(${swipeOffset}px)`, transition: swipeOffset === 0 ? 'transform 0.3s' : 'none' }}
      className={`rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-300 relative overflow-hidden ${
        isCompleted
          ? "opacity-50 grayscale border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/20"
          : "border-slate-800 hover:border-indigo-500/40 bg-slate-900/40 hover:bg-slate-900/60 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/5"
      }`}
    >
      {/* Swipe Indicators */}
      {swipeOffset > 20 && !isCompleted && (
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-16 bg-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-500 font-black text-xs animate-pulse">
          BİTİR
        </div>
      )}
      {swipeOffset < -20 && !isCompleted && !isPostponed && (
        <div className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 w-16 bg-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-500 font-black text-xs animate-pulse">
          ERTELE
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
        {/* Checkbox + Info */}
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-1 cursor-pointer min-w-0"
          onClick={() => description && setShowDesc(!showDesc)}
        >
          <div
            className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 transition-all duration-300 ${
              isCompleted
                ? "bg-emerald-500 border-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.4)]"
                : "border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-500"
            }`}
          >
            {isCompleted && (
              <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-white" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <h4
                className={`font-bold text-sm truncate transition-colors ${
                  isCompleted ? "text-slate-500 line-through" : "text-white group-hover:text-indigo-400"
                }`}
              >
                {title}
              </h4>
              {isPostponed && (
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-500/20 whitespace-nowrap">
                  ERTELENDİ
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border uppercase tracking-wider ${DIFFICULTY_COLORS[safeDifficulty]}`}>
                {safeDifficulty}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-400">+{xp} XP</span>
              {isPostponed && postponedTo && (
                <span className="text-xs text-amber-500/80 italic hidden sm:inline">
                  (📅 {postponedTo} tarihinde aktif olacak)
                </span>
              )}
              {description && (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-400 transition-colors">
                  {showDesc ? "▲ Gizle" : "▼ Detay"}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {/* Tags Display */}
            {(tags.length > 0 || customTags) && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1.5">
                {tags.map((tag, i) => (
                  <span key={i} className="text-[9px] bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-500/20">#{tag}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 border-l border-slate-800/50 pl-4 py-2">
          {isPostponed ? (
            <button
              onClick={handleCancelPostpone}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shrink-0 ${
                isSubmitting
                  ? "bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-wait"
                  : "bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? "..." : "İptal Et"}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <>
              {!isCompleted && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowPostpone(!showPostpone)}
                  title="Görevi Yarına Ertele"
                  className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-800/50 hover:bg-amber-500/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-amber-500 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-amber-500/20 shrink-0"
                >
                  <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              )}

              {!isCompleted && onFocus && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => onFocus({ id, title, xp, difficulty })}
                  title="Odaklanma Modu"
                  className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600/10 hover:bg-indigo-600/20 text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors border border-indigo-500/20 shrink-0"
                >
                  <span className="text-lg">⏱️</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                onClick={handleShare}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all flex-shrink-0 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 border border-slate-700 active:scale-95 shadow-lg"
              >
                ✉️ Paylaş
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={handleComplete}
                disabled={isCompleted || isSubmitting}
                className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all flex-shrink-0 shadow-lg active:scale-95 ${
                  isCompleted
                    ? "bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed shadow-none"
                    : isSubmitting
                    ? "bg-indigo-800 text-indigo-400 cursor-wait"
                    : "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-indigo-500/25 hover:shadow-indigo-500/40"
                }`}
              >
                {isCompleted ? "✓ Tamamlandı" : isSubmitting ? "..." : "Bitir"}
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Postpone Panel */}
      {showPostpone && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-800/50 bg-amber-500/5 rounded-b-2xl">
          <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <p className="text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-tight">Görevi Yarına Ertele</p>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-500/60 italic">* XP kazancı %70'e düşecektir.</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Erteleme sebebi (isteğe bağlı)..."
                value={postponeReason}
                onChange={(e) => setPostponeReason(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-amber-500/50 transition-colors"
              />
              <button
                onClick={handlePostpone}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                Onayla
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowPostpone(false)}
                className="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-400 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
              >
                İptal
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Description Expandable */}
      {showDesc && description && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-800/50">
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-3 leading-relaxed">{description}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Reflection Panel — FEAT-002 */}
      {showReflection && !isCompleted && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 border-t border-slate-800/50 bg-indigo-500/5 rounded-b-2xl animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-300">
          <div className="pt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <p className="text-indigo-400 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest">Görevi Tamamla & Yorumla</p>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-500/60 font-bold">+5 XP Bonus Kazan! ✍️</span>
            </div>
            
            <textarea
              placeholder="Bu görev sana ne hissettirdi? (Mikro-günlük)..."
              value={reflectionText}
              onChange={(e) => setReflectionText(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-200 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500/50 transition-colors resize-none"
              rows={2}
            />

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1 relative">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Etiketler (virgülle ayır)..."
                  value={customTags}
                  onChange={(e) => setCustomTags(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-400 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500/50"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={handleFinalComplete}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 active:scale-95"
              >
                {isSubmitting ? "..." : "Kaydet & Bitir"}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowReflection(false)}
                className="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-400 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all"
              >
                İptal
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default TaskItem;

import { useState } from 'react';
import EnhancedTaskCard from './EnhancedTaskCard';
import '../styles/TaskPoolSelector.css';

const MOOD_LABELS = {
  0: { label: 'Enerjik', emoji: '⚡', color: '#f59e0b' },
  1: { label: 'Normal', emoji: '😊', color: '#10b981' },
  2: { label: 'Yorgun', emoji: '😴', color: '#6366f1' },
  3: { label: 'Bunalmış', emoji: '😰', color: '#ef4444' },
  4: { label: 'Vaktim Kısıtlı', emoji: '⏰', color: '#3b82f6' },
};

const SLOT_LABELS = {
  0: 'Sabah',
  1: 'Öğle',
  2: 'Öğleden Sonra',
  3: 'Akşam',
  4: 'Gece',
};

export default function TaskPoolSelector({ poolData, onTaskSelect, onRefresh, isPoolMode = false, isLimitReached = false, selectedIds = new Set() }) {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all'); // all | quick | deep

  if (!poolData) return null;

  const mood = MOOD_LABELS[poolData.todayMood] || MOOD_LABELS[1];
  const slot = SLOT_LABELS[poolData.timeSlot] || 'Gün';

  const filteredTasks = poolData.tasks?.filter((t) => {
    const mins = t.estimatedMinutes ?? t.EstimatedMinutes ?? 0;
    if (filter === 'quick') return mins <= 20;
    if (filter === 'deep') return mins > 20;
    return true;
  }) || [];

  const handleSelect = (task) => {
    onTaskSelect?.(task);
  };

  return (
    <div className="task-pool-container">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="task-pool-header">
        <div className="pool-context">
          <div className="pool-mood-badge" style={{ '--mood-color': mood.color }}>
            {mood.emoji} {mood.label}
          </div>
          <div className="pool-meta">
            <span>🌅 {slot}</span>
            <span>⏱️ {poolData.availableMinutes} dk müsait</span>
            <span>⚡ Enerji {poolData.energyLevel}/5</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="pool-filters">
          {['all', 'quick', 'deep'].map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f}
              className={`filter-chip ${filter === f ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
            >
              {f === 'all' ? 'Tümü' : f === 'quick' ? '⚡ Hızlı (≤20dk)' : '🧠 Odak (>20dk)'}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <button className="pool-refresh-btn font-bold" onClick={onRefresh}>
          🔄 Yenile
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Task Grid */}
      {filteredTasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="pool-empty">
          <span>🎉</span>
          <p>Bu filtre için görev bulunamadı</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="task-pool-grid">
          {filteredTasks.map((task) => {
            const taskId = task.userTaskId ?? task.UserTaskId ?? task.id;
            return (
              <EnhancedTaskCard
                key={taskId}
                task={task}
                isSelected={selectedIds.has(taskId)}
                onSelect={() => handleSelect(task)}
                isPoolMode={isPoolMode}
                isLimitReached={isLimitReached}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="selection-summary">
          ✅ {selectedIds.size} görev seçildi — Harika! Başarılar!
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const TaskTimer = ({ task, onComplete, onClose }) => {
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(25 * 60); // Default 25 mins Pomodoro
  const [isActive, setIsActive] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isActive && !isPaused && timeLeft > 0) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setTimeLeft((prev) => prev - 1);
      }, 1000);
    } else if (timeLeft === 0) {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      // Optional: auto-complete or notification
    } else {
      clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  }, [isActive, isPaused, timeLeft]);

  const toggleTimer = () => {
    if (!isActive) {
      setIsActive(true);
    } else {
      setIsPaused(!isPaused);
    }
  };

  const resetTimer = () => {
    setIsActive(false);
    setIsPaused(false);
    setTimeLeft(25 * 60);
  };

  const formatTime = (seconds) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = seconds % 60;
    return `${mins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const progress = ((25 * 60 - timeLeft) / (25 * 60)) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-slate-950 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 sm:p-12 animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-300">
      <button 
        onClick={onClose}
        className="absolute top-8 right-8 text-slate-500 hover:text-white transition-colors p-3 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-900"
      >
        <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
        </svg>
      </button>

      <div className="max-w-2xl w-full text-center space-y-12">
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-indigo-500 font-black tracking-[0.3em] uppercase text-xs">Şu an Odaklanılan Görev</p>
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase leading-tight">
            {task?.title || "Odaklanma Zamanı"}
          </h2>
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
             <span className="bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
               {task?.difficulty || "Medium"}
             </span>
             <span className="bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold">
               +{task?.xp || 100} XP
             </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Big Timer Circle Display */}
        <div className="relative w-64 h-64 sm:w-80 sm:h-80 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
          <svg className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full -rotate-90">
            <circle
              cx="50%"
              cy="50%"
              r="48%"
              className="stroke-slate-900 fill-none"
              strokeWidth="4"
            />
            <circle
              cx="50%"
              cy="50%"
              r="48%"
              className="stroke-indigo-600 fill-none transition-all duration-1000"
              strokeWidth="4"
              strokeDasharray="100 100"
              style={{ strokeDasharray: `${progress} 100`, strokeLinecap: 'round' }}
            />
          </svg>
          <div className="text-7xl sm:text-8xl font-black text-white tabular-nums tracking-tighter">
            {formatTime(timeLeft)}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-6">
          <button
            onClick={toggleTimer}
            className={`w-full sm:w-48 py-5 rounded-[2rem] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-sm transition-all shadow-2xl active:scale-95 ${
              !isActive || isPaused 
                ? "bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white shadow-indigo-500/40" 
                : "bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300"
            }`}
          >
            {!isActive ? "Süreyi Başlat" : isPaused ? "Devam Et" : "Durdur"}
          </button>
          
          <button
            onClick={resetTimer}
            className="w-full sm:w-48 py-5 rounded-[2rem] bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300 font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-sm transition-all active:scale-95 border border-slate-800"
          >
            Sıfırla
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="pt-12 border-t border-slate-900">
           <button
             onClick={() => onComplete(task.id)}
             className="text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs flex items-center gap-2 mx-auto transition-all hover:scale-110"
           >
             <span className="text-xl">✅</span> Görevi Hemen Bitir
           </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default TaskTimer;

import React, { useState } from "react";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import { getUserIdFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";

const VACATION_REASONS = [
  { value: "Tatil", label: "🏖️ Tatil" },
  { value: "Hastalık", label: "🤒 Hastalık" },
  { value: "Çok yoğunum", label: "💼 Çok yoğunum" },
];

const VacationModeToggle = ({ isOnVacation: initialVacation = false, onVacationChange }) => {
  const [isOnVacation, setIsOnVacation] = useState(initialVacation);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("Tatil");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState(null);

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

  const handleStartVacation = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const body = {
        reason,
        endDate: endDate || null,
      };
      const res = await axiosClient.post(`/users/${userId}/vacation/start`, body);
      setIsOnVacation(true);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: res.data?.message || "Tatil modu başlatıldı! 🏖️" });
      setShowConfirm(false);
      onVacationChange?.(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Bir hata oluştu." });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleEndVacation = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const userId = getUserIdFromToken();
      const res = await axiosClient.post(`/users/${userId}/vacation/end`);
      setIsOnVacation(false);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: res.data?.message || "Tatil modu kapatıldı! 🔥" });
      onVacationChange?.(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: "Bir hata oluştu." });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900/80 to-slate-800/60 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-[2rem] p-6 space-y-5">
      {/* Başlık */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white tracking-wider uppercase italic flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xl">🏖️</span> Tatil / Mola Modu
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Bu sürede streak'in korunur, görev gelmez.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={() => isOnVacation ? handleEndVacation() : setShowConfirm(true)}
          disabled={loading}
          className={`relative w-14 h-7 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
            isOnVacation
              ? "bg-emerald-500 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30"
              : "bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600"
          } disabled:opacity-50`}
          aria-label="Tatil modunu aç/kapat"
        >
          <span
            className={`absolute top-1 w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow transition-all duration-300 ${
              isOnVacation ? "left-8" : "left-1"
            }`}
          />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Durum rozeti */}
      {isOnVacation && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2">
          <span className="text-emerald-400 text-sm">✅</span>
          <p className="text-emerald-300 text-sm font-medium">
            Tatil modundasın — streak'in güvende! 🔥
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Onay formu */}
      {showConfirm && !isOnVacation && (
        <div className="space-y-4 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-2xl p-4 bg-slate-900/40">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 font-semibold">Tatil nedeni nedir?</p>

          {/* Neden seçimi */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {VACATION_REASONS.map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.value}
                onClick={() => setReason(r.value)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                  reason === r.value
                    ? "bg-indigo-600/30 border border-indigo-500 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-400 hover:border-slate-500"
                }`}
              >
                {r.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Bitiş tarihi */}
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 block mb-1">Bitiş tarihi (opsiyonel)</label>
            <input
              type="date"
              min={todayStr}
              value={endDate}
              onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition-colors"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Açıklama */}
          <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 rounded-xl p-3">
            <p className="text-amber-300 text-xs">
              ⚠️ Tatil süresince sana görev atanmaz. Dilediğin zaman kapatabilirsin.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Butonlar */}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleStartVacation}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white text-sm font-bold py-2 rounded-xl transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {loading ? "Başlatılıyor..." : "Başlat 🏖️"}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowConfirm(false)}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-sm font-bold py-2 rounded-xl transition-all"
            >
              İptal
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mesaj */}
      {message && (
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm ${
            message.type === "success"
              ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/20"
              : "bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border border-red-500/20"
          }`}
        >
          {message.text}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default VacationModeToggle;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\chatbot\chatApiHandler.js

// ─── ChatBot API Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
import axiosClient from "../../api/axiosClient";
import chatService from "../../services/chatService";
import taskService from "../../services/taskService";
import userService from "../../services/userService";
import moodService from "../../services/moodService";
import badgeService from "../../services/badgeService";
import goalService from "../../services/goalService";
import { MOTIVATION_TEMPLATES } from "./chatFlows";

// ─── Yardımcı: API cevabından metin çıkar ────────────────────────────────────
function extractText(val) {
  if (!val) return null;
  if (typeof val === "string") return val;
  // AI servisi bazen { response: "..." } ya da { message: "..." } döner
  if (typeof val === "object") {
    return val.response || val.message || val.text || null;
  }
  return String(val);
}

// ─── Yardımcı: Mood açıklaması ────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getMoodDescription(mood) {
  if (!mood) return "bilinmiyor";
  const energy = mood.energyLevel ?? 5;
  if (energy >= 8) return "pozitif ve enerjik";
  if (energy >= 6) return "normal, iyi hissediyor";
  if (energy >= 4) return "yorgun, orta enerji";
  return "düşük enerji, zorlu bir gün geçiriyor";
}

// ─── Yardımcı: Mood hint'ten template key ────────────────────────────────────
function moodHintToTemplateKey(moodHint) {
  const map = {
    pozitif: "pozitif",
    normal: "normal",
    yorgun: "yorgun",
    zor: "zor",
  };
  return map[moodHint] || "normal";
}

// ─── Ana API Yürütücü ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export async function executeApiAction(apiAction, context = {}) {
  switch (apiAction) {

    // ── Görev Sorgulama ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_active_tasks": {
      const tasks = await taskService.getAllTasks();
      const active = tasks.filter(t =>
        t.status === "Selected" || t.status === "InProgress" || t.status === "Suggested"
      );
      return { tasks: active };
    }

    case "get_completed_today": {
      const tasks = await taskService.getAllTasks();
      const today = new Date().toDateString();
      const completed = tasks.filter(t => {
        if (t.status !== "Completed") return false;
        if (!t.completedAt) return false;
        return new Date(t.completedAt).toDateString() === today;
      });
      return { tasks: completed };
    }

    case "get_postponed_tasks": {
      const tasks = await taskService.getAllTasks();
      const postponed = tasks.filter(t => t.status === "Postponed");
      return { tasks: postponed };
    }

    case "get_daily_pool": {
      const data = await taskService.getDailyPool();
      // Backend { tasks: [...] } veya doğrudan array dönebilir
      const tasks = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.tasks || []);
      return { tasks };
    }

    // ── Kişiselleştirilmiş Görev Önerisi ──────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_personalized_tasks": {
      const [allTasksRes, profileRes, moodRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        axiosClient.get("/user-tasks/available-tasks"),
        userService.getProfile(),
        moodService.getTodayMood(),
      ]);

      // available-tasks endpoint'i zaten level filtrelemesini backend'de yapıyor
      const rawTasks = allTasksRes.status === "fulfilled"
        ? (Array.isArray(allTasksRes.value.data) ? allTasksRes.value.data : [])
        : [];
      const user = profileRes.status === "fulfilled" ? profileRes.value : null;
      const mood = moodRes.status === "fulfilled"
        ? (moodRes.value?.data ?? null)
        : null;

      let filtered = [...rawTasks];

      // ── Kategori filtresi ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const cat = context.categoryHint;
      if (cat && cat !== "all" && filtered.length > 0) {
        const catKeywords = {
          saglik:  ["sağlık", "spor", "fitness", "egzersiz", "health", "spor"],
          egitim:  ["eğitim", "okuma", "kitap", "öğrenme", "kurs", "education"],
          mental:  ["zihinsel", "meditasyon", "nefes", "mental", "mindfulness", "psikoloji"],
          sosyal:  ["sosyal", "aile", "arkadaş", "iletişim", "social"],
          kariyer: ["kariyer", "iş", "üretkenlik", "proje", "hedef", "productivity"],
          hobi:    ["hobi", "yaratıcı", "sanat", "müzik", "dans", "hobby", "resim"],
        };
        const keywords = catKeywords[cat] || [];
        const catFiltered = filtered.filter(t => {
          const name = (t.categoryName || "").toLowerCase();
          return keywords.some(kw => name.includes(kw));
        });
        // Eşleşme yoksa orijinal listeyi koru (kullanıcı kafası karışmasın)
        if (catFiltered.length > 0) filtered = catFiltered;
      }

      // ── Zorluk filtresi ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      const diff = context.difficultyHint;
      if (diff && diff !== "auto") {
        const diffFiltered = filtered.filter(t => t.difficulty === diff);
        if (diffFiltered.length > 0) filtered = diffFiltered;
      } else if (diff === "auto") {
        // Mood enerji seviyesine göre otomatik zorluk seçimi
        const energy = mood?.energyLevel ?? 5;
        let preferredDiffs;
        if (energy >= 8)      preferredDiffs = ["Hard", "Medium"];
        else if (energy >= 5) preferredDiffs = ["Medium", "Easy"];
        else                  preferredDiffs = ["Easy"];

        const autoFiltered = filtered.filter(t => preferredDiffs.includes(t.difficulty));
        if (autoFiltered.length > 0) filtered = autoFiltered;
      }

      // ── Seviyeye göre sırala (backend zaten filtreler ama sıralama ekle) ────
      if (user?.generalLevel) {
        const lvl = Math.floor(user.generalLevel);
        filtered.sort((a, b) => {
          // MinLevel'ı kullanıcı seviyesine en yakın olanlar önce
          const aDiff = Math.abs((a.minLevel || 1) - lvl);
          const bDiff = Math.abs((b.minLevel || 1) - lvl);
          return aDiff - bDiff;
        });
      }

      // ── Mood'a göre XP ağırlıklandırması ────────────────────────────────────
      // Düşük enerjide küçük XP'li (hızlı biten) görevler öne çıksın
      if (mood?.energyLevel && mood.energyLevel < 5) {
        filtered.sort((a, b) => (a.baseXP || 0) - (b.baseXP || 0));
      }

      // En iyi 5 tane al (shuffle ile çeşitlilik ekle)
      const top = filtered.slice(0, 10);
      const shuffled = top.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 5);

      return {
        tasks: shuffled,
        profile: user,
        mood,
        categoryHint: cat,
        difficultyHint: diff,
      };
    }

    // ── Profil & İstatistik ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_profile": {
      const profile = await userService.getProfile();
      return { profile };
    }

    case "get_user_stats": {
      const stats = await userService.getUserStats();
      return { stats };
    }

    case "get_weekly_report": {
      const res = await axiosClient.get("/reports");
      const reports = res.data?.reports || [];
      return { report: reports[0] || null };
    }

    case "get_daily_breakdown": {
      const res = await axiosClient.get("/reports/daily-breakdown");
      return { breakdown: res.data?.breakdown || [] };
    }

    // ── Hedefler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_goals": {
      const goals = await goalService.getGoals();
      return { goals: Array.isArray(goals) ? goals : [] };
    }

    case "get_goals_dashboard": {
      const data = await goalService.getGoalDashboard();
      return { dashboard: data };
    }

    // ── Rozetler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_badges": {
      const badges = await badgeService.getBadgeGallery();
      return { badges: Array.isArray(badges) ? badges : [] };
    }

    // ── Mood ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_today_mood": {
      const res = await moodService.getTodayMood();
      // { success: true, data: { ... } } yapısından data çıkar
      const mood = res?.data ?? res ?? null;
      return { mood };
    }

    case "save_mood": {
      const moodData = {
        moodMode: context.moodMode ?? 0,
        energyLevel: context.energyLevel ?? 5,
        availableMinutes: context.availableMinutes ?? 60,
      };
      await moodService.recordDailyMood(moodData);
      return { saved: true, mood: moodData };
    }

    // ── AI Motivasyon ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    case "get_ai_motivation": {
      // Profil + mood verisini paralel çek
      const [profileRes, moodRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        userService.getProfile(),
        moodService.getTodayMood(),
      ]);

      const user = profileRes.status === "fulfilled" ? profileRes.value : null;
      const mood = moodRes.status === "fulfilled"
        ? (moodRes.value?.data ?? null)
        : null;

      const moodDesc = context.moodHint
        ? context.moodHint
        : getMoodDescription(mood);

      const levelText = user
        ? `Kullanıcı seviyesi: ${Math.floor(user.generalLevel || 1)}, toplam XP: ${(user.totalXp || 0).toLocaleString("tr-TR")}.`
        : "";

      const prompt = `${levelText} Kullanıcının şu anki ruh hali: ${moodDesc}. Kullanıcıya kısa, içten ve güçlü Türkçe motivasyon mesajı yaz. Sadece motivasyon metnini yaz, JSON veya başka format kullanma.`;

      try {
        const aiResponse = await chatService.sendMessage(prompt);
        // AI servisi { response: "...", intent: "...", ... } döner
        const text = extractText(aiResponse?.response ?? aiResponse);
        if (!text) throw new Error("Boş AI cevabı");
        return { message: text, mood, profile: user, isAI: true };
      } catch {
        // AI servis yoksa veya hata varsa → offline şablonlar
        const key = moodHintToTemplateKey(context.moodHint || getMoodHint(mood?.energyLevel));
        const templates = MOTIVATION_TEMPLATES[key] || MOTIVATION_TEMPLATES.normal;
        const msg = templates[Math.floor(Math.random() * templates.length)];
        return { message: msg, mood, isAI: false };
      }
    }

    default:
      throw new Error(`Bilinmeyen API aksiyonu: ${apiAction}`);
  }
}

// ─── Yardımcı fonksiyonlar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getMoodHint(energyLevel) {
  if (!energyLevel) return "normal";
  if (energyLevel >= 8) return "pozitif";
  if (energyLevel >= 6) return "normal";
  if (energyLevel >= 4) return "yorgun";
  return "zor";
}

// ─── Görev Atama (available-tasks → assign) ───────────────────────────────────
export async function assignTask(taskId) {
  return await taskService.assignSpecificTask(taskId);
}

// ─── Görev Havuzdan Seç (daily-pool → select) ────────────────────────────────
export async function selectTask(taskId) {
  return await taskService.selectTask(taskId);
}

export const XPBreakdownChart = ({ breakdown }) => {
  if (!breakdown || breakdown.length === 0) return (
    <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm text-center py-2">Henüz XP verisi yok.</p>
  );
  const maxXP = Math.max(...breakdown.map(d => d.XPKazanci || 0), 1);
  const days = ["Pzt", "Sal", "Çar", "Per", "Cum", "Cmt", "Paz"];
  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/50 p-4">
      <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm mb-3">🔥 Son 7 Gün XP Kazanımı</p>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-1.5 h-24">
        {breakdown.map((d, i) => {
          const pct = ((d.XPKazanci || 0) / maxXP) * 100;
          const isToday = i === breakdown.length - 1;
          return (
            <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">{d.XPKazanci || 0}</span>
              <div className="w-full flex flex-col justify-end" style={{ height: "60px" }}>
                <div
                  className={`w-full rounded-t transition-all ${isToday ? "bg-indigo-500" : "bg-slate-600"}`}
                  style={{ height: `${Math.max(pct, 3)}%`, minHeight: "3px" }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className={`text-[9px] ${isToday ? "text-indigo-400 font-bold" : "text-slate-500"}`}>
                {new Date(d.date).toLocaleDateString("tr-TR", { weekday: "short" })}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const mkMsg = (sender, content, extras = {}) => ({
  id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
  sender,
  time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString("tr-TR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
  content,
  ...extras,
});

// ─── Ana Bileşen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ChatBotFlow = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(0);
  const [flowCtx, setFlowCtx] = useState({});
  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);
  // React Strict Mode çift çalışmayı önlemek için guard
  const initDone = useRef(false);
  // pushNode içinde stale closure'dan kaçınmak için ref
  const flowCtxRef = useRef({});

  // Kullanıcı değişince (logout / farklı hesapla login) her şeyi sıfırla
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) {
      // Çıkış yapıldı: chat'i kapat ve temizle
      setIsOpen(false);
      setMessages([]);
      setFlowCtx({});
      flowCtxRef.current = {};
      initDone.current = false;
      return;
    }
    // Yeni kullanıcı girişi veya ilk yükleme: ana menüyü göster
    if (!initDone.current) {
      initDone.current = true;
      pushNode("main_menu");
    }
  }, [user]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [messages]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setUnread(0);
  }, [isOpen]);

  const addMsg = useCallback((msg) => {
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, msg]);
    if (!isOpen) setUnread(c => c + 1);
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Dışarıdan tetikleme (dashboard toast)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e) => {
      setIsOpen(true);
      if (e?.detail?.message) {
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: e.detail.message }));
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("openChatBot", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("openChatBot", handler);
  }, [addMsg]); // addMsg değişince handler'ı güncelle

  // ─── Node'u işle ve mesaj olarak ekle ────────────────────────────────────
  const pushNode = useCallback(async (nodeId, ctx = {}) => {
    const node = FLOWS[nodeId];
    if (!node) return;

    const mergedCtx = { ...flowCtxRef.current, ...ctx };

    if (node.type === "options" || node.type === "message") {
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", {
        type: "options",
        text: node.message,
        options: node.options,
        nodeId,
      }));
      return;
    }

    if (node.type === "api_call") {
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "loading", text: node.loadingMessage }));
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const data = await executeApiAction(node.apiAction, mergedCtx);
        setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.content?.type !== "loading"));
        setLoading(false);
        const nextNode = FLOWS[node.nextNode];
        if (!nextNode) return;
        // Dynamic node'lar renderDataNode'a gönderilmez, pushNode ile işlenir
        if (nextNode.type === "dynamic") {
          // API'den gelen veriyi context'e aktar
          const dataCtx = { ...mergedCtx };
          if (data.mood) dataCtx.moodFromApi = data.mood;
          await pushNode(node.nextNode, dataCtx);
        } else {
          renderDataNode(nextNode, data, mergedCtx);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.content?.type !== "loading"));
        setLoading(false);
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: "⚠️ Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin." }));
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: "Ne yapmak istersin?", options: FLOWS.main_menu.options, nodeId: "main_menu" }));
      }
      return;
    }

    if (node.type === "dynamic" && node.dynamicType === "motivation_with_mood") {
      // Mood verisi ya API'den geldi (moodFromApi) ya da burada fetch edelim
      const existingMood = mergedCtx.moodFromApi || null;
      if (existingMood !== undefined && existingMood !== null) {
        // Mood var — direkt AI motivasyon çağrısına geç
        const newCtx = { ...mergedCtx, moodHint: getMoodHint(existingMood.energyLevel) };
        flowCtxRef.current = newCtx;
        setFlowCtx(newCtx);
        await pushNode("motivation_ai_call", newCtx);
      } else {
        // Mood yok — önce mood'unu sor
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "loading", text: "Ruh halin kontrol ediliyor..." }));
        setLoading(true);
        try {
          const moodRes = await executeApiAction("get_today_mood", mergedCtx);
          const mood = moodRes.mood;
          setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.content?.type !== "loading"));
          setLoading(false);
          if (!mood) {
            await pushNode("motivation_mood_missing", mergedCtx);
          } else {
            const newCtx = { ...mergedCtx, moodHint: getMoodHint(mood.energyLevel), moodFromApi: mood };
            flowCtxRef.current = newCtx;
            setFlowCtx(newCtx);
            await pushNode("motivation_ai_call", newCtx);
          }
        } catch {
          setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.content?.type !== "loading"));
          setLoading(false);
          await pushNode("motivation_mood_missing", mergedCtx);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
  }, [addMsg]); // flowCtxRef.current kullanıldığı için flowCtx bağımlılığı gerekmez

  // ─── Data node'u render et ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderDataNode = (node, data, ctx) => {
    if (!node) return;

    switch (node.type) {
      // Aktif / Ertelenen görev listeleri
      case "task_list":
      case "postponed_task_list": {
        const tasks = data.tasks || [];
        if (tasks.length === 0) {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: node.emptyMessage, options: node.emptyOptions, nodeId: node.id }));
          return;
        }
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "task_cards", tasks, isPool: false, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      // Tamamlanan görevler
      case "completed_task_list": {
        const tasks = data.tasks || [];
        if (tasks.length === 0) {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: node.emptyMessage, options: node.emptyOptions, nodeId: node.id }));
          return;
        }
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "completed_tasks", tasks, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      // Havuz (seç butonu olan liste)
      case "pool_task_list": {
        const tasks = data.tasks || [];
        if (tasks.length === 0) {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: node.emptyMessage, options: node.emptyOptions, nodeId: node.id }));
          return;
        }
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "pool_tasks", tasks, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      // Kişiselleştirilmiş öneriler
      case "suggested_task_cards": {
        const tasks = data.tasks || [];
        if (tasks.length === 0) {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: node.emptyMessage, options: node.emptyOptions, nodeId: node.id }));
          return;
        }
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: buildSuggestionIntro(data) }));
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "suggested_tasks", tasks, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      case "profile_card":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "profile_card", profile: data.profile, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;

      case "weekly_stats":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "weekly_stats", report: data.report, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;

      case "xp_chart":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "xp_chart", breakdown: data.breakdown, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;

      case "stats_card":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "stats_card", stats: data.stats, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;

      case "goal_list": {
        const goals = data.goals || [];
        if (goals.length === 0) {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: node.emptyMessage, options: node.emptyOptions, nodeId: node.id }));
          return;
        }
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "goal_list", goals, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      case "goals_summary":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "goals_dashboard", dashboard: data.dashboard, options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;

      case "badge_gallery": {
        const badges = data.badges || [];
        const unlocked = badges.filter(b => b.isUnlocked).length;
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: `🏆 Toplam ${badges.length} rozetten ${unlocked} tanesini kazandın!` }));
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "badge_gallery", badges: badges.slice(0, 8), options: node.options, nodeId: node.id }));
        break;
      }

      case "mood_saved":
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", {
          type: "mood_saved",
          mood: { moodMode: ctx.moodMode, energyLevel: ctx.energyLevel, availableMinutes: ctx.availableMinutes },
          options: node.options,
          nodeId: node.id,
        }));
        break;

      // Motivasyon — AI veya offline
      case "motivation_card":
        if (!data.message || typeof data.message !== "string") {
          // Güvenlik: boş veya geçersiz cevap gelirse offline fallback
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: "💪 Bugün küçük bir adım bile büyük bir zafer. Devam et!" }));
        } else {
          addMsg(mkMsg("bot", {
            type: "motivation_card",
            message: data.message,
            isAI: data.isAI,
            options: node.options,
            nodeId: node.id,
          }));
        }
        break;

      default:
        // JSON dump yerine kullanıcı dostu mesaj
        addMsg(mkMsg("bot", {
          type: "options",
          text: "İşlem tamamlandı! Başka bir şey yapayım mı?",
          options: FLOWS.main_menu.options,
          nodeId: "main_menu",
        }));
    }
  };

  // ─── Buton tıklaması ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleOption = useCallback(async (opt, msgId) => {
    if (loading) return;

    // Kullanıcı mesajı ekle
    addMsg(mkMsg("user", { type: "text", text: opt.label }));

    // Eski mesajdaki seçenekleri devre dışı bırak
    setMessages(prev => prev.map(m => m.id === msgId ? { ...m, content: { ...m.content, optionsUsed: true } } : m));

    // Context güncelle
    const ctxUpdate = {};
    if (opt.categoryHint !== undefined) ctxUpdate.categoryHint = opt.categoryHint;
    if (opt.difficultyHint !== undefined) ctxUpdate.difficultyHint = opt.difficultyHint;
    if (opt.moodHint !== undefined) ctxUpdate.moodHint = opt.moodHint;
    if (opt.moodMode !== undefined) ctxUpdate.moodMode = opt.moodMode;
    if (opt.energyLevel !== undefined) ctxUpdate.energyLevel = opt.energyLevel;
    if (opt.availableMinutes !== undefined) ctxUpdate.availableMinutes = opt.availableMinutes;
    const newCtx = { ...flowCtxRef.current, ...ctxUpdate };
    flowCtxRef.current = newCtx;
    setFlowCtx(newCtx);

    // Özel aksiyon
    if (opt.action === "navigate" && opt.target) {
      window.location.href = opt.target;
      return;
    }

    if (opt.nextNode) {
      await pushNode(opt.nextNode, newCtx);
    }
  }, [loading, addMsg, pushNode]);

  // ─── Görev atama ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAssign = async (task) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await assignTask(task.id || task.taskId);
      
      // Backend'den 200 dönse de success false (örn: limit aşıldı) olabilir
      if (res && (res.success === false || res.Success === false)) {
        throw new Error(res.message || res.Message || "Görev eklenemedi.");
      }

      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: `✅ "${task.title}" görevin eklendi! Görevler sayfasından takip edebilirsin.` }));
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: "Başka bir şey yapayım mı?", options: FLOWS.main_menu.options, nodeId: "main_menu" }));
    } catch (err) {
      const errMsg = err.response?.data?.message || err.response?.data || err.message || "Bilinmeyen bir hata oluştu.";
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: `⚠️ Görev eklenemedi: ${errMsg}` }));
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: "Başka bir görev seçmek ister misin?", options: FLOWS.main_menu.options, nodeId: "main_menu" }));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectPoolTask = async (task) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await selectTask(task.id || task.taskId);
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: `✅ "${task.title}" seçildi! Görevler sayfasında aktif görünecek.` }));
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "options", text: "Başka bir şey yapayım mı?", options: FLOWS.main_menu.options, nodeId: "main_menu" }));
    } catch {
      addMsg(mkMsg("bot", { type: "text", text: "⚠️ Görev seçilirken hata oluştu." }));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // ─── Sohbeti sıfırla ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleReset = () => {
    setMessages([]);
    setFlowCtx({});
    flowCtxRef.current = {};
    // initDone'u sıfırlamaya gerek yok — manuel reset
    setTimeout(() => pushNode("main_menu"), 50);
  };

  // ─── Mesaj render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderMessage = (msg) => {
    const { content } = msg;
    const isUser = msg.sender === "user";

    if (isUser) {
      return (
        <div key={msg.id} className="flex justify-end">
          <div className="max-w-[80%] bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-br-md px-4 py-2.5">
            <p className="text-sm">{content.text}</p>
            <p className="text-[9px] text-indigo-200 mt-1">{msg.time}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (content.type === "loading") {
      return (
        <div key={msg.id} className="flex justify-start">
          <div className="bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 border border-slate-700/50">
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mb-2">{content.text}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-1.5">
              {[0, 150, 300].map(d => (
                <span key={d} className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-400 rounded-full animate-bounce" style={{ animationDelay: `${d}ms` }} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div key={msg.id} className="flex justify-start">
        <div className="max-w-[92%] space-y-2 w-full">
          {/* Bot avatar */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
            <div className="w-5 h-5 bg-indigo-600/50 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]">🤖</div>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500">{msg.time}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Metin */}
          {content.text && (
            <div className="bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 border border-slate-700/50">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-100 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{content.text}</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Özel kartlar */}
          {content.type === "profile_card" && <ProfileCard profile={content.profile} />}
          {content.type === "weekly_stats" && <WeeklyStatsCard report={content.report} />}
          {content.type === "xp_chart" && <XPBreakdownChart breakdown={content.breakdown} />}
          {content.type === "stats_card" && <StatsCard stats={content.stats} />}
          {content.type === "goals_dashboard" && <GoalsDashboardCard dashboard={content.dashboard} />}
          {content.type === "motivation_card" && <MotivationCard message={content.message} isAI={content.isAI} />}
          {content.type === "mood_saved" && <MoodSavedCard mood={content.mood} />}

          {/* Aktif / ertelenen görev listesi (buton yok) */}
          {content.type === "task_cards" && content.tasks?.map(t => (
            <TaskCard key={t.id || t.taskId} task={t} />
          ))}

          {/* Tamamlananlar */}
          {content.type === "completed_tasks" && content.tasks?.map(t => (
            <CompletedTaskCard key={t.id || t.taskId} task={t} />
          ))}

          {/* Havuz görevleri — seç butonu var */}
          {content.type === "pool_tasks" && content.tasks?.map(t => (
            <TaskCard
              key={t.id || t.taskId}
              task={t}
              onAction={handleSelectPoolTask}
              actionLabel="Seç"
              actionIcon="✅"
            />
          ))}

          {content.type === "suggested_tasks" && content.tasks?.map(t => (
            <TaskCard
              key={t.id || t.taskId}
              task={t}
              onAction={handleAssign}
              actionLabel="Göreve Başla"
              actionIcon="🚀"
              actionColor="emerald"
            />
          ))}

          {content.type === "badge_gallery" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {content.badges?.map((b, i) => <BadgeCard key={i} badge={b} />)}
            </div>
          )}

          {content.type === "goal_list" && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {content.goals?.map((g, i) => <GoalCard key={i} goal={g} />)}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Seçenek Butonları */}
          {content.options?.length > 0 && !content.optionsUsed && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
              {content.options.map((opt, i) => (
                <button
                  key={i}
                  onClick={() => handleOption(opt, msg.id)}
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed
                    bg-slate-700/60 border-slate-600/50 text-slate-200 hover:bg-indigo-600/30 hover:border-indigo-500/50 hover:text-white active:scale-95"
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          {content.optionsUsed && content.options?.length > 0 && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 italic">Seçim yapıldı</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  // Giriş yapılmamışsa chatbot'u tamamen gizle
  if (!user) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Floating Buton */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 ${
          isOpen ? "bg-slate-700" : "bg-indigo-600 shadow-indigo-500/40 hover:shadow-indigo-500/60"
        }`}
      >
        {isOpen ? (
          <span className="text-2xl text-white">✕</span>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative">
            <span className="text-2xl">🤖</span>
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-3 h-3 bg-emerald-400 rounded-full border-2 border-slate-950 animate-pulse" />
            {unread > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute -top-2 -left-2 min-w-[20px] h-5 bg-red-500 text-white text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full flex items-center justify-center px-1">
                {unread}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Chat Penceresi */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 sm:inset-auto sm:bottom-24 sm:right-6 z-50 w-full h-full sm:w-[420px] sm:h-[650px] bg-slate-900 sm:rounded-3xl border-t sm:border border-slate-700/50 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50 flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
          
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="sm:hidden text-white/80 hover:text-white mr-1">
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7" />
                </svg>
              </button>
              <div className="w-9 h-9 bg-white/20 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-base backdrop-blur-sm">🤖</div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-black text-sm tracking-wide">LifeQuest Asistan</h3>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="text-indigo-200 text-[10px] font-medium">Çevrimiçi · Yardıma hazır</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleReset}
              className="text-white/60 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
              title="Sohbeti yenile"
            >
              🔄
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Mesajlar */}
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-700 scrollbar-track-transparent">
            {messages.map(msg => renderMessage(msg))}
            <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
          </div>

          {/* Alt bilgi */}
          <div className="px-4 py-3 border-t border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/80 text-center shrink-0">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-600">Seçeneklere tıklayarak ilerleyebilirsin</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default ChatBotFlow;

// ─── Yardımcı ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function getMoodHint(energyLevel) {
  if (!energyLevel) return "normal";
  if (energyLevel >= 8) return "pozitif";
  if (energyLevel >= 6) return "normal";
  if (energyLevel >= 4) return "yorgun";
  return "zor";
}

function buildSuggestionIntro(data) {
  const cat = data.categoryHint;
  const diff = data.difficultyHint;
  const energy = data.mood?.energyLevel;
  const level = data.profile?.generalLevel ? Math.floor(data.profile.generalLevel) : null;

  let intro = "🎯 İşte sana özel görev önerileri!";
  const parts = [];
  if (level) parts.push(`Seviye ${level}`);
  if (energy) parts.push(`Enerji: ${energy}/10`);
  if (diff && diff !== "auto") parts.push(diff === "Easy" ? "Kolay" : diff === "Medium" ? "Orta" : "Zor");
  if (parts.length > 0) intro += `\n📌 ${parts.join(" · ")}`;
  return intro;
}

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\chatbot\chatFlows.js

// ─── LifeQuest Chatbot Flow Engine ───────────────────────────────────────────
// Her "node" bir ekran durumunu temsil eder.
// type: "message" | "options" | "api_call" | "dynamic"
// options içindeki her buton { label, icon, nextNode, action? } içerir.

export const FLOWS = {

  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  //  ANA MENÜ
  // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  main_menu: {
    id: "main_menu",
    type: "options",
    message: "Merhaba! 👋 Ben LifeQuest asistanın. Sana nasıl yardımcı olabilirim?",
    options: [

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\components\onboarding\StepGoals.jsx
