import React from 'react';

const FOCUS_AREAS = [
  { value: 'health',       label: 'Sağlık & Spor',    emoji: '💪', sub: 'Egzersiz, uyku, beslenme' },
  { value: 'career',       label: 'Kariyer & İş',     emoji: '🚀', sub: 'Beceri, networking, verimlilik' },
  { value: 'education',    label: 'Öğrenme',          emoji: '🎓', sub: 'Okuma, kurslar, yeni beceriler' },
  { value: 'social',       label: 'İlişkiler',        emoji: '🤝', sub: 'Aile, arkadaşlar, sosyal hayat' },
  { value: 'mindfulness',  label: 'Zihinsel Sağlık',  emoji: '🧘', sub: 'Meditasyon, stres yönetimi' },
  { value: 'finance',      label: 'Finans',           emoji: '💰', sub: 'Tasarruf, bütçe, yatırım' },
];

const StepGoals = ({ answers, onChange, onNext, onBack }) => {
  const toggleSecondary = (v) => {
    if (v === answers.primaryFocusArea) return;
    const cur = answers.secondaryGoals || [];
    const next = cur.includes(v)
      ? cur.filter(x => x !== v)
      : cur.length < 2 ? [...cur, v] : cur;
    onChange({ secondaryGoals: next });
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="step-title">Ne üzerinde çalışmak istiyorsun? 🎯</div>
      <div className="step-subtitle">Ana odak alanın öncelikli görevleri belirler.</div>

      <label style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)', fontSize: '0.85rem', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
        En çok neyi geliştirmek istiyorsun?
      </label>
      <div className="option-cards">
        {FOCUS_AREAS.map(opt => (
          <div
            key={opt.value}
            className={`option-card ${answers.primaryFocusArea === opt.value ? 'selected' : ''}`}
            onClick={() => onChange({ primaryFocusArea: opt.value })}
          >
            <span className="card-emoji">{opt.emoji}</span>
            <div className="card-label">{opt.label}</div>
            <div className="card-sub">{opt.sub}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {answers.primaryFocusArea && (
        <>
          <label style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.65)', fontSize: '0.85rem', display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>
            Bunlar dışında neler var? (Opsiyonel, max 2)
          </label>
          <div className="chips-grid">
            {FOCUS_AREAS
              .filter(f => f.value !== answers.primaryFocusArea)
              .map(f => (
                <div
                  key={f.value}
                  className={`chip ${answers.secondaryGoals?.includes(f.value) ? 'active' : ''}`}
                  onClick={() => toggleSecondary(f.value)}
                >
                  {f.emoji} {f.label}
                </div>
              ))}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <div className="step-actions">
        <button className="btn-secondary" onClick={onBack}>← Geri</button>
        <button className="btn-primary" onClick={onNext} disabled={!answers.primaryFocusArea}>
          Devam →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StepGoals;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const AVATARS = ['🦁','🐯','🦊','🐺','🦅','🦋','🐉','🦄','🐬','🦈','🐸','🐼','🐻','🦝','🐮','🐧','🦩','🐙','🦕','🤖'];

const FOCUS_LABELS = {
  health: '💪 Sağlık & Spor',
  career: '🚀 Kariyer & İş',
  education: '🎓 Öğrenme',
  social: '🤝 İlişkiler',
  mindfulness: '🧘 Zihinsel Sağlık',
  finance: '💰 Finans',
};

const StepSummary = ({ answers, result, onFinish }) => {
  const [confetti, setConfetti] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Konfeti animasyonu
    const items = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => ({
      id: i,
      left: `${Math.random() * 100}%`,
      delay: `${Math.random() * 2}s`,
      duration: `${1.5 + Math.random() * 2}s`,
      color: ['#7c3aed','#06b6d4','#10b981','#f59e0b','#ef4444'][i % 5]
    }));
    setConfetti(items);
  }, []);

  const avatar = AVATARS[(answers.avatarId || 1) - 1];
  const dailyLimit = result?.dailyTaskLimit || Math.max(1, Math.floor((answers.preferredTasksPerWeek || 5) / 7));

  return (
    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
      {/* Konfeti */}
      <div style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, width: '100%', height: '100%', pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
        {confetti.map(c => (
          <div
            key={c.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: c.left,
              top: '-10px',
              width: '8px', height: '8px',
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: c.color,
              animation: `fall ${c.duration} ${c.delay} ease-in forwards`
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <style>{`
        @keyframes fall {
          to { transform: translateY(400px) rotate(720deg); opacity: 0; }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div style={{ fontSize: '4rem', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>{avatar}</div>
      <div className="step-title" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>Hazırsın! 🎉</div>
      <div className="step-subtitle" style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
        Merhaba, <strong style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{answers.displayName || 'Kahraman'}</strong>! Profiin oluşturuldu.
      </div>

      {/* Özet Kartlar */}
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'left', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">🎯</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Odak Alanın</h4>
            <p>{FOCUS_LABELS[answers.primaryFocusArea] || answers.primaryFocusArea || 'Genel'}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">📋</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Günlük Görev Limitin</h4>
            <p>Günde {dailyLimit} görev, haftada {answers.preferredTasksPerWeek || 5} görev hedefi</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="summary-card">
          <div className="summary-icon">🔥</div>
          <div className="summary-info">
            <h4>Streak Başladı!</h4>
            <p>1. Gün • Devam et!</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {result?.firstTaskTitle && (
          <div className="summary-card">
            <div className="summary-icon">✅</div>
            <div className="summary-info">
              <h4>İlk Görev Hazır</h4>
              <p>{result.firstTaskTitle}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <button className="btn-primary" style={{ width: '100%', fontSize: '1rem', padding: '1rem' }} onClick={onFinish}>
        🚀 Hadi Başlayalım!
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default StepSummary;

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";

const AuthContext = createContext();

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const storedUser = sessionStorage.getItem("user_data");

    if (storedUser) {
      setUser(JSON.parse(storedUser));
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  const login = (userData) => {
    sessionStorage.setItem("user_data", JSON.stringify(userData));
    setUser(userData);
    navigate("/dashboard");
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      // Import and call API to clear cookies
      const axiosClient = (await import("../api/axiosClient")).default;
      await axiosClient.post("/Auth/revoke");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Logout API failed", err);
    }
    sessionStorage.removeItem("user_data");
    setUser(null);
    navigate("/login");
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, logout, loading }}>
      {!loading && children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\context\SignalRContext.jsx

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { HubConnectionBuilder, LogLevel, HttpTransportType } from '@microsoft/signalr';
import { useAuth } from './authContext';

const SignalRContext = createContext();

const HUB_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5020/api")
    .replace("/api", "") + "/hubs/notification";

export const SignalRProvider = ({ children }) => {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const connectionRef = useRef(null);
    const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!user) {
            if (connectionRef.current) {
                connectionRef.current.stop();
                connectionRef.current = null;
                setIsConnected(false);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (connectionRef.current) return; // Already connecting/connected

        const connection = new HubConnectionBuilder()
            .withUrl(HUB_URL, {
                withCredentials: true,
                transport: HttpTransportType.WebSockets | HttpTransportType.LongPolling,
            })
            .withAutomaticReconnect([0, 2000, 5000, 10000])
            .configureLogging(LogLevel.Warning)
            .build();

        connection.onreconnecting(() => setIsConnected(false));
        connection.onreconnected(() => setIsConnected(true));
        connection.onclose(() => setIsConnected(false));

        connection.start()
            .then(() => {
                console.info("[SignalR] Global connection established.");
                setIsConnected(true);
            })
            .catch(err => {
                console.error("[SignalR] Connection failed:", err);
                setIsConnected(false);
            });

        connectionRef.current = connection;

        return () => {
            if (connectionRef.current) {
                connectionRef.current.stop();
                connectionRef.current = null;
                setIsConnected(false);
            }
        };
    }, [user]);

    const on = (eventName, callback) => {
        if (connectionRef.current) {
            connectionRef.current.on(eventName, callback);
        }
    };

    const off = (eventName, callback) => {
        if (connectionRef.current) {
            connectionRef.current.off(eventName, callback);
        }
    };

    return (
        <SignalRContext.Provider value={{ connection: connectionRef.current, isConnected, on, off }}>
            {children}
        </SignalRContext.Provider>
    );
};

export const useSignalRContext = () => useContext(SignalRContext);

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\hooks\useSignalR.js

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useSignalRContext } from "../context/SignalRContext";

/**
 * useSignalR — LifeQuest gerçek zamanlı bildirim hook'u (v2 - Singleton Context tabanlı)
 */
export const useSignalR = ({ onNotification, onProactiveMessage } = {}) => {
    const { on, off } = useSignalRContext();

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleNotification = (notif) => {
            if (onNotification) onNotification(notif);
        };

        const handleProactive = (message) => {
            // Plan P2-T1: openChatBot custom event dispatch
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("openChatBot", { detail: message }));
            if (onProactiveMessage) onProactiveMessage(message);
        };

        on("ReceiveNotification", handleNotification);
        on("ReceiveProactiveMessage", handleProactive);

        return () => {
            off("ReceiveNotification", handleNotification);
            off("ReceiveProactiveMessage", handleProactive);
        };
    }, [onNotification, onProactiveMessage, on, off]);
};

export default useSignalR;

        {activeTab === "analytics" && <AdminAnalytics />}

        {activeTab === "json-seed" && (

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-white font-black italic uppercase text-lg tracking-widest">
                  🛠️ Tüm Verileri JSON ile Sıfırla & Doldur
                </h3>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">
                  Aşağıdaki JSON şablonunu dilediğiniz gibi düzenleyin. Gönderdiğinizde veritabanını isteğinize göre temizleyebilir veya mevcut verileri koruyarak üstüne ekleyebilirsiniz.
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-700 font-mono">
                Full Configuration Format
              </span>
            </div>

            <textarea
              value={jsonInput}
              onChange={(e) => setJsonInput(e.target.value)}
              className="flex-1 min-h-[350px] bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 text-emerald-400 font-mono text-xs outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition-colors relative z-10 resize-none mb-6"

        {activeTab !== "triggers" && activeTab !== "json-seed" && (

                Tekli{" "}
                {activeTab === "tasks"
                  ? "Görev"
                  : activeTab === "categories"
                  ? "Kategori"
                  : "Rozet"}{" "}
                Ekle

                  {activeTab === "tasks"
                    ? "Görev"
                    : activeTab === "categories"

                    : "Rozet"}{" "}

              <textarea
                value={jsonInput}
                onChange={(e) => setJsonInput(e.target.value)}
                className="flex-1 min-h-[400px] bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 text-emerald-400 font-mono text-xs outline-none focus:border-rose-500 transition-colors relative z-10 resize-none"
                placeholder={`[\n  { "name": "Örnek Veri", ... }\n]`}
              />

              <button

              >
                {loading
                  ? "YÜKLENİYOR..."
                  : `TOPLU ${activeTab.toUpperCase()} GÖNDER`}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default AdminPage;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import BadgeCard from "../components/BadgeCard";
import badgeService from "../services/badgeService";

const BadgeGallery = () => {
  const [badges, setBadges] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchBadges = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await badgeService.getBadgeGallery();
        setBadges(data);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Rozetler yüklenirken hata:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchBadges();
  }, []);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-10">
        <section>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">
            ROZETLER
          </h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)]"></div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 mt-4 font-medium italic">
            Başarılarını sergile ve yeni hedeflere odaklan.
          </p>
        </section>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8">
          {!loading ? (
            badges.length > 0 ? (
              badges.map((badge) => <BadgeCard key={badge.id} {...badge} />)
            ) : (
              <p className="text-slate-500 italic col-span-4 text-center">
                Henüz rozet tanımlanmamış.
              </p>
            )
          ) : (
            [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="h-64 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-3xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"
              ></div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default BadgeGallery;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\DailyTaskPage.jsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import DailyMoodSelector from '../components/DailyMoodSelector';
import TaskPoolSelector from '../components/TaskPoolSelector';
import { moodApi, taskPoolApi } from '../api/moodApi';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import '../styles/DailyTaskPage.css';

export default function DailyTaskPage() {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState('loading'); // loading | mood | pool
  const [poolData, setPoolData] = useState(null);
  const [poolLoading, setPoolLoading] = useState(false);

  // Sayfa açıldığında bugün zaten mood girildi mi kontrol et
  useEffect(() => {
    checkTodayMood();
  }, []);

  const checkTodayMood = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await moodApi.getTodayMood();
      if (res.data?.data) {
        // Bugün mood girilmiş — direkt pool'a geç
        await loadPool();
        setPhase('pool');
      } else {
        setPhase('mood');
      }
    } catch {
      setPhase('mood');
    }
  };

  const handleMoodRecorded = async () => {
    await loadPool();
    setPhase('pool');
  };

  const loadPool = async () => {
    setPoolLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await taskPoolApi.getDailyPool(6);
      setPoolData(res.data?.data || res.data || null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Pool yüklenemedi:', err);
    } finally {
      setPoolLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTaskSelect = async (task) => {
    try {
      await taskPoolApi.selectTask(task.userTaskId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Görev seçilemedi:', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="daily-task-page">
        {/* Page Header */}
        <div className="daily-task-page__header">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">🎯 Günlük Görevler</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm">Ruh haline göre kişiselleştirilmiş görevler</p>
          </div>
          {phase === 'pool' && (
            <button
              className="mood-reset-btn bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition-colors"
              onClick={() => setPhase('mood')}
            >
              😊 Moodunu Güncelle
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {phase === 'loading' && (
          <div className="daily-task-page__loading flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
            <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
            <p className="text-slate-400">Yükleniyor...</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {phase === 'mood' && (
          <DailyMoodSelector onMoodRecorded={handleMoodRecorded} />
        )}

        {phase === 'pool' && (
          poolLoading ? (
            <div className="daily-task-page__loading flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
              <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
              <p className="text-slate-400">Görevler hazırlanıyor...</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <TaskPoolSelector
              poolData={poolData}
              onTaskSelect={handleTaskSelect}
              onRefresh={loadPool}
            />
          )
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
}

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\DashBoard.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import CategoryCard from '../components/CategoryCard';
import categoryService from '../services/categoryService';
import userService from '../services/userService';
import { moodApi } from '../api/moodApi';
import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';
import { getUserIdFromToken } from '../utils/authUtils';
import { toast, ToastContainer } from 'react-toastify';
import 'react-toastify/dist/ReactToastify.css';
import useSignalR from '../hooks/useSignalR';


const DashBoard = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [recentActivities, setRecentActivities] = useState([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    streak: [],
    streakCount: 0,
    totalCompleted: 0,
    weeklyGrowth: 0
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [motivation, setMotivation] = useState("Günlük motivasyon yükleniyor...");
  const [todayMood, setTodayMood] = useState(null);
  const [showMoodModal, setShowMoodModal] = useState(false);
  const [taskToAccept, setTaskToAccept] = useState(null);
  const [showTaskModal, setShowTaskModal] = useState(false);

  // SP-03: useSignalR hook ile proaktif nudge dinleme
  useSignalR({
    onNotification: (notif) => {
      if (notif?.type === 'ProactiveNudge') {
        toast(
          <div>
            <p className="font-bold text-sm mb-1">LifeQuest AI 🤖</p>
            <p className="text-xs">{notif.message}</p>
          </div>,
          {
            autoClose: 8000,
            className: 'bg-slate-800 border border-indigo-500/40 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl',
            progressClassName: 'bg-indigo-500',
            onClick: () => {
              window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('openChatBot', { detail: { message: notif.message } }));
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
      try {
        try {
          const catsRes = await categoryService.getAllCategories();
          setCategories(Array.isArray(catsRes) ? catsRes : (catsRes?.categories || []));
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Kategoriler hatası:", err);
        }

        try {
          const actsRes = await userService.getActivities();
          const activitiesList = actsRes.activities || actsRes.Activities || actsRes || [];
          setRecentActivities(Array.isArray(activitiesList) ? activitiesList : []);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Aktiviteler hatası:", err);
          setRecentActivities([]);
        }

        try {
          const statsRes = await userService.getUserStats();
          setStats(statsRes || { streak: [], streakCount: 0, totalCompleted: 0, weeklyGrowth: 0 });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("İstatistik hatası:", err);
        }

        // AI Motivasyon Çekme
        try {
          const aiResponse = await axiosClient.post('/chat/send', { 
            message: "Beni motive et" 
          });
          if (aiResponse.data && aiResponse.data.response) {
            setMotivation(aiResponse.data.response);
          } else {
             setMotivation("Bugün hedeflerine ulaşmak için harika bir gün! Küçük adımlar büyük sonuçlar getirir.");
          }
        } catch (err) {
          setMotivation("Bugün hedeflerine ulaşmak için harika bir gün! Küçük adımlar büyük sonuçlar getirir.");
        }

        // Mood Check
        try {
          const moodRes = await moodApi.getTodayMood();
          if (moodRes.data?.data) {
            setTodayMood(moodRes.data.data);
          } else {
            setShowMoodModal(true);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          setShowMoodModal(true);
        }

      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Genel Dashboard hatası:", error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchDashboardData();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAcceptTask = async () => {
      const acceptTask = sessionStorage.getItem("acceptTask");
      if (acceptTask) {
        try {
          const res = await axiosClient.get("/tasks/getall");
          const allTasks = res.data?.tasks || res.data?.Tasks || res.data || [];
          const matchingTask = allTasks.find(t => t.id === acceptTask);
          if (matchingTask) {
            setTaskToAccept(matchingTask);
            setShowTaskModal(true);
          } else {
            sessionStorage.removeItem("acceptTask");
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Görev detayları yüklenirken hata:", err);
          sessionStorage.removeItem("acceptTask");
        }
      }
    };
    checkAcceptTask();
  }, []);

  const handleAcceptTask = async () => {
    if (!taskToAccept) return;
    try {
      await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/assign/${taskToAccept.id}`);
      toast.success("Görev başarıyla kabul edildi ve havuzunuza eklendi! 🎉");
      sessionStorage.removeItem("acceptTask");
      setShowTaskModal(false);
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error(err.response?.data?.message || "Görev kabul edilirken bir hata oluştu.");
    }
  };

  const handleDeclineTask = () => {
    sessionStorage.removeItem("acceptTask");
    setShowTaskModal(false);
    toast.info("Görev paylaşımı reddedildi.");
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8">
        <section className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-6">
          <div>
            <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-indigo-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full pointer-events-none"></div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">DASHBOARD</h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.6)]"></div>
          </div>
          
          {/* AI Motivasyon Widget */}
          <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-900/50 to-violet-900/50 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-4 max-w-md shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm relative overflow-hidden group">
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-indigo-500/10 blur-3xl rounded-full group-hover:bg-indigo-500/20 transition-all"></div>
            <div className="text-3xl relative z-10 animate-bounce">🤖</div>
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-indigo-300 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Yapay Zeka Asistanı</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 leading-tight italic">"{motivation}"</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Günlük Özet Bar */}
        {todayMood && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-6 mb-4 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-indigo-600/20 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-inner">
                {todayMood.moodMode === 0 ? '⚡' : todayMood.moodMode === 1 ? '😊' : todayMood.moodMode === 2 ? '😴' : todayMood.moodMode === 3 ? '😰' : '⏰'}
              </div>
              <div>

              categories.map((cat) => (

          </div>
        </section>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            
            <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 hover:border-indigo-500/30 transition-all duration-500 group relative">
               <p className="text-slate-500 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Haftalık Seri</p>
               <p className="text-5xl font-black text-white group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform origin-left">
                 {stats.streakCount} GÜN
               </p>
               <div className="mt-4 flex gap-1 h-2">
                 {stats.streak && stats.streak.length > 0 ? stats.streak.map((isActive, i) => (
                   <div key={i} className={`h-full w-full rounded-full transition-all ${isActive ? 'bg-indigo-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)]' : 'bg-slate-800'}`}></div>
                 )) : (
                   <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600">Veri yok</span>
                 )}
               </div>
            </div>
            
            <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 hover:border-emerald-500/30 transition-all duration-500 group">
               <p className="text-slate-500 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Biten Görevler</p>
               <p className="text-5xl font-black text-white group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform origin-left">
                 {stats.totalCompleted}
               </p>
               <p className="text-emerald-500 text-[10px] mt-4 font-black uppercase tracking-tighter">
                 Bu hafta %{stats.weeklyGrowth} artış
               </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 p-8 rounded-[2rem] border border-slate-800 backdrop-blur-sm">
            <h3 className="text-white font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-widest mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 bg-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-pulse"></span>
              Son Aktiviteler
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              {loading ? (
                 <div className="space-y-4">
                   {[1,2,3].map(i => <div key={i} className="h-10 bg-slate-900/40 animate-pulse rounded-lg"></div>)}
                 </div>
              ) : recentActivities.length > 0 ? (
                recentActivities.map((act) => (
                  <div key={act.id} className="flex gap-4 relative group">
                    <div className="w-[2px] bg-slate-800 absolute left-[11px] top-8 bottom-[-24px] group-last:hidden"></div>

                      act.type === 'TASK' ? 'bg-indigo-600' : act.type === 'BADGE' ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'
                    }`}>
                      {act.type === 'TASK' ? '✓' : act.type === 'BADGE' ? '🏆' : '⭐'}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">{act.text}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">{act.time}</span>
                        {act.xp && <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-black">{act.xp}</span>}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                 <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs italic">Henüz aktivite kaydı yok.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {/* SP-03: Nudge toast bildirimleri */}
      <ToastContainer
        position="bottom-right"
        theme="dark"
        toastClassName="!rounded-2xl !shadow-2xl"
        progressClassName="!bg-indigo-500"
      />

      {/* Mood Modal */}
      {showMoodModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative">
            <button 
              onClick={() => setShowMoodModal(false)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-slate-500 hover:text-white transition-colors p-2"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
            <div className="p-6">
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white mb-2">Güne Hazır Mısın?</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">Sana en uygun görevleri önerebilmemiz için bugünkü durumunu paylaş.</p>
              <button 
                onClick={() => navigate('/task-pool')}
                className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-colors"
              >
                Durumunu Belirle & Görevleri Al
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Görev Kabul/Red Etme Modalı */}
      {showTaskModal && taskToAccept && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900/90 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(79,70,229,0.2)] p-6 relative">
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600/20 border border-indigo-500/40 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-inner mb-4 animate-pulse">
                ✉️
              </div>
              <p className="text-indigo-400 font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">GÖREV PAYLAŞIMI ALDINIZ</p>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter uppercase mb-2">{taskToAccept.title}</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm">{taskToAccept.description}</p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-800/40 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-800 mb-6 flex justify-around text-center">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Zorluk</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-200">{taskToAccept.difficulty}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="border-l border-slate-700 pl-4 h-full"></div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Ödül</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-400">{taskToAccept.baseXP || taskToAccept.baseXp} XP</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <button 
                onClick={handleDeclineTask}
                className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-600 text-slate-300 py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-black tracking-wider text-xs uppercase transition-all duration-300"
              >
                Reddet
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={handleAcceptTask}
                className="flex-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 hover:from-indigo-500 hover:to-violet-500 text-white py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-black tracking-wider text-xs uppercase shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_4px_25px_rgba(79,70,229,0.6)] transition-all duration-300"
              >
                Kabul Et
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default DashBoard;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\ForgotPasswordPage.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import authService from "../services/authService";

const ForgotPasswordPage = () => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setMessage("");
    setError("");

    try {
      const res = await authService.forgotPassword(email);
      if (res.isSuccess || res.success) {
        setMessage("🎉 Şifre sıfırlama bağlantısı e-posta adresinize gönderildi! Lütfen gelen kutunuzu kontrol edin.");
      } else {
        setError(res.message || "Şifre sıfırlama işlemi başarısız.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError(err.response?.data?.message || "Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar deneyin.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative overflow-hidden bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-indigo-900/20 via-slate-950 to-slate-950">
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-600/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-rose-600/10 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>

      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl relative z-10">
        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)] mb-4 text-white">
            🔑
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter uppercase italic">
            ŞİFREMİ UNUTTUM
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-2 font-medium">
            Şifreni yenilemek için e-postanı gir.
          </p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
          {error && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-500 text-xs font-bold text-center">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {message && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-xl text-emerald-500 text-xs font-bold text-center">
              {message}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
              E-Posta Adresi
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              placeholder="kullanici@lifequest.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] transition-all active:scale-[0.98] uppercase tracking-widest"
          >
            {loading ? "GÖNDERİLİYOR..." : "SIFIRLAMA LİNKİ GÖNDER"}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-8 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">
            Şifreni hatırladın mı?{" "}
            <Link
              to="/login"
              className="text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
            >
              Giriş Yap
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ForgotPasswordPage;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import goalService from '../services/goalService';
import GoalCard from '../components/GoalCard';

const GOAL_TYPES = [
  { value: 0, label: 'Genel', emoji: '⭐' },
  { value: 1, label: 'Haftalık', emoji: '📅' },
  { value: 2, label: 'Aylık', emoji: '🗓️' },
  { value: 3, label: 'Proje', emoji: '🚀' },
];

const ICONS = ['🎯', '💪', '📚', '🧘', '🏃', '💰', '🎨', '🤝', '🌱', '⚡', '🏋️', '🎓'];
const COLORS = ['#7c3aed', '#0ea5e9', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6', '#06b6d4'];

const GoalsPage = () => {
  const [dashboard, setDashboard] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('active');
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [newGoal, setNewGoal] = useState({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    type: 0,
    targetValue: 30,
    bonusXP: 100,
    icon: '🎯',
    color: '#7c3aed',
    why: '',
    progressUnit: 'görev',
    autoTrackByCategory: false,
    autoTrackByXP: false,
    reminderEnabled: true,
    reminderFrequency: 'daily',
    startDate: new Date().toISOString(),
    endDate: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString(),
    durationDays: 30,
  });

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const data = await goalService.getGoalDashboard();
      setDashboard(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Dashboard alınamadı:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { fetchDashboard(); }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const handleCreateGoal = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const endDate = new Date(Date.now() + newGoal.durationDays * 86400000).toISOString();
      await goalService.createGoal({ ...newGoal, endDate });
      setShowModal(false);
      fetchDashboard();
      setNewGoal(prev => ({ ...prev, title: '', description: '', why: '' }));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Hedef oluşturulamadı:', err);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'active', label: 'Aktif', count: dashboard?.totalActiveGoals || 0, color: '#7c3aed' },
    { id: 'completed', label: 'Tamamlanan', count: dashboard?.totalCompletedThisMonth || 0, color: '#10b981' },
    { id: 'archived', label: 'Arşiv', count: dashboard?.archivedGoals?.length || 0, color: '#64748b' },
  ];

  const goalList = activeTab === 'active'
    ? dashboard?.activeGoals || []
    : activeTab === 'completed'
    ? dashboard?.completedGoals || []
    : dashboard?.archivedGoals || [];

  const lagGoals = dashboard?.activeGoals?.filter(g => g.isOnLag) || [];

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-end">
          <section className="relative">
            <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-teal-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full pointer-events-none"></div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">HEDEFLER</h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-teal-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(13,148,136,0.6)]"></div>
          </section>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
            className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)]"
          >
            + Yeni Hedef
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Lag uyarısı */}
        {lagGoals.length > 0 && (
          <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-2xl">⚠️</span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm">{lagGoals.length} hedef geride kalıyor</div>
              <div className="text-amber-400/60 text-xs mt-0.5">
                {lagGoals.map(g => g.title).join(', ')} — biraz daha ilerleme gerekiyor!
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {tabs.map(tab => (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all relative z-20 cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === tab.id
                  ? 'text-white shadow-lg'
                  : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800'
              }`}
              style={activeTab === tab.id ? { background: `${tab.color}cc` } : {}}
            >
              {tab.label}
              {tab.count > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1.5 text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black"
                  style={{ background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' }}>
                  {tab.count}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-32 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : goalList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🎯</p>
            <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">
              {activeTab === 'active' ? 'Aktif hedef yok.' : activeTab === 'completed' ? 'Bu ay tamamlanan yok.' : 'Arşivlenmiş hedef yok.'}
            </p>
            {activeTab === 'active' && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowModal(true)}
                className="mt-4 px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold text-sm hover:bg-indigo-500 transition-all"
              >
                İlk Hedefini Oluştur →
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {goalList.map(goal => (
              <GoalCard key={goal.id} goal={goal} onUpdate={fetchDashboard} />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Hedef Oluştur Modal */}
      {showModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 p-8 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg shadow-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
              <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Yeni Hedef</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowModal(false)} className="text-slate-500 hover:text-white text-xl">✕</button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreateGoal} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Icon + Color seçici */}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block">İkon</label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {ICONS.map(ic => (
                      <button
                        type="button" key={ic}
                        className={`text-xl w-9 h-9 rounded-lg transition-all ${newGoal.icon === ic ? 'bg-indigo-600/40 ring-2 ring-indigo-500' : 'bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700'}`}
                        onClick={() => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, icon: ic }))}
                      >{ic}</button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block">Renk</label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {COLORS.map(c => (
                      <button
                        type="button" key={c}
                        className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full transition-all ${newGoal.color === c ? 'ring-2 ring-white scale-110' : 'opacity-70 hover:opacity-100'}`}
                        style={{ background: c }}
                        onClick={() => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, color: c }))}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Başlığı *</label>
                <input required type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                  placeholder="Örn: 30 Günde 30 Kitap"
                  value={newGoal.title} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, title: e.target.value }))} />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Neden yapıyorum? (Motivasyon)</label>
                <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                  placeholder="Bu hedef benim için ne ifade ediyor?"
                  value={newGoal.why} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, why: e.target.value }))} />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Değer</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    value={newGoal.targetValue} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, targetValue: parseInt(e.target.value) }))} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Birim</label>
                  <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    placeholder="görev, km, sayfa..." 
                    value={newGoal.progressUnit} onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, progressUnit: e.target.value }))} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Süre (Gün)</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="365" className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-none rounded-xl text-white p-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 outline-none text-sm"
                    value={newGoal.durationDays}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, durationDays: parseInt(e.target.value) }))} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Otomatik takip */}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.autoTrackByCategory}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, autoTrackByCategory: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">Kategori ile takip</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.autoTrackByXP}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, autoTrackByXP: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">XP ile takip</span>
                </label>
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="checkbox" className="w-4 h-4 accent-indigo-600"
                    checked={newGoal.reminderEnabled}
                    onChange={e => setNewGoal(p => ({ ...p, reminderEnabled: e.target.checked }))} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">Hatırlatma</span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm">
                  İptal
                </button>
                <button type="submit" disabled={submitting}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold bg-teal-600 text-white hover:bg-teal-500 shadow-lg shadow-teal-900/50 text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50">
                  {submitting ? '⏳ Oluşturuluyor...' : '✨ Hedefi Oluştur'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default GoalsPage;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import leaderboardService from '../services/leaderboardService';
import { getUserIdFromToken } from '../utils/authUtils';

const RANK_COLORS = [
  'from-amber-400 to-yellow-500',   // 1st
  'from-slate-300 to-slate-400',    // 2nd
  'from-amber-600 to-orange-700',   // 3rd
];

const RANK_ICONS = ['👑', '🥈', '🥉'];
const RANK_BORDER = ['border-amber-400/50 shadow-amber-500/20', 'border-slate-400/50 shadow-slate-400/10', 'border-amber-600/50 shadow-orange-700/10'];

const LeaderboardPage = () => {
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [myRank, setMyRank] = useState(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('global'); // 'global' | 'friends'
  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = useState('alltime'); // 'alltime' | 'weekly' | 'monthly'
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalCount, setTotalCount] = useState(0);
  const currentUserId = getUserIdFromToken?.() || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchLeaderboard = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const response = await leaderboardService.getLeaderboard(page, 20, filter, timeRange);
        const list = response.leaderboard || [];
        setLeaderboard(list);
        setTotalCount(response.totalCount || 0);
        
        // Find current user's rank
        const userData = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('user_data') || '{}');
        const myEntryIndex = list.findIndex(u => u.userName === userData?.userName);
        if (myEntryIndex >= 0) {
          setMyRank((page - 1) * 20 + myEntryIndex + 1);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    fetchLeaderboard();
  }, [page, filter, timeRange]);

  const top3 = leaderboard.slice(0, 3);
  const rest = leaderboard.slice(3);

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      <div className="space-y-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative">
          <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-amber-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">SIRALAMALAR</h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-amber-500 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.6)]"></div>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-2">En yüksek XP'ye sahip oyuncular</p>
          
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 mt-6">
            <div className="flex bg-slate-900/60 p-1 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
              <button 
                onClick={() => { setFilter('global'); setPage(1); }}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-black tracking-widest transition-all ${filter === 'global' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300'}`}
              >
                🌍 KÜRESEL
              </button>
              <button 
                onClick={() => { setFilter('friends'); setPage(1); }}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-black tracking-widest transition-all ${filter === 'friends' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300'}`}
              >
                🤝 ARKADAŞLAR
              </button>
            </div>

            <select 
              value={timeRange} 
              onChange={(e) => { setTimeRange(e.target.value); setPage(1); }}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl px-4 py-2 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 transition-colors"
            >
              <option value="alltime">Tüm Zamanlar</option>
              <option value="weekly">Bu Hafta</option>
              <option value="monthly">Bu Ay</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </section>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {[1,2,3,4,5].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-16 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"></div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Top 3 Podium */}
            {top3.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-4">
                {/* 2nd place */}
                <div className={`order-1 mt-8 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[1]} shadow-lg`}>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2">{RANK_ICONS[1]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[1]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg mb-3`}>
                    {top3[1]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[1]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">{top3[1]?.name} {top3[1]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[1]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm mt-2">{top3[1]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[1]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>

                {/* 1st place */}
                <div className={`order-2 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[0]} shadow-2xl relative`}>
                  <div className="absolute -top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-amber-500 text-black text-xs font-black px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-lg">1. SIRALAMASINDA</div>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2 mt-4">{RANK_ICONS[0]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[0]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-black text-xl shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/30 mb-3`}>
                    {top3[0]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[0]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold truncate">{top3[0]?.name} {top3[0]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[0]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black mt-2">{top3[0]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[0]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>

                {/* 3rd place */}
                <div className={`order-3 mt-12 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-2xl border p-4 text-center ${RANK_BORDER[2]} shadow-lg`}>
                  <div className="text-3xl mb-2">{RANK_ICONS[2]}</div>
                  <div className={`w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br ${RANK_COLORS[2]} flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg mb-3`}>
                    {top3[2]?.name?.charAt(0)}{top3[2]?.surname?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">{top3[2]?.name} {top3[2]?.surname}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{top3[2]?.userName}</p>
                  <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm mt-2">{top3[2]?.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {top3[2]?.generalLevel}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Rest of leaderboard */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {rest.map((user, idx) => {
                const rank = idx + 4;
                return (
                  <div key={user.userName} className={`flex items-center gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    rank === myRank
                      ? 'border-indigo-500/50 bg-indigo-500/10 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/10'
                      : 'border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/40 hover:border-slate-700'
                  }`}>
                    <div className="w-8 text-center">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 font-black text-sm">{rank}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-violet-600 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-sm">
                      {user.name?.charAt(0)}{user.surname?.charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm truncate">
                        {user.name} {user.surname}
                        {rank === myRank && <span className="ml-2 text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-black">(Sen)</span>}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{user.userName}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-amber-400 font-black text-sm">{user.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</p>
                      <p className="text-slate-600 text-xs">Lv. {user.generalLevel}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {leaderboard.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-16 text-slate-500">
                <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🏆</p>
                <p className="font-bold">Sıralama verisi yok.</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Pagination */}
            {totalCount > 20 && (
              <div className="flex justify-center gap-4 mt-8">
                <button 
                  disabled={page === 1}
                  onClick={() => setPage(p => p - 1)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  Önceki
                </button>
                <span className="text-slate-500 flex items-center px-4 font-bold">Sayfa {page}</span>
                <button 
                  disabled={page * 20 >= totalCount}
                  onClick={() => setPage(p => p + 1)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-400 rounded-lg disabled:opacity-30"
                >
                  Sonraki
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default LeaderboardPage;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\LoginPage.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
import authService from "../services/authService";
import { useAuth } from "../context/authContext";
import { getUserNameFromToken } from "../utils/authUtils";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";

const LoginPage = () => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();

  const { login } = useAuth();

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await authService.login({ email, password });

      if (response && response.isSuccess) {
        const userData = {
          userId: response.userId,
          userName: response.userName,
          role: response.role
        };
        sessionStorage.setItem("user_data", JSON.stringify(userData));

        const acceptTask = searchParams.get("acceptTask");
        if (acceptTask) {
          sessionStorage.setItem("acceptTask", acceptTask);
        }

        // We pass userData to the context login method
        login(userData);
      } else {
        setError("Beklenmedik bir sunucu yanıtı alındı.");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setError("Giriş başarısız! E-posta veya şifre hatalı olabilir.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-indigo-900/20 via-slate-950 to-slate-950">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md">
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
          <div className="inline-flex w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600 rounded-2xl items-center justify-center font-black text-3xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] mb-4 text-white">
            LQ
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter">
            LIFEQUEST
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium mt-2 italic">
            Maceraya devam etmek için giriş yap.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[2.5rem] backdrop-blur-sm shadow-2xl">
          <form className="space-y-6" onSubmit={handleLogin}>
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-500 text-xs font-bold text-center">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
                E-Posta Adresi
              </label>
              <input
                type="email"
                placeholder="admin@lifequest.com"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 ml-1">
                Şifre
              </label>
              <input
                type="password"
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-800/50 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] transition-all active:scale-[0.98] uppercase tracking-widest"
            >
              Giriş Yap
            </button>
          </form>

          <div className="mt-8 text-center space-y-2">
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">
              Hesabın yok mu?{" "}
              <Link
                to="/register"
                className="text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
              >
                Hemen Kaydol
              </Link>
            </p>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">
              <Link
                to="/forgot-password"
                className="text-slate-400 font-semibold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
              >
                Şifremi Unuttum
              </Link>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default LoginPage;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { onboardingService } from '../services/onboardingService';
import StepWelcome from '../components/onboarding/StepWelcome';
import StepLifestyle from '../components/onboarding/StepLifestyle';
import StepGoals from '../components/onboarding/StepGoals';
import StepCapacity from '../components/onboarding/StepCapacity';
import StepMotivation from '../components/onboarding/StepMotivation';
import StepDifficulty from '../components/onboarding/StepDifficulty';
import StepFirstTask from '../components/onboarding/StepFirstTask';
import StepSummary from '../components/onboarding/StepSummary';
import './OnboardingPage.css';

const TOTAL_STEPS = 8;

const OnboardingPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState({
    displayName: '',
    avatarId: 1,
    lifestyleType: '',
    wakeUpTime: '07:00',
    workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    primaryFocusArea: '',
    secondaryGoals: [],
    dailyAvailableMinutes: 30,
    preferredTaskDuration: 'short_15',
    preferredTasksPerWeek: 5,
    motivationFactor: '',
    motivationKillers: [],
    difficultyPreference: 'medium',
    ageRange: '25-34'
  });

  const updateAnswers = (updates) => setAnswers(prev => ({ ...prev, ...updates }));

  const next = () => setStep(s => Math.min(s + 1, TOTAL_STEPS));
  const prev = () => setStep(s => Math.max(s - 1, 1));

  const handleComplete = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await onboardingService.completeOnboarding(answers);
      setResult(response);
      setStep(8);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Onboarding tamamlanırken hata:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const goToDashboard = () => navigate('/dashboard');

  const progressPct = Math.round((step / TOTAL_STEPS) * 100);

  return (
    <div className="onboarding-page">
      <div className="onboarding-container">
        {/* Progress Bar */}
        <div className="onboarding-progress">
          <div className="progress-header">
            <span className="progress-step">Adım {step} / {TOTAL_STEPS}</span>
            <span className="progress-pct">{progressPct}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="progress-track">
            <div className="progress-fill" style={{ width: `${progressPct}%` }} />
          </div>
          <div className="step-dots">
            {Array.from({ length: TOTAL_STEPS }, (_, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className={`step-dot ${i + 1 < step ? 'done' : ''} ${i + 1 === step ? 'active' : ''}`}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Adım İçeriği */}
        <div className="step-content">
          {step === 1 && (
            <StepWelcome answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} />
          )}
          {step === 2 && (
            <StepLifestyle answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 3 && (
            <StepGoals answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 4 && (
            <StepCapacity answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 5 && (
            <StepMotivation answers={answers} onChange={updateAnswers} onNext={next} onBack={prev} />
          )}
          {step === 6 && (
            <StepDifficulty
              answers={answers}
              onChange={updateAnswers}
              onNext={handleComplete}
              onBack={prev}
              loading={loading}
            />
          )}
          {step === 7 && (
            <StepFirstTask result={result} onNext={next} onSkip={goToDashboard} />
          )}
          {step === 8 && (
            <StepSummary answers={answers} result={result} onFinish={goToDashboard} />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default OnboardingPage;
