import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import MainLayout from '../layouts/MainLayout';
import socialService from '../services/socialService';
import ChallengeCard from '../components/ChallengeCard';
import { challengeService } from '../services/challengeService';
import categoryService from '../services/categoryService';
import useSignalR from '../hooks/useSignalR';

const tabs = ['Arkadaşlarım', 'İstekler', 'Mücadeleler', 'Kullanıcı Ara', 'Engellenenler'];
const CHALLENGE_STATUS_TABS = ['active', 'invited', 'completed'];

const SocialPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(0);
  const [challengeStatus, setChallengeStatus] = useState('active');
  const [friends, setFriends] = useState([]);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [challenges, setChallenges] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [blockedUsers, setBlockedUsers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [showChallengeModal, setShowChallengeModal] = useState(false);
  const [challengeTarget, setChallengeTarget] = useState(null);
  const [challengeForm, setChallengeForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    challengeType: 'TaskCount',
    targetValue: 10,
    durationDays: 7,
    challengerMessage: '',
    targetCategoryId: '',
  });

  // Real-time challenge updates
  useSignalR({
    onNotification: (notif) => {
      if (notif?.type === 'ChallengeProgressUpdated' || notif?.type === 'ChallengeCompleted') {
        fetchChallenges();
      }
    }
  });


  const showToast = (message, type = 'success') => {
    setToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Ayrıştırılmış hata yönetimi: Bir servis çökerse diğerleri çalışmaya devam etsin
      const safeFetch = async (fn, setter, defaultValue = []) => {
        try {
          const res = await fn();
          setter(res);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error(`Fetch error:`, err);
          setter(defaultValue);
        }
      };

      await Promise.all([
        safeFetch(socialService.getFriends, setFriends),
        safeFetch(socialService.getFriendRequests, setRequests),
        safeFetch(categoryService.getAllCategories, setCategories),
        safeFetch(socialService.getBlockedUsers, setBlockedUsers)
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("General fetch error", err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchChallenges = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await challengeService.getActiveChallenges(challengeStatus);
      setChallenges(result?.challenges || result || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  }, [challengeStatus]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeTab === 2) fetchChallenges();
  }, [fetchChallenges, activeTab, challengeStatus]);

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (searchQuery.length < 2) return;
    setSearching(true);
    try {
      const results = await socialService.searchUsers(searchQuery);
      setSearchResults(results);
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('Arama sırasında hata oluştu.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendRequest = async (userId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.sendFriendRequest(userId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlık isteği gönderildi! 🤝');
      setSearchResults(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== userId));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.message || 'İstek gönderilemedi.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleAccept = async (requestId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.acceptFriendRequest(requestId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlık isteği kabul edildi! 🎉');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (requestId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.rejectFriendRequest(requestId);
      showToast('İstek reddedildi.');
      setRequests(prev => prev.filter(r => r.requestId !== requestId));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveFriend = async (friendshipId) => {
    if (!confirm('Arkadaşını listeden çıkarmak istediğine emin misin?')) return;
    try {
      await socialService.removeFriend(friendshipId);
      showToast('Arkadaşlıktan çıkarıldı.');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleBlock = async (userId) => {
    if (!confirm('Bu kullanıcıyı engellemek istediğine emin misin? Arkadaşlıktan çıkarılacak ve sana ulaşamayacak.')) return;
    try {
      await socialService.blockUser(userId);
      showToast('Kullanıcı engellendi.');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleUnblock = async (userId) => {
    try {
      await socialService.unblockUser(userId);
      showToast('Engel kaldırıldı.');
      fetchData();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('İşlem başarısız.', 'error');
    }
  };

  const openChallengeModal = (friend) => {
    setChallengeTarget(friend);
    setShowChallengeModal(true);
  };

  const handleCreateChallenge = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await challengeService.sendInvite({
        opponentId: challengeTarget.friendId,
        title: challengeForm.title,
        challengeType: challengeForm.challengeType,
        targetValue: challengeForm.targetValue,
        durationDays: challengeForm.durationDays,
        challengerMessage: challengeForm.challengerMessage,
        targetCategoryId: challengeForm.challengeType === 'CategoryFocus' ? challengeForm.targetCategoryId : null,
      });
      showToast(`${challengeTarget.name}'e mücadele daveti gönderildi! ⚔️`);
      setShowChallengeModal(false);
      fetchChallenges();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Challenge error details:", err.response?.data);
      const errorMessage = err.response?.data?.message || err.response?.data?.Message || 'Mücadele oluşturulamadı.';
      showToast(errorMessage, 'error');
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      {/* Toast */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl ${
          toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white' : 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
        }`}>
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-8">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="relative">
          <div className="absolute -left-10 -top-10 w-40 h-40 bg-violet-600/10 blur-[80px] rounded-full"></div>
          <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2 relative z-10">SOSYAL</h2>
          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-violet-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(124,58,237,0.6)]"></div>
          <div className="flex gap-4 mt-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white">{friends.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Arkadaş</p>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-400">{requests.length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Bekleyen İstek</p>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/20 text-center">
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-rose-400">{challenges.filter(c => c.status === 'Active').length}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Aktif Mücadele</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
          {tabs.map((tab, i) => (
            <button
              key={tab}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(i)}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${
                activeTab === i
                  ? 'bg-violet-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-violet-500/30'
                  : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800'
              }`}
            >
              {tab}
              {i === 1 && requests.length > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1.5 bg-amber-500 text-black text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black">
                  {requests.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="h-24 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"></div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* ARKADAŞLARIM */}
            {activeTab === 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {friends.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="col-span-2 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🤝</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Henüz arkadaşın yok.</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm mt-1">Kullanıcı Ara sekmesinden arkadaş ekleyebilirsin!</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  friends.map((f) => (
                    <div key={f.friendshipId} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 hover:border-violet-500/40 transition-colors group flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 to-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg shadow-lg">
                          {f.name.charAt(0)}{f.surname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold">{f.name} {f.surname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{f.userName}</p>
                          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-indigo-400 font-bold">Lv. {f.level}</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-600">•</span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-bold">{f.totalXP?.toLocaleString()} XP</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => openChallengeModal(f)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          ⚔️ Mücadele
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleRemoveFriend(f.friendshipId)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          Çıkar
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleBlock(f.friendId)}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-black rounded-lg bg-slate-800/50 text-rose-500/50 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white transition-all uppercase"
                          title="Engelle"
                        >
                          🚫
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* BEKLEYEN İSTEKLER */}
            {activeTab === 1 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {requests.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">📬</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Bekleyen istek yok.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  requests.map((r) => (
                    <div key={r.requestId} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white text-lg">
                          {r.requesterName.charAt(0)}{r.requesterSurname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold">{r.requesterName} {r.requesterSurname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{r.requesterUserName} • Lv. {r.requesterLevel}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleAccept(r.requestId)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-500 transition-all uppercase shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20"
                        >
                          Kabul
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleReject(r.requestId)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black rounded-xl bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          Reddet
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* SP-05: MÜCADELELER */}
            {activeTab === 2 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* Status filter */}
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {[['active','Aktif'],['invited','Davetler'],['completed','Tamamlanan']].map(([s, l]) => (
                    <button key={s}
                      onClick={() => { setChallengeStatus(s); }}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all ${
                        challengeStatus === s
                          ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                          : 'bg-slate-900/60 text-slate-400 border border-slate-800 hover:text-white'
                      }`}>
                      {l}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {challenges.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">⚔️</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Henüz {challengeStatus === 'invited' ? 'bekleyen davet' : challengeStatus === 'completed' ? 'tamamlanan mücadele' : 'aktif mücadele'} yok.</p>
                    {challengeStatus === 'active' && <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm mt-1">Arkadaşlarına mücadele daveti gönder!</p>}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {challenges.map(c => (
                      <ChallengeCard key={c.id} challenge={c} onUpdate={fetchChallenges} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* KULLANICI ARA */}
            {activeTab === 3 && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={searchQuery}
                    onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
                    placeholder="İsim veya kullanıcı adı ara..."
                    className="flex-1 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-200 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-500 transition-colors placeholder:text-slate-600"
                  />
                  <button
                    onClick={handleSearch}
                    disabled={searching || searchQuery.length < 2}
                    className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-violet-600 hover:bg-violet-500 text-white font-bold text-sm transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                  >
                    {searching ? '...' : '🔍 Ara'}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {searchResults.map((user) => (
                    <div key={user.id} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 hover:border-violet-500/30 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 to-indigo-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white">
                          {user.name.charAt(0)}{user.surname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{user.name} {user.surname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{user.userName} • Lv. {user.level}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleSendRequest(user.id)}
                          className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-violet-600/20 text-violet-400 hover:bg-violet-600 hover:text-white text-xs font-black transition-all uppercase"
                        >
                          + Arkadaş Ekle
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleBlock(user.id)}
                          className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white transition-all"
                          title="Engelle"
                        >
                          🚫
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}

                  {searchResults.length === 0 && searchQuery.length >= 2 && !searching && (
                    <p className="text-slate-500 text-center py-8">Kullanıcı bulunamadı.</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* ENGELLENENLER */}
            {activeTab === 4 && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {blockedUsers.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-700 p-12 text-center">
                    <p className="text-4xl mb-4">🛡️</p>
                    <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">Engellenmiş kullanıcı yok.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  blockedUsers.map((u) => (
                    <div key={u.id} className="bg-slate-900/60 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/10 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-800 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-slate-500">
                          {u.name.charAt(0)}{u.surname.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-slate-200 font-bold">{u.name} {u.surname}</p>
                          <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs">@{u.userName}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleUnblock(u.id)}
                        className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black rounded-xl bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all uppercase border border-slate-700"
                      >
                        Engeli Kaldır
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* SP-05: Mücadele Modal */}
      {showChallengeModal && challengeTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-50 p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-8 w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-1">⚔️ Mücadele Başlat</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">
              <span className="text-violet-400 font-bold">{challengeTarget.name} {challengeTarget.surname}</span>'e mücadele daveti
            </p>
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateChallenge} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mücadele Adı *</label>
                <input required type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  value={challengeForm.title} onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, title: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Örn: Haftalık Görev Mücadelesi" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mücadele Tipi</label>
                <select className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  value={challengeForm.challengeType}
                  onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, challengeType: e.target.value })}>
                  <option value="TaskCount">📋 Görev Sayısı</option>
                  <option value="XPRace">⭐ XP Yarışı</option>
                  <option value="StreakBattle">🔥 Seri Mücadelesi</option>
                  <option value="CategoryFocus">🎯 Kategori Odağı</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              {challengeForm.challengeType === 'CategoryFocus' && (
                <div>
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Kategori *</label>
                  <select required className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.targetCategoryId}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, targetCategoryId: e.target.value })}>
                    <option value="">Kategori Seçin...</option>
                    {categories.map(cat => (
                      <option key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>{cat.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="flex gap-4">
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Hedef Sayı</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="500" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.targetValue}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, targetValue: parseInt(e.target.value) })} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Süre (Gün)</label>
                  <input type="number" min="1" max="90" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                    value={challengeForm.durationDays}
                    onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, durationDays: parseInt(e.target.value) })} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 block">Mesaj (opsiyonel)</label>
                <input type="text" className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-white p-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500"
                  placeholder="Rakibe mesaj..."
                  value={challengeForm.challengerMessage}
                  onChange={e => setChallengeForm({ ...challengeForm, challengerMessage: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 mt-6">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowChallengeModal(false)} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors text-sm">İptal</button>
                <button type="submit" className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500 shadow-lg shadow-rose-900/50 text-sm transition-all">⚔️ Mücadele Başlat</button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default SocialPage;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\TaskList.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import TaskItem from "../components/TaskItem";
import taskService from "../services/taskService";
import categoryService from "../services/categoryService";
import TaskTimer from "../components/TaskTimer";

const TaskList = () => {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const currentCategoryName = searchParams.get("category");

  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [requesting, setRequesting] = useState(false);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [activeTimerTask, setActiveTimerTask] = useState(null);

  const showToast = (message, type = "success") => {
    setToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchCategories = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await categoryService.getAllCategories();
        setCategories(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.categories || []);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    };
    fetchCategories();
  }, []);

  const fetchTasks = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const selectedCategory = categories.find((c) => c.name === currentCategoryName);
      const categoryId = selectedCategory ? selectedCategory.id : null;
      const data = await taskService.getAllTasks(categoryId);
      setTasks(Array.isArray(data) ? data : data?.tasks || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (categories.length > 0 || !currentCategoryName) {
      fetchTasks();
    }
  }, [currentCategoryName, categories]);

  const handleCategoryChange = (e) => {
    const selectedName = e.target.value;
    if (selectedName === "all") {
      setSearchParams({});
    } else {
      setSearchParams({ category: selectedName });
    }
  };

  const handleCompleteTask = async (taskId, reflectionText = null, customTags = []) => {
    try {
      const result = await taskService.completeTask(taskId, reflectionText, customTags);
      if (result.success) {
        setTasks((prevTasks) =>
          prevTasks.map((t) => (t.id === taskId ? { ...t, isCompleted: true } : t))
        );
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("userUpdated"));
        showToast(`🎉 Görev tamamlandı! +${result.earnedXp} XP kazandın!`, "success");
      } else {
        showToast(result.message || "Görev tamamlanamadı.", "error");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      showToast("Bir hata oluştu. Lütfen tekrar dene.", "error");
    }
  };

  const handlePostponeTask = (taskId) => {
    setTasks((prevTasks) =>
      prevTasks.map((t) =>
        t.id === taskId ? { ...t, status: 'Postponed' } : t
      )
    );
    showToast("📅 Görev yarına ertelendi.", "success");
  };

  const handleCancelPostponeTask = (taskId) => {
    setTasks((prevTasks) =>
      prevTasks.map((t) =>
        t.id === taskId ? { ...t, status: 'Selected', postponedTo: null } : t
      )
    );
    showToast("Görevin ertelemesi iptal edildi.", "success");
  };


  const handleRequestNewQuests = () => {
    navigate("/task-pool");
  };

  const handleFocusTask = (task) => {
    setActiveTimerTask(task);
  };

  const completedCount = tasks.filter((t) => t.isCompleted).length;
  const totalCount = tasks.length;
  const progress = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div className={`fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl transition-all animate-bounce ${
          toast.type === "success"
            ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-emerald-500/30"
            : "bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-rose-500/30"
        }`}>
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-end gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">
              GÖREVLER
            </h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)]"></div>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mt-2 text-sm italic font-medium">
              {currentCategoryName
                ? `${currentCategoryName.toUpperCase()} KATEGORİSİ`
                : "TÜM GÖREVLERİN LİSTESİ"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-4">
            <button
              onClick={handleRequestNewQuests}
              className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:border-indigo-500 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <span>✨ Görev Havuzuna Git</span>
            </button>

            <div className="relative">
              <select
                className="appearance-none bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-sm rounded-xl py-3 pl-4 pr-10 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none cursor-pointer hover:border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                onChange={handleCategoryChange}
                value={currentCategoryName || "all"}
              >
                <option value="all">Tüm Kategoriler</option>
                {categories.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>
                    {c.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-slate-500">▾</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Progress Bar */}
        {totalCount > 0 && !loading && (
          <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wider">
              <span>Günlük İlerleme</span>
              <span className={progress === 100 ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-indigo-400"}>
                {completedCount}/{totalCount} Görev — {progress}%
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-1000 ${
                  progress === 100
                    ? "bg-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(16,185,129,0.5)]"
                    : "bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-400"
                }`}
                style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Task List */}
        <div className="grid gap-4">
          {!loading ? (
            tasks.length > 0 ? (
              tasks.map((task) => (
                <TaskItem
                  key={task.id}
                  id={task.id}
                  title={task.title}
                  description={task.description}
                  xp={task.baseXP || task.xp}
                  difficulty={task.difficulty}
                  isCompleted={task.isCompleted}
                  status={task.status}
                  postponedTo={task.postponedTo}
                  onComplete={handleCompleteTask}
                  onPostpone={handlePostponeTask}
                  onCancelPostpone={handleCancelPostponeTask}
                  onFocus={handleFocusTask}
                />
              ))
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center py-16 border-2 border-slate-800/50 rounded-[2rem] bg-slate-900/20 border-dashed flex flex-col items-center gap-6">
                <div className="text-6xl">🎯</div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-xl">Maceraya Hazır Mısın?</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">
                    Şu an aktif bir görevin yok. Hemen yenilerini alabilirsin.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={handleRequestNewQuests}
                  className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30 transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95"
                >
                  GÖREV HAVUZUNA GİT
                </button>
              </div>
            )
          ) : (
            [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="h-20 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl animate-pulse border border-slate-800"
              ></div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeTimerTask && (
        <TaskTimer 
          task={activeTimerTask} 
          onClose={() => setActiveTimerTask(null)}
          onComplete={(id) => {
            handleCompleteTask(id);
            setActiveTimerTask(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default TaskList;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\pages\TaskPoolPage.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import MainLayout from "../layouts/MainLayout";
import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";
import DailyMoodSelector from "../components/DailyMoodSelector";
import TaskPoolSelector from "../components/TaskPoolSelector";
import userService from "../services/userService";
import { moodApi, taskPoolApi } from "../api/moodApi";
import "../styles/DailyTaskPage.css";

const TaskPoolPage = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("recommended"); // "recommended" | "all"
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("loading"); // loading | mood | pool
  const [poolData, setPoolData] = useState(null);
  const [poolLoading, setPoolLoading] = useState(false);
  const [availableTasks, setAvailableTasks] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [userLevel, setUserLevel] = useState(1);

  // Filter & Pagination States for ALL Tasks
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("all");
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [userLimits, setUserLimits] = useState({ daily: 3, today: 0, active: 0 });
  const [selectedInSession, setSelectedInSession] = useState(0);
  const [pendingSelections, setPendingSelections] = useState(new Map()); // Map<taskId, {task, type}>
  const pageSize = 6;
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const showToast = (message, type = "success") => {
    setToast({ message, type });
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    checkTodayMood();
    fetchAvailableTasks();
    const fetchUserLevel = async () => {
      try {
        const freshData = await userService.getProfile();
        setUserLevel(freshData.generalLevel ?? freshData.GeneralLevel ?? 1);
        setUserLimits({
          daily: freshData.dailyTaskLimit ?? 3,
          today: freshData.todayTaskCount ?? 0,
          active: freshData.activeTaskCount ?? 0
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
      }
    };
    fetchUserLevel();
  }, []);

  const checkTodayMood = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await moodApi.getTodayMood();
      if (res.data?.data || res.data) {
        // Bugün mood girilmiş — direkt pool'a geç
        await loadPool();
        setPhase("pool");
      } else {
        setPhase("mood");
      }
    } catch {
      setPhase("mood");
    }
  };

  const handleMoodRecorded = async () => {
    await loadPool();
    setPhase("pool");
  };

  const loadPool = async () => {
    setPoolLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await taskPoolApi.getDailyPool(6);
      setPoolData(res.data?.data || res.data || null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Pool yüklenemedi:", err);
    } finally {
      setPoolLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchAvailableTasks = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const availRes = await axiosClient.get("/user-tasks/available-tasks");
      if (availRes.data) {
        setAvailableTasks(availRes.data);
      } else {
        setAvailableTasks([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      showToast("Görevler yüklenirken bir sorun oluştu.", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleSelection = (task, type = 'all') => {
    const taskId = task.userTaskId ?? task.UserTaskId ?? task.id ?? task.Id;
    
    setPendingSelections(prev => {
      const newMap = new Map(prev);
      if (newMap.has(taskId)) {
        newMap.delete(taskId);
      } else {
        // Limit check BEFORE adding
        if (userLimits.today + newMap.size >= userLimits.daily) {
          showToast(`⚠️ Günlük limitine (${userLimits.daily}) ulaştın!`, "error");
          return prev; // Do not add
        }
        newMap.set(taskId, { task, type });
      }
      return newMap;
    });
  };

  const handleAssignAppTask = async (appTaskId) => {
    // This is no longer used directly on button click, we use toggleSelection now.
    // Keeping it here just in case, but refactored to toggleSelection.
  };

  // Get dynamic categories list from available tasks - MEMOIZED
  const uniqueCategories = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      "all",
      ...new Set(availableTasks.map((t) => t.categoryName || "Genel")),
    ];
  }, [availableTasks]);

  // Client-side category filter - MEMOIZED
  const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return availableTasks.filter((task) =>
      selectedCategory === "all"
        ? true
        : (task.categoryName || "Genel") === selectedCategory
    );
  }, [availableTasks, selectedCategory]);

  // Client-side pagination - MEMOIZED
  const totalPages = useMemo(() => {
    return Math.ceil(filteredTasks.length / pageSize);
  }, [filteredTasks]);

  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;

  const paginatedTasks = useMemo(() => {
    return filteredTasks.slice(startIndex, startIndex + pageSize);
  }, [filteredTasks, startIndex]);

  const handleCategoryChange = useCallback((category) => {
    setSelectedCategory(category);
    setCurrentPage(1); // Reset to page 1
  }, []);

  const mostCommonCategory = useMemo(() => {
    return uniqueCategories
      .filter((c) => c !== "all")
      .map((catName) => ({
        name: catName,
        count: availableTasks.filter((t) => (t.categoryName || "Genel") === catName).length,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)[0]?.name || "Genel";
  }, [uniqueCategories, availableTasks]);

  const handleFinishSelection = async () => {
    if (pendingSelections.size === 0) {
      navigate("/tasks");
      return;
    }

    setActionLoading('finish');
    let successCount = 0;
    
    try {
      // Process all pending selections
      for (const [taskId, data] of pendingSelections.entries()) {
        if (data.type === 'recommended') {
          await taskPoolApi.selectTask(taskId);
        } else {
          await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/assign/${taskId}`);
        }
        successCount++;
      }
      
      showToast(`🎉 ${successCount} görev başarıyla listene eklendi!`, "success");
      setPendingSelections(new Map());
      setTimeout(() => navigate("/tasks"), 1000);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Toplu atama sırasında hata:", err);
      const msg = err.response?.data?.message || "Görevler atanırken bir hata oluştu.";
      showToast(msg, "error");
      
      // If some succeeded, we still want to clear them and maybe navigate
      if (successCount > 0) {
        showToast(`⚠️ Sadece ${successCount} görev atanabildi.`, "warning");
        setTimeout(() => navigate("/tasks"), 2000);
      }
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <MainLayout>
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div
          className={`fixed top-6 right-6 z-50 px-6 py-4 rounded-2xl font-bold text-sm shadow-2xl transition-all animate-bounce ${
            toast.type === "success"
              ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-emerald-500/30"
              : "bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-rose-500/30"
          }`}
        >
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <section className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-6">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-4xl font-black text-white italic tracking-tighter mb-2">
              GÖREV HAVUZU
            </h2>
            <div className="h-1.5 w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-600 to-indigo-600 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(192,38,211,0.5)]"></div>
            <p className="text-slate-500 mt-2 text-sm italic font-medium max-w-lg">
              İster yapay zeka tarafından senin için özenle seçilen önerilere odaklan, ister seviyene uygun olan diğer tüm görevlerden seçerek kendi rotanı çiz.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Custom Tabs */}
          <div className="flex bg-slate-900/60 p-1 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("recommended")}
              className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-black tracking-wide transition-all ${
                activeTab === "recommended"
                  ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              🤖 ÖNERİLENLER
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("all")}
              className={`px-6 py-3 rounded-xl text-sm font-black tracking-wide transition-all ${
                activeTab === "all"
                  ? "bg-fuchsia-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-fuchsia-500/30"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              📋 TÜM GÖREVLER
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>
        
        {/* Limit Warning Banner */}
        {userLimits.today >= userLimits.daily && (
          <div className="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 p-6 rounded-[2rem] flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-6 animate-pulse">
            <div className="text-4xl">⚠️</div>
            <div className="flex-1 text-center md:text-left">
              <h3 className="text-amber-400 font-black text-lg tracking-tight">BUGÜNLÜK BU KADAR!</h3>
              <p className="text-amber-500/80 text-sm font-medium">
                Günlük görev limitine ({userLimits.daily}) ulaştın. Harika bir iş çıkardın! Yeni görevler için yarını bekleyebilir veya mevcut görevlerini tamamlayabilirsin.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleFinishSelection}
              className="bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black px-6 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs transition-all shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20"
            >
              GÖREVLERİME GİT
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Contents */}
        {activeTab === "recommended" ? (
          /* SECTION 1: RECOMMENDED (FROM /daily) */
          <div className="daily-task-page space-y-6">
            {phase === "loading" && (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
                <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
                <p className="text-slate-400">Yükleniyor...</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {phase === "mood" && (
              <DailyMoodSelector onMoodRecorded={handleMoodRecorded} />
            )}

            {phase === "pool" && (
              poolLoading ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12">
                  <div className="loading-spinner w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-full animate-spin mb-4" />
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Görevler hazırlanıyor...</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900/40 p-4 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-base">💡 Ruh haline özel öneriler hazır!</h3>
                      <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">Sana en uygun olanları seç ve listene ekle.</p>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setPhase("mood")}
                      className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-colors"
                    >
                      😊 Moodunu Güncelle
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <TaskPoolSelector
                    poolData={poolData}
                    isPoolMode={true}
                    isLimitReached={userLimits.today + pendingSelections.size >= userLimits.daily}
                    selectedIds={new Set(pendingSelections.keys())}
                    onTaskSelect={(task) => toggleSelection(task, 'recommended')}
                    onRefresh={loadPool}
                  />
                </div>
              )
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* SECTION 2: ALL LEVEL-APPROPRIATE TASKS */
          <div className="space-y-8">
            {/* Quick Stats Banner */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">Mevcut Seviyen</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-black text-fuchsia-400">{userLevel} Seviye</p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-3xl">🛡️</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">Seviyene Uygun Görev</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white">{availableTasks.length} Görev</p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-3xl">⚔️</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-slate-900/40 p-4 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">En Popüler Kategori</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-black text-indigo-400">{mostCommonCategory}</p>
                </div>
                <span className="text-3xl">🔥</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Category selection */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
              <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase mr-2 tracking-wider">
                Kategori Seç:
              </span>
              {uniqueCategories.map((cat) => (
                <button
                  key={cat}
                  onClick={() => handleCategoryChange(cat)}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border ${
                    selectedCategory === cat
                      ? "bg-fuchsia-600/20 text-fuchsia-300 border-fuchsia-500/40 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(217,70,239,0.2)]"
                      : "bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 border-slate-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat === "all" ? "Tüm Kategoriler" : cat}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 animate-pulse">
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map((i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="h-48 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800"></div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : paginatedTasks.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-16 border-2 border-slate-800/50 rounded-[2rem] bg-slate-900/20 border-dashed flex flex-col items-center gap-4">
                <span className="text-5xl">🏆</span>
                <p className="text-slate-400 font-semibold text-lg">Bu kategoride seviyene uygun görev kalmadı.</p>
                <p className="text-slate-600 text-sm max-w-sm">
                  Diğer kategorileri inceleyebilirsin!
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                  {paginatedTasks.map((t) => (
                    <div
                      key={t.id}
                      className="relative bg-slate-900/40 hover:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 hover:border-fuchsia-500/50 p-6 rounded-3xl transition-all duration-300 group flex flex-col justify-between h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl hover:shadow-fuchsia-500/10"
                    >
                      <div className="absolute -right-6 -top-6 w-24 h-24 bg-fuchsia-500/10 blur-[50px] rounded-full group-hover:bg-fuchsia-500/20 transition-all"></div>

                      <div className="space-y-3 relative z-10">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                          <span className="text-xs bg-fuchsia-500/15 text-fuchsia-300 border border-fuchsia-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                            {t.categoryIcon || "🎯"} {t.categoryName || "Genel"}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                            +{t.baseXP || t.xp} XP
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <h4 className="text-white font-black text-lg group-hover:text-fuchsia-400 transition-colors tracking-tight line-clamp-1">
                          {t.title}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-medium line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed">
                          {t.description}
                        </p>

                        {t.whyThisTask && (
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/60 leading-relaxed italic">
                            🎯 <strong>Amaç:</strong> {t.whyThisTask}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="relative z-10 mt-auto pt-2 flex flex-col gap-2">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">
                          <span>Zorluk: <strong className="text-slate-300">{t.difficulty || "Normal"}</strong></span>
                          <span>Min Seviye: <strong className="text-slate-300">{t.minLevel || 1}</strong></span>
                        </div>

                        <button
                          onClick={() => toggleSelection(t, 'all')}
                          disabled={actionLoading !== null || (!pendingSelections.has(t.id) && userLimits.today + pendingSelections.size >= userLimits.daily)}
                          className={`w-full ${pendingSelections.has(t.id) ? 'bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600' : 'bg-fuchsia-600 hover:bg-fuchsia-500'} disabled:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-white text-xs font-black py-3 rounded-2xl transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-fuchsia-600/20 hover:shadow-fuchsia-600/40 flex items-center justify-center gap-2`}
                        >
                          {actionLoading === t.id ? (
                            <span className="animate-spin">↻</span>
                          ) : pendingSelections.has(t.id) ? (
                            <>
                              <span>SEÇİMİ KALDIR</span>
                              <span>❌</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <span>{userLimits.today + pendingSelections.size >= userLimits.daily ? "LİMİT DOLDU" : "GÖREVİ LİSTENE EKLE"}</span>
                              <span>{userLimits.today + pendingSelections.size >= userLimits.daily ? "🔒" : "➕"}</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {/* Pagination Controls */}
                {totalPages > 1 && (
                  <div className="flex justify-center items-center gap-4 pt-4">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCurrentPage((prev) => Math.max(prev - 1, 1))}
                      disabled={currentPage === 1}
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-300 hover:text-white rounded-xl transition-all"
                    >
                      Önceki
                    </button>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400">
                      Sayfa <strong className="text-fuchsia-400">{currentPage}</strong> / {totalPages}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setCurrentPage((prev) => Math.min(prev + 1, totalPages))}
                      disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
                      className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-300 hover:text-white rounded-xl transition-all"
                    >
                      Sonraki
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Global Redirection Button */}
        {(selectedInSession > 0 || pendingSelections.size > 0 || userLimits.active > 0) && (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-12 border-t border-slate-800/50 mt-12">
            <button
              onClick={handleFinishSelection}
              disabled={actionLoading === 'finish'}
              className="group relative px-12 py-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 via-purple-600 to-fuchsia-600 rounded-3xl font-black text-white shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(79,70,229,0.3)] hover:shadow-indigo-500/50 transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 overflow-hidden disabled:opacity-75 disabled:scale-100"
            >
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/20 translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-transform duration-300"></div>
              <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-4 text-lg tracking-wider">
                {actionLoading === 'finish' ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="animate-spin">↻</span>
                    ATAMALAR YAPILIYOR...
                  </>
                ) : pendingSelections.size > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    SEÇİLEN {pendingSelections.size} GÖREVİ ATAYIP BAŞLA
                    <span className="text-2xl group-hover:translate-x-2 transition-transform">⚔️</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    GÖREV LİSTEME GİT VE BAŞLA
                    <span className="text-2xl group-hover:translate-x-2 transition-transform">⚔️</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </MainLayout>
  );
};

export default TaskPoolPage;

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import authService from "../services/authService";

const VerifyEmailPage = () => {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const token = searchParams.get("token");
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      setError("Geçersiz veya eksik doğrulama bağlantısı.");
      return;
    }

    const verify = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError("");
      setSuccess("");

      try {
        const response = await authService.verifyEmail(token);
        if (response.isSuccess) {
          setSuccess("🎉 E-posta adresiniz başarıyla doğrulandı! Giriş sayfasına yönlendiriliyorsunuz.");
          setTimeout(() => navigate("/login"), 3000);
        } else {
          setError(response.message || "E-posta doğrulama başarısız oldu.");
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        setError(err.response?.data?.message || "Doğrulama işlemi sırasında bir hata oluştu.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    verify();
  }, [token, navigate]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative overflow-hidden bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-indigo-900/20 via-slate-950 to-slate-950">
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-600/20 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-rose-600/10 blur-[120px] rounded-full"></div>

      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[2rem] shadow-2xl relative z-10 text-center">
        <div className="text-center mb-6">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 bg-indigo-600 rounded-2xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(79,70,229,0.5)] mb-4 text-white">
            ✉️
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tighter italic uppercase">
            E-POSTA DOĞRULAMA
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-2 font-medium">
            LifeQuest Hesabını Aktifleştir
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {loading && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-indigo-500/10 border border-indigo-500/20 rounded-xl text-indigo-400 font-medium text-center text-sm animate-pulse">
              E-posta adresiniz doğrulanıyor, lütfen bekleyin...
            </div>
          )}

          {error && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 rounded-xl text-rose-500 font-bold text-center text-sm">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {success && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-xl text-emerald-500 font-bold text-center text-sm">
              {success}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mt-8 text-center">
            <Link
              to="/login"
              className="text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:text-indigo-300 underline decoration-2 underline-offset-4"
            >
              Giriş Sayfasına Dön
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default VerifyEmailPage;

import axios from "axios";

// Python AI Mikro Servis
const aiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_AI_SERVICE_URL || "http://localhost:5001",
  headers: {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const aiService = {
  // Sağlık kontrolü
  healthCheck: async () => {
    const response = await aiClient.get("/health");
    return response.data;
  },

  // Chatbot — mesaj gönder
  chat: async (userId, message) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/chat", {
      user_id: userId,
      message: message,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Yansıma metni doğrulama
  verifyReflection: async (text, minWordCount = 10, taskCategory = null) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/verify-reflection", {
      text,
      min_word_count: minWordCount,
      task_category: taskCategory,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Görüntü doğrulama
  verifyImage: async (userId, taskId, taskCategory, imageBase64) => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/verify-image", {
      user_id: userId,
      task_id: taskId,
      task_category: taskCategory,
      image_base64: imageBase64,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Modelleri yeniden eğit (Admin)
  trainModels: async () => {
    const response = await aiClient.post("/api/train");
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default aiService;

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const authService = {
  login: async (credentials) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/Auth/Login', credentials);
    return response.data;
  },

  register: async (userData) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/Auth/Register', userData);
    return response.data;
  },

  verifyEmail: async (token) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/Auth/verify-email?token=${token}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  forgotPassword: async (email) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/Auth/forgot-password', { email });
    return response.data;
  },

  resetPassword: async (resetData) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/Auth/reset-password', resetData);
    return response.data;
  }
};

export default authService;

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

export const challengeService = {
  sendInvite: async (inviteData) => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.post('/social/challenges/invite', inviteData);
    return data;
  },
  respondToChallenge: async (challengeId, accept, message) => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.patch(`/social/challenges/${challengeId}/respond`, { accept, message });
    return data;
  },
  getActiveChallenges: async (status = 'active') => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.get(`/social/challenges?status=${status}`);
    return data;
  },
  getChallengeDetail: async (challengeId) => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.get(`/social/challenges/${challengeId}`);
    return data;
  },
  cancelChallenge: async (challengeId) => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.delete(`/social/challenges/${challengeId}`);
    return data;
  },
  getChallengeDetails: async (challengeId) => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.get(`/social/challenges/${challengeId}/details`);
    return data;
  }
};

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\services\chatService.js

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const chatService = {
  sendMessage: async (message) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/chat/send', { message });
    return response.data;
  },

  // Bağlamsal motivasyon mesajı (mood + level dahil)
  getMotivation: async ({ moodHint, level, totalXp }) => {
    const parts = [];
    if (moodHint) parts.push(`Kullanıcı şu an ${moodHint} hissediyor.`);
    if (level) parts.push(`Seviye: ${level}.`);
    if (totalXp) parts.push(`Toplam XP: ${totalXp}.`);
    const message = `${parts.join(' ')} Kullanıcıya kısa, içten ve güçlü bir Türkçe motivasyon mesajı ver. Sadece mesajı yaz, başka şey ekleme.`;
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/chat/send', { message });
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default chatService;

import axiosClient from "../api/axiosClient";

const goalService = {
  getGoals: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get("/goals");
    return response.data?.goals || [];
  },

  getGoalDashboard: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get("/goals/dashboard");
    return response.data;
  },

  createGoal: async (goalData) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post("/goals", goalData);
    return response.data;
  },

  updateGoalProgress: async (goalId, incrementBy, note) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/goals/${goalId}/progress`, { incrementBy, note });
    return response.data;
  },

  archiveGoal: async (goalId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/goals/${goalId}/archive`);
    return response.data;
  },

  addMilestone: async (goalId, milestone) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/goals/${goalId}/milestones`, milestone);
    return response.data;
  }
};

export default goalService;

DOSYA YOLU: frontend\src\services\postService.js
==================================================

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const API_BASE = axiosClient.defaults.baseURL?.replace('/api', '') || 'http://localhost:5020';

const postService = {
  /**
   * Arkadaşların ve kendi paylaşımlarını getir.
   * @param {number} page - Sayfa numarası (1'den başlar)
   */
  getFeed: async (page = 1, pageSize = 20) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.get(`/posts/feed?page=${page}&pageSize=${pageSize}`);
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Yeni gönderi oluştur. Hem metin hem de resimli paylaşımı destekler.
   * @param {string|null} content - Metin içeriği
   * @param {File|null} imageFile - Resim dosyası
   * @param {Array<{taskId, x, y}>} tags - Resim üzerindeki etiketler
   */
  createPost: async (content, imageFile, tags = []) => {
    const formData = new FormData();
    if (content) formData.append('Content', content);
    if (imageFile) formData.append('Image', imageFile);
    if (tags.length > 0) formData.append('TagsJson', JSON.stringify(tags));

    const res = await axiosClient.post('/posts', formData, {
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Kendi paylaşımını sil.
   * @param {string} postId
   */
  deletePost: async (postId) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.delete(`/posts/${postId}`);
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Gönderiyi beğen.
   * @param {string} postId
   */
  likePost: async (postId) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.post(`/posts/${postId}/like`);
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Gönderi beğenisini kaldır.
   * @param {string} postId
   */
  unlikePost: async (postId) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.delete(`/posts/${postId}/like`);
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Gönderiye yapılan yorumları getir.
   * @param {string} postId
   */
  getComments: async (postId) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.get(`/posts/${postId}/comments`);
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Gönderiye yorum yap.
   * @param {string} postId
   * @param {string} content
   */
  addComment: async (postId, content) => {
    const res = await axiosClient.post(`/posts/${postId}/comments`, { content });
    return res.data;
  },

  /**
   * Resmin tam URL'ini oluştur.
   * @param {string|null} imageUrl - '/uploads/posts/xxx.jpg' formatında
   */
  getImageUrl: (imageUrl) => {
    if (!imageUrl) return null;
    return `${API_BASE}${imageUrl}`;
  },
};

export default postService;

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const socialService = {
  // Arkadaş listesi
  getFriends: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/social/friends');
    return response.data.friends || [];
  },

  // Bekleyen istekler
  getFriendRequests: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/social/friend-requests');
    return response.data.requests || [];
  },

  // Kullanıcı ara
  searchUsers: async (query) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get(`/social/users/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
    return response.data.users || [];
  },

  // Arkadaşlık isteği gönder
  sendFriendRequest: async (targetUserId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/social/friend-request/${targetUserId}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // İstek kabul et
  acceptFriendRequest: async (requestId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/social/friend-request/${requestId}/accept`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // İstek reddet
  rejectFriendRequest: async (requestId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/social/friend-request/${requestId}/reject`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // Arkadaşlık sil
  removeFriend: async (friendshipId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.delete(`/social/friends/${friendshipId}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  // Mücadeleler
  getChallenges: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/social/challenges');
    return response.data.challenges || [];
  },

  // Mücadele oluştur
  createChallenge: async (challengeData) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/social/challenges', challengeData);
    return response.data;
  },
  
  // P4-T1: Engelleme işlemleri
  getBlockedUsers: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/social/blocked-users');
    return response.data.blockedUsers || [];
  },
  blockUser: async (targetUserId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/social/block/${targetUserId}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  unblockUser: async (targetUserId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/social/unblock/${targetUserId}`);
    return response.data;
  },
  // P4-T2: Kudos gönder
  sendKudos: async (userTaskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/social/kudos', { userTaskId });
    return response.data;
  },
};

export default socialService;

import axiosClient from '../api/axiosClient';

const taskService = {
  getAllTasks: async (categoryId = null) => {
    const url = categoryId ? `/user-tasks?categoryId=${categoryId}` : '/user-tasks';
    const response = await axiosClient.get(url);
    return response.data.tasks || [];
  },

  completeTask: async (userTaskId, reflectionText = null, customTags = []) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.patch(`/user-tasks/${userTaskId}/complete`, {
      reflectionText,
      customTags
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  requestNewQuests: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post('/user-tasks/request-new');
    return response.data;
  },

  assignSpecificTask: async (appTaskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/assign/${appTaskId}`);
    return response.data;
  },

  createTask: async (taskData) => {
    return await axiosClient.post('/Tasks/create-task', taskData);
  },

  createBulkTasks: async (tasksArray) => {
    return await axiosClient.post('/Tasks/create-bulk-tasks', { tasks: tasksArray });
  },

  // ─── SP-01: Yeni Görev Aksiyonları ─────────────────────────────────────
  getDailyPool: async () => {
    const response = await axiosClient.get('/user-tasks/daily-pool');
    return response.data;
  },

  selectTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/select`);
    return response.data;
  },

  postponeTask: async (taskId, postponeTo, reason) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/postpone`, {
      postponeTo,
      reason
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  pauseTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/pause`);
    return response.data;
  },

  resumeTask: async (taskId) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/resume`);
    return response.data;
  },

  abandonTask: async (taskId, reason) => {
    const response = await axiosClient.post(`/user-tasks/${taskId}/abandon`, {
      reason
    });
    return response.data;
  }
};

export default taskService;

export const getUserIdFromToken = () => {
  const userDataStr = sessionStorage.getItem("user_data");
  if (!userDataStr) return null;
  try {
    const userData = JSON.parse(userDataStr);
    return userData.userId || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const getUserNameFromToken = () => {
  const userDataStr = sessionStorage.getItem("user_data");
  if (!userDataStr) return null;
  try {
    const userData = JSON.parse(userDataStr);
    return userData.userName || "Bilinmeyen Kullanıcı";
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const getUserRoleFromToken = () => {
  const userDataStr = sessionStorage.getItem("user_data");
  if (!userDataStr) return null;
  try {
    const userData = JSON.parse(userDataStr);
    return userData.role || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FluentValidation;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Behaviors;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddMediatR(conf =>
        {
            conf.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(typeof(ServiceRegistration).Assembly);
        });
        services.AddValidatorsFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
        services.AddTransient(typeof(IPipelineBehavior<,>), typeof(ValidationBehavior<,>));
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Behaviors\ValidationBehavior.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Behaviors;

public sealed class ValidationBehavior<TRequest, TResponse> : IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
        where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> _validators;

    public ValidationBehavior(IEnumerable<IValidator<TRequest>> validators)
    {
        _validators = validators;
    }

    public async Task<TResponse> Handle(TRequest request, RequestHandlerDelegate<TResponse> next, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (!_validators.Any())
            return await next();

        var context = new ValidationContext<TRequest>(request);

        var validationResults = await Task.WhenAll(
            _validators.Select(v => v.ValidateAsync(context, cancellationToken)));

        var failures = validationResults
            .SelectMany(r => r.Errors)
            .Where(f => f != null)
            .ToList();

        if (failures.Count != 0)
            throw new ValidationException(failures);

        return await next();
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Common\Extensions\PaginationExtensions.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs.Common;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Extensions;

public static class PaginationExtensions
{
    public static async Task<PaginatedList<T>> ToPaginatedListAsync<T>(
        this IQueryable<T> source, 
        int pageNumber, 
        int pageSize, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // Clamp pageSize between 1 and 100
        pageSize = Math.Clamp(pageSize, 1, 100);
        pageNumber = Math.Max(pageNumber, 1);

        var count = await source.CountAsync(cancellationToken);
        var items = await source
            .Skip((pageNumber - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new PaginatedList<T>(items, count, pageNumber, pageSize);
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Common\Security\HashingHelper.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Security;

public static class HashingHelper
{
    public static void CreatePasswordHash(string password, out byte[] passwordHash, out byte[] passwordSalt)
    {
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA512();
        passwordSalt = hmac.Key;
        passwordHash = hmac.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password));
    }

    public static bool VerifyPasswordHash(string password, byte[] passwordHash, byte[] passwordSalt)
    {
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA512(passwordSalt);
        var computedHash = hmac.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(password));

        return computedHash.SequenceEqual(passwordHash);
    }
}
