using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Tasks.Queries.GetAll;

public sealed class GetAllTasksQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetAllTasksQueryRequest, List<GetAllTasksQueryResponse>>
{
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;

    public GetAllTasksQueryHandler(IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository)
    {
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<List<GetAllTasksQueryResponse>> Handle(GetAllTasksQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tasks = await _taskReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
                                             .Include(t => t.Category)
                                             .Where(t => t.IsActive)
                                             .OrderBy(t => t.MinLevel)
                                             .ThenBy(t => t.Title)
                                             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return tasks.Select(t => new GetAllTasksQueryResponse
        {
            Id = t.Id,
            Title = t.Title,
            Description = t.Description,
            CategoryName = t.Category != null ? t.Category.Name : "Kategorisiz",
            CategoryId = t.CategoryId,
            Difficulty = t.Difficulty.ToString(),
            BaseXP = t.BaseXP,
            MinLevel = t.MinLevel,
            MaxLevel = t.MaxLevel,
            IsDaily = t.IsDaily,
            IsActive = t.IsActive
        }).ToList();
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Commands.UpdateGoals;

// ─── Request ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public class UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest : IRequest<UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public List<string> NewGoals { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> RemovedGoals { get; set; } = new();
}

public class UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public List<string> UpdatedGoals { get; set; } = new();
}

// ─── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

public sealed class UpdateUserGoalsCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest, UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notifService;

    public UpdateUserGoalsCommandHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWrite,
        IAppNotificationService notifService)
    {
        _userRead = userRead;
        _userWrite = userWrite;
        _notifService = notifService;
    }

    public async Task<UpdateUserGoalsCommandResponse> Handle(
        UpdateUserGoalsCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." };

        var goals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();

        // Kaldırılanları sil
        foreach (var r in request.RemovedGoals)
            goals.Remove(r);

        // Yenileri ekle (duplicate yok)
        foreach (var n in request.NewGoals)
            if (!goals.Contains(n, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                goals.Add(n);

        user.UserGoals = goals;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWrite.Update(user);
        await _userWrite.SaveAsync();

        // Bildirim gönder
        await _notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
            user.Id,
            "Hedeflerin güncellendi! 🎯",
            "Yeni hedeflerine uygun görevler hazırlanıyor.",
            "SystemMessage");

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Hedeflerin başarıyla güncellendi.",
            UpdatedGoals = goals
        };
    }
}

    }

    public async Task<VacationCommandResponse> Handle(
        EndVacationCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." };

        if (!user.IsOnVacation)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Tatil modunda değilsin." };

        int restoredStreak = user.FrozenStreak;

        user.IsOnVacation      = false;
        user.VacationEndDate   = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        user.FrozenStreak      = 0;
        user.UpdatedAt         = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWrite.Update(user);
        await _userWrite.SaveAsync();

        // Chatbot hoşgeldin mesajı (SignalR push)
        await _notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
            user.Id,
            "Hoş geldin! 🎉",
            $"Tatilden döndün! Streak'in ({restoredStreak} gün) hâlâ yerinde. Hazır mısın?",
            "SystemMessage");

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = $"Tatil modu kapatıldı. Streak'in ({restoredStreak} gün) korundu! 🔥"
        };
    }
}

    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;

        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\User\Queries\GetLeaderboard\GetLeaderboardQueryHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Extensions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetLeaderboard;

public sealed class GetLeaderboardQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetLeaderboardQueryRequest, PaginatedList<GetLeaderboardQueryResponse>>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IFriendshipReadRepository _friendshipReadRepository;

    public GetLeaderboardQueryHandler(IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository, IFriendshipReadRepository friendshipReadRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _friendshipReadRepository = friendshipReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<PaginatedList<GetLeaderboardQueryResponse>> Handle(GetLeaderboardQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userQuery = _userReadRepository.Table.AsNoTracking();

        if (request.Filter == "friends" && request.CurrentUserId.HasValue)
        {
            var friendIds = await _friendshipReadRepository.Table.AsNoTracking()
                .Where(f => (f.RequesterId == request.CurrentUserId || f.AddresseeId == request.CurrentUserId) && f.Status == LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums.FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
                .Select(f => f.RequesterId == request.CurrentUserId ? f.AddresseeId : f.RequesterId)
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
            
            friendIds.Add(request.CurrentUserId.Value); // Kendisi de listede olsun

            userQuery = userQuery.Where(u => friendIds.Contains(u.Id));
        }

        var query = userQuery
                      .OrderByDescending(u => u.TotalXP)
                      .Select(user => new GetLeaderboardQueryResponse
                      {
                          Rank = 0,
                          UserName = user.UserName,
                          Name = user.Name,
                          Surname = user.Surname,
                          TotalXP = user.TotalXP,
                          GeneralLevel = user.GeneralLevel
                      });

        var paginatedResult = await query.ToPaginatedListAsync(request.PageNumber, request.PageSize, cancellationToken);
        
        // Fix ranks based on page
        int baseRank = (request.PageNumber - 1) * request.PageSize;
        for (int i = 0; i < paginatedResult.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            paginatedResult.Items[i].Rank = baseRank + i + 1;
        }

        return paginatedResult;
    }
}

==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserActivities;

public sealed class GetUserActivitiesQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserActivitiesQueryRequest, GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;

    public GetUserActivitiesQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository, IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserActivitiesQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tasksData = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(ut => ut.CompletedAt)
            .Take(5)
            .Select(ut => new
            {
                ut.Id,
                Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                ut.EarnedXp,
                OriginalDate = ut.CompletedAt!.Value
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var badgesData = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(ub => ub.EarnedAt)
            .Take(5)
            .Select(ub => new
            {
                ub.Id,
                Name = ub.Badge.Name,
                OriginalDate = ub.EarnedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var taskDtos = tasksData.Select(t => {
            var trTime = t.OriginalDate.AddHours(3);
            var cleanTrTime = DateTime.SpecifyKind(trTime, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            return new ActivityDto
            {
                Id = t.Id,
                Type = "TASK",
                Text = $"\"{t.Title}\" görevini tamamladın",
                Xp = $"+{t.EarnedXp} XP",
                Time = cleanTrTime.ToString("dd MMM HH:mm"),
                RawDate = cleanTrTime
            };
        });

        var badgeDtos = badgesData.Select(b => {
            var trTime = b.OriginalDate.AddHours(3);
            var cleanTrTime = DateTime.SpecifyKind(trTime, DateTimeKind.Unspecified);

            return new ActivityDto
            {
                Id = b.Id,
                Type = "BADGE",
                Text = $"\"{b.Name}\" rozetini kazandın!",
                Xp = "",
                Time = cleanTrTime.ToString("dd MMM HH:mm"),
                RawDate = cleanTrTime
            };
        });

        var allActivities = taskDtos
            .Concat(badgeDtos)
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.RawDate)
            .Take(5)
            .ToList();

        return new GetUserActivitiesQueryResponse
        {
            Activities = allActivities
        };
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserProfile;

public sealed class GetUserProfileQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserProfileQueryRequest, GetUserProfileQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserProfileQueryHandler(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserProfileQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserProfileQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .ThenInclude(cp => cp.Category)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == request.UserId, cancellationToken);

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        var userBadges = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Include(ub => ub.Badge)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var completedTaskCount = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .CountAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new GetUserProfileQueryResponse
        {
            Name = user.Name,
            Surname = user.Surname,
            UserName = user.UserName,
            TotalXP = user.TotalXP,
            GeneralLevel = user.GeneralLevel,
            CreatedAt = user.CreatedAt,
            CompletedTaskCount = completedTaskCount,
            DailyTaskLimit = user.DailyTaskLimit,
            TodayTaskCount = user.TodayTaskCount,
            ActiveTaskCount = user.ActiveTaskCount,

            EarnedBadges = userBadges.Select(ub => new UserBadgeDto
            {
                BadgeName = ub.Badge.Name,
                IconPath = ub.Badge.IconPath,
                Description = ub.Badge.Description,
                EarnedAt = ub.EarnedAt
            }).ToList(),

            CategoryStats = user.CategoryProgresses.Select(cp => new CategoryProgressDto
            {
                CategoryName = cp.Category.Name,
                IconPath = cp.Category.IconPath,
                Level = cp.Level,
                CurrentXp = cp.CurrentXp,
                XpToNextLevel = cp.XpToNextLevel
            }).ToList()
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\User\Queries\GetUserStats\GetUserStatsQueryHandler.cs
==================================================

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.User.Queries.GetUserStats;

public sealed class GetUserStatsQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserStatsQueryRequest, GetUserStatsQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserStatsQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserStatsQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserStatsQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var completedDates = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue, tracking: false)
            .Select(ut => ut.CompletedAt!.Value)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var completedDateStrings = completedDates
            .Select(d => d.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"))
            .ToHashSet();

        var totalCompleted = completedDates.Count;
        var now = DateTime.Now;

        var lastWeekCount = completedDates.Count(d => d >= now.AddDays(-7));
        var previousWeekCount = completedDates.Count(d => d >= now.AddDays(-14) && d < now.AddDays(-7));

        int growth = 0;
        if (previousWeekCount > 0)
            growth = ((lastWeekCount - previousWeekCount) * 100) / previousWeekCount;
        else if (lastWeekCount > 0)
            growth = 100;

        var streakList = new List<bool>();
        for (int i = 6; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var checkDateStr = now.AddDays(-i).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd");
            streakList.Add(completedDateStrings.Contains(checkDateStr));
        }

        int currentStreak = 0;
        for (int i = streakList.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            if (streakList[i]) currentStreak++;
            else if (i == streakList.Count - 1) continue;
            else break;
        }

        return new GetUserStatsQueryResponse
        {
            TotalCompleted = totalCompleted,
            WeeklyGrowth = growth,
            Streak = streakList,
            StreakCount = currentStreak
        };
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserBadges.Queries.GetBadgeGallery;


public sealed class GetBadgeGalleryQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetBadgeGalleryQueryRequest, GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IBadgeReadRepository _badgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;

    public GetBadgeGalleryQueryHandler(
        IBadgeReadRepository badgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository)
    {
        _badgeReadRepository = badgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse> Handle(GetBadgeGalleryQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var allBadges = await _badgeReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false)
            .OrderBy(b => b.RequiredLevel)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var userEarnedBadges = await _userBadgeReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ub => ub.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: false)
            .Select(ub => new { ub.BadgeId, ub.EarnedAt })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var badgeDtos = allBadges.Select(badge =>
        {
            var earnedRecord = userEarnedBadges.FirstOrDefault(ub => ub.BadgeId == badge.Id);
            return new BadgeGalleryDto
            {
                Id = badge.Id,
                Name = badge.Name,
                Description = badge.Description,
                IconPath = badge.IconPath,
                RequiredLevel = badge.RequiredLevel,
                IsEarned = earnedRecord != null,
                EarnedAt = earnedRecord?.EarnedAt
            };
        }).ToList();

        return new GetBadgeGalleryQueryResponse
        {
            Badges = badgeDtos
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\AssignSpecificTask\AssignSpecificTaskCommandHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.AssignSpecificTask;

public class AssignSpecificTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AssignSpecificTaskCommandRequest, AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _appTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;

    public AssignSpecificTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository appTaskReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository)
    {
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _appTaskReadRepository = appTaskReadRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse> Handle(AssignSpecificTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse { Success = false, Message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." };
        }

        // ─── DailyLimitRule ─────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.TodayTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse 
            { 
                Success = false, 
                Message = $"Bugün için görev limitine ({user.TodayTaskCount}/{user.DailyTaskLimit}) ulaştın. Yarın yeni görev alabilirsin veya limitini ayarlardan değiştirebilirsin." 
            };
        }

        // ─── ActiveLimitRule ────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.ActiveTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit * 2)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse 
            { 
                Success = false, 
                Message = $"Henüz tamamlanmamış {user.ActiveTaskCount}/{user.DailyTaskLimit * 2} görevin var. Önce mevcut görevlerini tamamla veya ertele." 
            };
        }

        var taskExists = await _appTaskReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.AppTaskId.ToString());
        if (taskExists == null)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse { Success = false, Message = "Görev bulunamadı." };
        }

        var alreadyAssigned = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.AppTaskId == request.AppTaskId
                && ut.AssignedAt.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date
                && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Expired && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Abandoned, cancellationToken);
            
        if (alreadyAssigned)
        {
            return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev sana bugün zaten atanmış durumda." };
        }

        var newUserTask = new UserTask
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            AppUserId = request.UserId,
            AppTaskId = request.AppTaskId,
            Status = AppTaskStatus.Selected,
            AssignedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            DueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddHours(24),
            EarnedXp = 0
        };

        user.TodayTaskCount++;
        user.ActiveTaskCount++;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserTask);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new AssignSpecificTaskCommandResponse
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Görev başarıyla eklendi!",
            AssignedUserTaskId = newUserTask.Id
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\CancelPostponeTask\CancelPostponeTaskCommand.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.CancelPostponeTask;

public class CancelPostponeTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
}

public class CancelPostponeTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<CancelPostponeTaskCommandRequest, bool>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;

    public CancelPostponeTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(CancelPostponeTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (!userTask.IsPostponed || userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.Postponed)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Bu görev ertelenmiş durumda değil.");

        // Yarın için oluşturulan görevi bul ve sil
        if (userTask.PostponedTo.HasValue)
        {
            var dueDate = userTask.PostponedTo.Value.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue);
            // PostgreSQL UTC time matching
            dueDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind(dueDate, DateTimeKind.Utc);
            
            var tomorrowTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
                .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId 
                             && ut.AppTaskId == userTask.AppTaskId 
                             && ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested
                             && ut.DueDate == dueDate, tracking: true)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

            if (tomorrowTask != null)
            {
                _userTaskWriteRepository.Remove(tomorrowTask);
            }
        }

        // Görevi eski haline döndür
        userTask.IsPostponed = false;
        userTask.PostponeCount = Math.Max(0, userTask.PostponeCount - 1);
        userTask.PostponedTo = null;
        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Selected; // Erteleme iptal edilince görev listesine geri döner
        userTask.SkipReason = null;
        userTask.XpCompensationRate = 1.0m;

        _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(userTask);

        // Kullanıcının toplam erteleme sayısını düşür
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user != null)
        {
            user.TotalPostponeCount = Math.Max(0, user.TotalPostponeCount - 1);
            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        }

        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return true;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\CompleteUserTask\CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.CompleteUserTask;

public sealed class CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler
    : IRequestHandler<CompleteUserTaskCommandRequest, CompleteUserTaskCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGamificationService _gamificationService;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserGoalReadRepository _goalReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserGoalWriteRepository _goalWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneReadRepository _milestoneReadRepository;
    private readonly IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository _milestoneWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskInteractionWriteRepository _interactionWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAchievementService _achievementService;
    private readonly IChallengeService _challengeService;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public CompleteUserTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IGamificationService gamificationService,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IUserGoalReadRepository goalReadRepository,
        IUserGoalWriteRepository goalWriteRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneReadRepository milestoneReadRepository,
        IGoalMilestoneWriteRepository milestoneWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskInteractionWriteRepository interactionWriteRepository,
        IAchievementService achievementService,
        IChallengeService challengeService,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _gamificationService = gamificationService;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _goalReadRepository = goalReadRepository;
        _goalWriteRepository = goalWriteRepository;
        _milestoneReadRepository = milestoneReadRepository;
        _milestoneWriteRepository = milestoneWriteRepository;
        _interactionWriteRepository = interactionWriteRepository;
        _achievementService = achievementService;
        _challengeService = challengeService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<CompleteUserTaskCommandResponse> Handle(
        CompleteUserTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // 1. Görev kontrolü
        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId, cancellationToken);

        if (userTask == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Görev bulunamadı." };

        if (userTask.AppUserId != request.UserId)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev size ait değil." };

        if (userTask.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu görev zaten tamamlanmış." };

        var task = userTask.AppTask;
        if (task == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Görev detayları bulunamadı." };

        // 2. Görev tamamlama + XP kazanma
        int xpToEarn = task.BaseXP;
        userTask.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Completed;
        
        // FEAT-002 & FEAT-008
        userTask.ReflectionText = request.ReflectionText;
        userTask.CustomTags = request.CustomTags;

        await _gamificationService.AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(request.UserId, xpToEarn, userTask, task.CategoryId);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        // 3. Kullanıcı sayaçları + Streak + XP Bonus hesapla (MISS-004 + IMP-001)
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .Include(u => u.UserTasks)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == request.UserId, cancellationToken);

        if (user != null)
        {
            // SP-05: ActiveTaskCount ve WeeklyCompletedCount güncelle
            if (user.ActiveTaskCount > 0) user.ActiveTaskCount--;
            user.WeeklyCompletedCount++;

            // ── MISS-004: Streak hesaplama ──────────────────────────────
            var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
            var yesterday = today.AddDays(-1);

            if (user.LastTaskCompletedDate == null)
            {
                // İlk görev tamamlama
                user.CurrentStreak = 1;
            }
            else if (user.LastTaskCompletedDate == yesterday)
            {
                // Dün tamamlandı: seri devam ediyor
                user.CurrentStreak++;
            }
            else if (user.LastTaskCompletedDate < yesterday)
            {
                // 2+ gün önce: seri sıfırla
                user.CurrentStreak = 1;
            }
            // Bugün zaten tamamlandıysa streak değişmez

            user.LongestStreak = Math.Max(user.LongestStreak, user.CurrentStreak);
            user.LastTaskCompletedDate = today;

            // ── IMP-001: XP Bonus Sistemi ───────────────────────────────
            int bonusXp = 0;

            // Günün ilk görevi: +20 XP
            bool isFirstTaskToday = !user.UserTasks!
                .Any(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed &&
                           ut.CompletedAt.HasValue &&
                           ut.CompletedAt.Value.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date &&
                           ut.Id != userTask.Id);
            if (isFirstTaskToday)
                bonusXp += 20;

            // FEAT-002: Reflection Bonusu (+5 XP)
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ReflectionText))
                bonusXp += 5;

            // Geri dönüş bonusu: 3+ gün aradan sonra +50 XP
            bool isComebackBonus = user.LastTaskCompletedDate.HasValue &&
                                   user.LastTaskCompletedDate.Value < today.AddDays(-3);
            if (isComebackBonus)
                bonusXp += 50;

            // Streak çarpanı (temel XP üzerine)
            double streakMultiplier = 1.0;
            if (user.CurrentStreak > 30) streakMultiplier = 1.25;
            else if (user.CurrentStreak > 7) streakMultiplier = 1.10;

            int finalXp = (int)Math.Round(xpToEarn * streakMultiplier) + bonusXp;

            // XP farkını ekle (temel XP zaten eklendi, sadece farkı ekle)
            int extraXp = finalXp - xpToEarn;
            if (extraXp > 0)
                await _gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(request.UserId, extraXp);

            xpToEarn = finalXp; // response için güncelle

            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
            await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            // SP-05: Hedef otomatik ilerleme güncelleme
            await UpdateGoalProgressAsync(request.UserId, task.CategoryId, xpToEarn, cancellationToken);

            // ML modeli için etkileşim verisini kaydet
            var userCatLevelObj = user.CategoryProgresses?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
            int userCatLevel = userCatLevelObj?.Level ?? 1;

            var interaction = new UserTaskInteraction
            {
                AppUserId = request.UserId,
                AppTaskId = task.Id,
                UserLevel = (int)user.GeneralLevel,
                UserCategoryLevel = userCatLevel,
                TaskDifficulty = (int)task.Difficulty,
                TaskBaseXP = task.BaseXP,
                DayOfWeek = (int)DateTime.UtcNow.DayOfWeek,
                HourOfDay = DateTime.UtcNow.Hour,
                UserCompletedTaskCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0,
                UserStreakDays = user.CurrentStreak,
                WasCompleted = true,
                CompletionTimeHours = (float)(DateTime.UtcNow - userTask.AssignedAt).TotalHours,
                Rating = 5.0f
            };

            await _interactionWriteRepository.AddAsync(interaction);
            await _interactionWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        }

        // 4. Başarımları ve Mücadeleleri kontrol et
        await _achievementService.CheckAchievementsAsync(request.UserId);
        await _challengeService.UpdateChallengeProgressAsync(request.UserId, task.CategoryId, xpToEarn);

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Görev başarıyla tamamlandı! 🎉",
            EarnedXp = xpToEarn
        };
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Görev tamamlandığında ilgili aktif hedeflerin ilerlemesini günceller.</summary>
    private async Task UpdateGoalProgressAsync(Guid userId, Guid? categoryId, int earnedXp, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var activeGoals = await _goalReadRepository.GetWhere(
            g => g.AppUserId == userId && !g.IsCompleted && !g.IsArchived, tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var goal in activeGoals)
        {
            bool updated = false;

            // AutoTrackByCategory: Kategori eşleşiyorsa CurrentValue++
            if (goal.AutoTrackByCategory && categoryId.HasValue &&
                goal.LinkedCategoryIds != null && goal.LinkedCategoryIds.Contains(categoryId.Value))
            {
                goal.CurrentValue++;
                updated = true;
            }

            // AutoTrackByXP: CurrentValue += kazanılan XP
            if (goal.AutoTrackByXP)
            {
                goal.CurrentValue += earnedXp;
                updated = true;
            }

            if (!updated) continue;

            // Hedef tamamlandı mı?
            if (goal.CurrentValue >= goal.TargetValue && !goal.IsCompleted)
            {
                goal.IsCompleted = true;
                goal.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId,
                    "Hedef Tamamlandı! 🏆",
                    $"Tebrikler! '{goal.Title}' hedefini tamamladın!",
                    "GoalCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Milestone kontrolü
                var milestones = await _milestoneReadRepository
                    .GetWhere(m => m.UserGoalId == goal.Id && !m.IsCompleted, tracking: true)
                    .OrderBy(m => m.OrderIndex)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                foreach (var milestone in milestones.Where(m => goal.CurrentValue >= m.TargetValue))
                {
                    milestone.IsCompleted = true;
                    milestone.CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

                    await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        userId,
                        "Milestone Tamamlandı! 🎯",
                        $"'{goal.Title}' hedefinde '{milestone.Title}' adımını geçtin!",
                        "MilestoneCompleted");
                }
                await _milestoneWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
            }

            _goalWriteRepository.Update(goal);
        }

        await _goalWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PostponeTask;

public class PostponeTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<PostponeResultDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    public DateOnly PostponeTo { get; set; } = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1));
    public string? SkipReason { get; set; }
}

public class PostponeTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<PostponeTaskCommandRequest, PostponeResultDto>
{
    private const int MaxPostponeCount = 3;
    private const decimal PostponeXpRate = 0.70m;

    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;

    public PostponeTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<PostponeResultDto> Handle(PostponeTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.PostponeCount >= MaxPostponeCount)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Bu görevi artık erteleyemezsin (maks {MaxPostponeCount} erteleme). Vazgeç ya da tamamla.");

        userTask.IsPostponed = true;
        userTask.PostponeCount++;
        userTask.PostponedTo = request.PostponeTo;
        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Postponed;
        userTask.SkipReason = request.SkipReason;
        userTask.XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate;

        _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(userTask);

        // Kullanıcının toplam erteleme sayısını artır
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user != null)
        {
            user.TotalPostponeCount++;
            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        }

        // Yarın için aynı görevi Suggested statüsüyle yeni UserTask oluştur
        var tomorrowTask = new UserTask
        {
            AppUserId = request.UserId,
            AppTaskId = userTask.AppTaskId,
            Status = AppTaskStatus.Suggested,
            DueDate = DateTime.SpecifyKind(request.PostponeTo.ToDateTime(TimeOnly.MinValue), DateTimeKind.Utc),
            IsPostponed = true,
            PostponeCount = userTask.PostponeCount,
            XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate
        };
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(tomorrowTask);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new PostponeResultDto
        {
            UserTaskId = userTask.Id,
            PostponedTo = request.PostponeTo,
            PostponeCount = userTask.PostponeCount,
            RemainingPostpones = MaxPostponeCount - userTask.PostponeCount,
            XpCompensationRate = PostponeXpRate,
            Message = $"{userTask.AppTask.Title} {request.PostponeTo:dd.MM}'e ertelendi. Tamamlarsan {(int)(userTask.AppTask.BaseXP * PostponeXpRate)} XP kazanacaksın!"
        };
    }
}

using FluentValidation;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PostponeTask;

public class PostponeTaskCommandValidator : AbstractValidator<PostponeTaskCommandRequest>
{
    public PostponeTaskCommandValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.UserId)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Kullanıcı kimliği belirtilmelidir.");

        RuleFor(x => x.UserTaskId)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage("Görev kimliği belirtilmelidir.");

        RuleFor(x => x.PostponeTo)
            .Must(date => date > DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow))
            .WithMessage("Erteleme tarihi bugünden ileri bir tarih olmalıdır.");

        RuleFor(x => x.SkipReason)
            .MaximumLength(500).WithMessage("Erteleme nedeni en fazla 500 karakter olabilir.")
            .When(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.SkipReason));
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Commands\SelectTask\SelectTaskCommand.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.SelectTask;

public class SelectTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    /// <summary>SP-05: Kullanıcı limit uyarısını onaylayıp aşmak istiyorsa true.</summary>
    public bool ForceOverLimit { get; set; } = false;
}

public class SelectTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<SelectTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public SelectTaskCommandHandler(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(SelectTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Kullanıcıyı çek
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(request.UserId.ToString(), tracking: true)
            ?? throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // ─── SP-05: DailyLimitRule ─────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.TodayTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit)
        {
            if (!request.ForceOverLimit || user.OverLimitWarningShown)
                throw new Exception($"Bugün için görev limitine ({user.TodayTaskCount}/{user.DailyTaskLimit}) ulaştın. Yarın yeni görev alabilirsin veya limitini ayarlardan değiştirebilirsin.");

            // İlk kez aşıyor, uyarı flag'ini set et
            user.OverLimitWarningShown = true;
        }

        // ─── SP-05: ActiveLimitRule ────────────────────────────────────────
        if (user.ActiveTaskCount >= user.DailyTaskLimit * 2)
            throw new Exception($"Henüz tamamlanmamış {user.ActiveTaskCount}/{user.DailyTaskLimit * 2} görevin var. Önce mevcut görevlerini tamamla veya ertele.");

        var userTask = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.Suggested)
            throw new Exception("Yalnızca önerilmiş görevler seçilebilir.");

        // Bugünkü mood'dan energy ve mood snapshot al
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Selected;
        userTask.UserEnergyAtStart = todayMood?.EnergyLevel;
        userTask.UserMoodAtStart = todayMood?.MoodMode;

        // SP-05: Sayaçları güncelle
        user.TodayTaskCount++;
        user.ActiveTaskCount++;
        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(userTask);
        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
            request.UserId,
            "Görev seçildi!",
            $"'{userTask.AppTask?.Title}' görevini seçtin. Hadi başlayalım!",
            "TaskSelected");

        return new UserTaskDto
        {
            Id = userTask.Id,
            Title = userTask.AppTask?.Title ?? string.Empty,
            Description = userTask.AppTask?.Description ?? string.Empty,
            Xp = userTask.EarnedXp,
            BaseXP = userTask.AppTask?.BaseXP ?? 0,
            Difficulty = userTask.AppTask?.Difficulty.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
            IsCompleted = userTask.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed,
            AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.ShareUserTask;

public sealed class ShareUserTaskCommandHandler 
    : IRequestHandler<ShareUserTaskCommandRequest, ShareUserTaskCommandResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public ShareUserTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<ShareUserTaskCommandResponse> Handle(ShareUserTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository.Table
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, cancellationToken);

        if (userTask == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Görev bulunamadı." };

        // Token oluştur (UUID)
        userTask.ShareToken = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        userTask.ShareTokenExpiresAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(7);

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            Message = "Paylaşım linki oluşturuldu.",
            ShareToken = userTask.ShareToken,
            ShareUrl = $"/share/{userTask.ShareToken}" // Frontend route
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PauseResumeTask;

// ─── Pause ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class PauseTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
}

public class PauseTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<PauseTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public PauseTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(PauseTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.InProgress)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Yalnızca devam eden görevler duraklatılabilir.");

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Paused;
        userTask.PausedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new UserTaskDto { Id = userTask.Id, IsCompleted = false, Xp = userTask.EarnedXp, AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt };
    }
}

// ─── Resume ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class ResumeTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<UserTaskDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
}

public class ResumeTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<ResumeTaskCommandRequest, UserTaskDto>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public ResumeTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<UserTaskDto> Handle(ResumeTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        if (userTask.Status != AppTaskStatus.Paused)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Yalnızca duraklatılmış görevler devam ettirilebilir.");

        if (userTask.PausedAt.HasValue)
        {
            var pausedMinutes = (int)(DateTime.UtcNow - userTask.PausedAt.Value).TotalMinutes;
            userTask.TotalPausedMinutes += pausedMinutes;
        }

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.InProgress;
        userTask.PausedAt = null;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new UserTaskDto { Id = userTask.Id, IsCompleted = false, Xp = userTask.EarnedXp, AssignedAt = userTask.AssignedAt };
    }
}

// ─── Abandon ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
public class AbandonTaskCommandRequest : IRequest<bool>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid UserTaskId { get; set; }
    public string? Reason { get; set; }
}

public class AbandonTaskCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<AbandonTaskCommandRequest, bool>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _writeRepository;

    public AbandonTaskCommandHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository, IUserTaskWriteRepository writeRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
        _writeRepository = writeRepository;
    }

    public async Task<bool> Handle(AbandonTaskCommandRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.Id == request.UserTaskId && ut.AppUserId == request.UserId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new Exception("Görev bulunamadı.");

        userTask.Status = AppTaskStatus.Abandoned;
        userTask.SkipReason = request.Reason;

        _writeRepository.Update(userTask);
        await _writeRepository.SaveAsync();

        return true;
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetDailyTaskPool;

public class GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest : IRequest<DailyTaskPoolDto>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public int Count { get; set; } = 6;
}

public class GetDailyTaskPoolQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest, DailyTaskPoolDto>
{
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _recommendationService;

    public GetDailyTaskPoolQueryHandler(
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        ITaskRecommendationService recommendationService)
    {
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _recommendationService = recommendationService;
    }

    public async Task<DailyTaskPoolDto> Handle(GetDailyTaskPoolQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        // Bugün zaten önerilmiş görevler varsa onları döndür
        var existingSuggested = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId
                && (ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Selected)
                && ut.DueDate.HasValue
                && DateOnly.FromDateTime(ut.DueDate.Value) == today, tracking: false)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        // Bugünkü mood kaydını çek (yoksa default)
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == request.UserId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var moodMode = todayMood?.MoodMode ?? MoodMode.Normal;
        var availableMinutes = todayMood?.AvailableMinutes ?? 30;
        var energyLevel = todayMood?.EnergyLevel ?? 3;
        var timeSlot = DayTimeSlotExtensions.FromHour(DateTime.UtcNow.Hour);

        if (existingSuggested.Count >= request.Count)
        {
            return new DailyTaskPoolDto
            {
                Tasks = existingSuggested.Select(ut => new TaskRecommendationDto
                {
                    UserTaskId = ut.Id,
                    AppTaskId = ut.AppTaskId,
                    Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                    Description = ut.AppTask.Description,
                    CategoryName = ut.AppTask.Category?.Name ?? string.Empty,
                    EstimatedMinutes = ut.AppTask.EstimatedMinutes,
                    BaseXP = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                    Difficulty = ut.AppTask.Difficulty.ToString(),
                    WhyThisTask = ut.AppTask.WhyThisTask,
                    BadgeHint = ut.AppTask.BadgeHint,
                    MatchScore = 0.8,
                    RecommendationReason = "Bugün için daha önce önerildi",
                    Status = ut.Status.ToString()
                }).ToList(),
                TodayMood = moodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = availableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = energyLevel,
                TimeSlot = timeSlot,
                PoolGeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
        }

        // Yeni öneri oluştur
        var recommendations = await _recommendationService.GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
            request.UserId, moodMode, timeSlot, energyLevel, availableMinutes, request.Count);

        return new DailyTaskPoolDto
        {
            Tasks = recommendations,
            TodayMood = moodMode,
            AvailableMinutes = availableMinutes,
            EnergyLevel = energyLevel,
            TimeSlot = timeSlot,
            PoolGeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetSharedTaskByToken;

public sealed class GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryHandler 
    : IRequestHandler<GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryRequest, GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _readRepository;

    public GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository readRepository)
    {
        _readRepository = readRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryResponse> Handle(GetSharedTaskByTokenQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userTask = await _readRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppUser)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ut => ut.ShareToken == request.Token, cancellationToken);

        if (userTask == null)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Geçersiz veya süresi dolmuş paylaşım linki." };

        if (userTask.ShareTokenExpiresAt.HasValue && userTask.ShareTokenExpiresAt.Value < DateTime.UtcNow)
            return new() { Success = false, Message = "Bu paylaşım linkinin süresi dolmuş." };

        return new()
        {
            Success = true,
            TaskTitle = userTask.AppTask.Title,
            TaskDescription = userTask.AppTask.Description,
            CategoryName = userTask.AppTask.Category.Name,
            CategoryIcon = userTask.AppTask.Category.IconPath,
            UserName = $"{userTask.AppUser.Name} {userTask.AppUser.Surname}",
            CompletedAt = userTask.CompletedAt,
            ReflectionText = userTask.ReflectionText,
            Tags = userTask.CustomTags ?? userTask.AppTask.Tags
        };
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Application\Features\UserTasks\Queries\GetUserTasks\GetUserTasksQueryHandler.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetUserTasks;

public sealed class GetUserTasksQueryHandler : IRequestHandler<GetUserTasksQueryRequest, GetUserTasksQueryResponse>
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public GetUserTasksQueryHandler(IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    public async Task<GetUserTasksQueryResponse> Handle(GetUserTasksQueryRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        IQueryable<UserTask> query = _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == request.UserId && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Suggested, tracking: false)
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category);

        if (request.CategoryId.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(ut => ut.AppTask.CategoryId == request.CategoryId.Value);
        }

        var tasks = await query
            .OrderBy(ut => ut.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .ThenByDescending(ut => ut.AssignedAt)
            .Select(ut => new UserTaskDto
            {
                Id = ut.Id,
                AppTaskId = ut.AppTaskId,
                Title = ut.AppTask.Title,
                Description = ut.AppTask.Description,
                Xp = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                BaseXP = ut.AppTask.BaseXP,
                Difficulty = ut.AppTask.Difficulty.ToString(),
                IsCompleted = ut.CompletedAt.HasValue,
                CompletedAt = ut.CompletedAt,
                AssignedAt = ut.AssignedAt,
                CategoryName = ut.AppTask.Category != null ? ut.AppTask.Category.Name : null,
                Status = ut.Status.ToString(),
                PostponedTo = ut.PostponedTo
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new GetUserTasksQueryResponse
        {
            Tasks = tasks
        };
    }
}

using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

public sealed class AppTask : BaseEntity
{
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    public Guid CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category Category { get; set; } = default!;

    public int MinLevel { get; set; }
    public int MaxLevel { get; set; }
    public int BaseXP { get; set; }

    public DifficultyLevel Difficulty { get; set; }
    public bool IsDaily { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
    public bool IsCustom { get; set; } = false;
    public Guid? CreatedByUserId { get; set; }

    // ─── SP-01: Yeni Alanlar ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Görevin tahmini süresi (dakika)</summary>
    public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi zaman dilimlerinde önerilsin — jsonb (ör: ["Morning","Noon"])</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<DayTimeSlot>? RecommendedTimeSlots { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Görev küçük parçalara bölünebilir mi?</summary>
    public bool IsChunkable { get; set; } = false;

    /// <summary>Parçalanabilir görevlerde minimum parça süresi (dakika)</summary>
    public int? ChunkMinutes { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Görevi yapabilmek için minimum enerji seviyesi (1-5)</summary>
    public int MinEnergyLevel { get; set; } = 1;

    /// <summary>Görevi yapabilmek için maksimum enerji seviyesi (1-5)</summary>
    public int MaxEnergyLevel { get; set; } = 5;

    /// <summary>Görevin neden önerildiğini açıklayan metin</summary>
    public string? WhyThisTask { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Rozet ipucu metni (ör: "3 gün üst üste yaparsan Demir İrade rozetini açarsın!")</summary>
    public string? BadgeHint { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi zayıflıkları hedefliyor — jsonb</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? TargetedWeaknesses { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Hangi hedefleri destekliyor — jsonb</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? TargetedGoals { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Görev etiketleri — FEAT-008</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? Tags { get; set; }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Core\LifeQuestAPI.Domain\Entities\Challenge.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

public sealed class Challenge : BaseEntity
{
    public Guid ChallengerId { get; set; }
    public AppUser Challenger { get; set; } = default!;

    public Guid OpponentId { get; set; }
    public AppUser Opponent { get; set; } = default!;

    // ─── SP-05: Mücadele Tipi ve Durum ───────────────────────────────────
    public ChallengeType ChallengeType { get; set; } = ChallengeType.TaskCount;
    public ChallengeStatus Status { get; set; } = ChallengeStatus.Invited;

    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? Description { get; set; }

    /// <summary>CategoryFocus tipinde hedeflenen kategori.</summary>
    public Guid? TargetCategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category? TargetCategory { get; set; }

    /// <summary>SpecificTask tipinde hedeflenen görev.</summary>
    public Guid? TargetAppTaskId { get; set; }
    public AppTask? TargetAppTask { get; set; }

    /// <summary>TaskCount: kaç görev, XPRace: kaç XP. Null ise süre sonunda en yüksek kazanır.</summary>
    public int? TargetValue { get; set; }

    // ─── İlerleme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public int ChallengerProgress { get; set; } = 0;
    public int OpponentProgress { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── Sonuç ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public Guid? WinnerId { get; set; }
    public int WinnerXPBonus { get; set; } = 100;
    public int LoserXPPenalty { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── Tarihler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public DateTime StartDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime InvitedAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public DateTime? AcceptedAt { get; set; }

    // ─── Davet ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string? ChallengerMessage { get; set; }
    public bool IsPublic { get; set; } = false;

    // ─── Geriye Dönük Uyumluluk (Eski alanları eşliyoruz) ─────────────────
    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public bool IsActive => Status == ChallengeStatus.Active;

    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public int TargetTaskCount => TargetValue ?? 0;

    [System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema.NotMapped]
    public int WinnerBonusXP => WinnerXPBonus;

    // ─── Eski alanlar (CategoryFocus için hâlâ kullanılıyor) ──────────────
    public Guid? CategoryId { get; set; }
    public Category? Category { get; set; }

    // ─── Navigation Properties ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    public ICollection<ChallengeParticipant> Participants { get; set; } = default!;
}

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;

public sealed class AppUser : BaseEntity
{
    // ─── Temel Kimlik Bilgileri ────────────────────────────────────────────
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Surname { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string FullName => $"{Name} {Surname}";
    public string UserName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Email { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public bool IsEmailVerified { get; set; } = false;
    public string? EmailVerificationToken { get; set; }
    public DateTime? EmailVerificationTokenExpiry { get; set; }

    public string? PasswordResetToken { get; set; }
    public DateTime? PasswordResetTokenExpiry { get; set; }

    public string? RefreshToken { get; set; }
    public DateTime? RefreshTokenExpiryTime { get; set; }

    public byte[] PasswordHash { get; set; } = default!;
    public byte[] PasswordSalt { get; set; } = default!;
    public Guid AppRoleId { get; set; }
    public AppRole AppRole { get; set; } = default!;

    // ─── Phase 4: Social & Profile ────────────────────────────────────────
    public string? Bio { get; set; }
    public string? Location { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>İlgi alanları (ör: ["fitness", "tech", "art"])</summary>
    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? Interests { get; set; }

    // ─── Gamification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    public int TotalXP { get; set; } = 0;
    public double GeneralLevel { get; set; } = 1.0;

    // MISS-004: Streak sistemi
    public int CurrentStreak { get; set; } = 0;
    public int LongestStreak { get; set; } = 0;
    public DateOnly? LastTaskCompletedDate { get; set; }

    // ─── Anket / Profil Alanları (SP-01) ──────────────────────────────────

    [Column("UserGoals", TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? UserGoals { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Günlük ortalama müsait süre (dakika)</summary>

    [Column(TypeName = "jsonb")]
    public List<string>? Strengths { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Motivasyon faktörü: leveling/badges/social/streaks/reports</summary>

    /// <summary>Haftada kaç görev tercih ediyor</summary>
    public int? PreferredTasksPerWeek { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Zorluk tercihi: easy/medium/hard/mixed</summary>
    public string? DifficultyPreference { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Profil anketi tamamlandı mı?</summary>
    public bool ProfileCompleted { get; set; } = false;

    public DateTime? ProfileCompletedAt { get; set; }

    // ─── Davranış İstatistikleri (SP-01) ──────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Son 30 günün ortalama aktif dakikası (sistem hesaplar)</summary>
    public int AverageDailyActiveMinutes { get; set; } = 0;

    // ─── SP-04: Tatil / Mola Modu ─────────────────────────────────────────

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

/// <summary>
/// Görev durum enum'u — SP-01 ile genişletildi.
/// Migration notu: eski Assigned=0 → Suggested=0 (otomatik uyumlu),
/// eski Completed=1 → Completed=4 (veri migration'ı gerekli).
/// </summary>
public enum AppTaskStatus
{
    Pending = 0,      // Bekliyor
    InProgress = 1,   // Timer çalışıyor
    Completed = 2,    // Tamamlandı
    Failed = 3,       // Başarısız
    Expired = 4,      // Süresi doldu
    Suggested = 5,    // Sistem tarafından önerildi, kullanıcı henüz seçmedi
    Selected = 6,     // Kullanıcı seçti, henüz başlamadı
    Paused = 7,       // Duraklat
    Postponed = 8,    // Ertelendi
    Compensated = 9,  // Ertelenmiş görev telafi edildi
    Abandoned = 10    // Vazgeçildi
}

    /// <summary>Belirli sürede en çok görevi tamamla.</summary>

    /// <summary>Belirli sürede en çok XP kazan.</summary>

    /// <summary>Seriyi kim daha uzun tutar.</summary>
    StreakBattle = 2,

    /// <summary>Belirli kategoride en çok görev.</summary>
    CategoryFocus = 3,

    /// <summary>Aynı görevi kim önce tamamlar.</summary>

}

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;

public enum DayTimeSlot
{
    Morning = 0,   // 06:00 - 11:00
    Noon = 1,      // 11:00 - 14:00
    Afternoon = 2, // 14:00 - 18:00
    Evening = 3,   // 18:00 - 22:00
    Night = 4      // 22:00 - 06:00
}

public static class DayTimeSlotExtensions
{
    public static DayTimeSlot FromHour(int hour)
    {
        return hour switch
        {
            >= 6 and < 11 => DayTimeSlot.Morning,
            >= 11 and < 14 => DayTimeSlot.Noon,
            >= 14 and < 18 => DayTimeSlot.Afternoon,
            >= 18 and < 22 => DayTimeSlot.Evening,
            _ => DayTimeSlot.Night
        };
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Email;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Token;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.BehaviorAnalysis;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Email;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Token;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Polly;
using Polly.Extensions.Http;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddInfrastructureServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        // Mevcut servisler
        services.AddScoped<ITokenService, JwtTokenService>();
        services.AddScoped<IEmailService, SmtpEmailService>();
        services.AddScoped<IGamificationService, GamificationService>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementService, AchievementService>();
        services.AddScoped<IDailyQuestService, DailyQuestService>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeService, ChallengeService>();

        // SP-01: Bağlam-duyarlı görev öneri servisi (explicit namespace - isim çakışması önleme)
        services.AddScoped<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.ITaskRecommendationService,
            LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest.TaskRecommendationService>();

        // SP-03: Davranış analizi servisi
        services.AddScoped<IUserBehaviorAnalysisService, UserBehaviorAnalysisService>();

        // AI Chat servisi — Python mikro servise bağlanır
        // MISS-010: 5s timeout + 3 retry (exponential backoff) + circuit breaker
        var aiServiceBaseUrl = configuration["AIService:BaseUrl"] ?? "http://localhost:5001";

        var retryPolicy = HttpPolicyExtensions
            .HandleTransientHttpError()
            .WaitAndRetryAsync(3, retryAttempt =>
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt))); // 2s, 4s, 8s

        var circuitBreakerPolicy = HttpPolicyExtensions
            .HandleTransientHttpError()
            .CircuitBreakerAsync(
                handledEventsAllowedBeforeBreaking: 5,
                durationOfBreak: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30));

        services.AddHttpClient<IAIChatService, AIChatService>(client =>
        {
            client.BaseAddress = new Uri(aiServiceBaseUrl);
            client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10); // MISS-010: 5s yerine 10s (3 deneme için)
        })
        .ConfigurePrimaryHttpMessageHandler(() => new HttpClientHandler
        {
            ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = (sender, cert, chain, sslPolicyErrors) => true
        })
        .AddPolicyHandler(retryPolicy)
        .AddPolicyHandler(circuitBreakerPolicy);
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure\Services\AI\AIChatService.cs
