using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;

/// <summary>
/// Python AI mikro servisine HTTP isteği atarak chatbot işlevselliği sağlar.
/// SP-02: Context-aware yanıt + action desteği eklendi.
/// </summary>
public class AIChatService : IAIChatService
{
    private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly ILogger<AIChatService> _logger;

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions _jsonOptions = new()
    {
        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower,
        DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull
    };

    public AIChatService(HttpClient httpClient, ILogger<AIChatService> logger)
    {
        _httpClient = httpClient;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    // SP-01 uyumluluk — eski çağrılar için
    public async Task<ChatBotResponse> ProcessMessageAsync(Guid userId, string message)
    {
        try
        {
            var request = new AIChatRequest { UserId = userId.ToString(), Message = message };
            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/chat", request);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<AIChatApiResponse>();
            if (result == null) return GetFallbackResponse();

            return new ChatBotResponse
            {
                Intent = result.Intent,
                Confidence = result.Confidence,
                Response = result.Response,
                Sentiment = result.Sentiment,
                SentimentConfidence = result.SentimentConfidence,
                Suggestions = result.Suggestions
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI chat hatası. UserId: {UserId}", userId);
            return GetFallbackResponse();
        }
    }

    // SP-02: Context-aware yanıt
    public async Task<ChatResponseDto> ProcessMessageWithContextAsync(Guid userId, string message, ChatContextDto context)
    {
        try
        {
            var request = new AIChatContextRequest
            {
                UserId = userId.ToString(),
                Message = message,
                Context = new AIChatContextPayload
                {
                    UserName = context.UserName,
                    Personality = context.Personality,
                    TodayTasks = context.TodayTasks.Select(t => new AIChatTaskContext
                    {
                        Id = t.Id.ToString(),
                        Title = t.Title,
                        Status = t.Status,
                        Category = t.Category,
                        EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes
                    }).ToList(),
                    CompletedToday = context.CompletedToday,
                    CurrentStreak = context.CurrentStreak,
                    TotalXp = context.TotalXP,
                    TodayMood = context.TodayMood,
                    AvailableMinutes = context.AvailableMinutes
                }
            };

            var response = await _httpClient.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/chat", request, _jsonOptions);
            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<AIChatContextApiResponse>(_jsonOptions);
            if (result == null) return GetFallbackContextResponse();

            return new ChatResponseDto
            {
                Intent = result.Intent,
                IntentConfidence = result.IntentConfidence,
                Sentiment = result.Sentiment,
                SentimentConfidence = result.SentimentConfidence,
                UrgencyLevel = result.UrgencyLevel,
                Response = result.Response,
                Suggestions = result.Suggestions ?? new(),
                Actions = (result.Actions ?? new()).Select(a => new ChatActionDto
                {
                    Type = a.Type,
                    Label = a.Label,
                    TaskId = a.TaskId.HasValue ? a.TaskId : null,
                    Payload = a.Payload
                }).ToList(),
                SuggestedTasks = result.SuggestedTasks?.Select(t => new MiniTaskDto
                {
                    TaskId = Guid.TryParse(t.TaskId, out var tid) ? tid : Guid.Empty,
                    Title = t.Title,
                    CategoryName = t.CategoryName,
                    EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes,
                    BaseXP = t.BaseXp,
                    Difficulty = t.Difficulty,
                    WhyThisTask = t.WhyThisTask
                }).ToList(),
                ShouldShowMoodSelector = result.ShouldShowMoodSelector
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI context chat hatası. UserId: {UserId}", userId);
            return GetFallbackContextResponse();
        }
    }

    private static ChatBotResponse GetFallbackResponse() => new()
    {
        Intent = "unknown",
        Confidence = 0,
        Response = "Şu anda AI asistanına ulaşamıyorum. Lütfen daha sonra tekrar dene! 🔄",
        Sentiment = "neutral",
        SentimentConfidence = 0,
        Suggestions = new() { "Görevlerim", "Profilim", "Yardım" }
    };

    private static ChatResponseDto GetFallbackContextResponse() => new()
    {
        Intent = "unknown",
        IntentConfidence = 0,
        Sentiment = "neutral",
        SentimentConfidence = 0,
        UrgencyLevel = 0,
        Response = "Şu anda AI asistanına ulaşamıyorum. Lütfen daha sonra tekrar dene! 🔄",
        Suggestions = new() { "Görevlerim", "Profilim", "Yardım" },
        Actions = new()
    };

    // ─── Request/Response iç modelleri ───────────────────────────────────────

    private class AIChatRequest
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_id")] public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("message")] public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }

    private class AIChatContextRequest
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_id")] public string UserId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("message")] public string Message { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("context")] public AIChatContextPayload? Context { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatContextPayload
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("user_name")] public string UserName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("personality")] public string Personality { get; set; } = "friendly";
        [JsonPropertyName("today_tasks")] public List<AIChatTaskContext> TodayTasks { get; set; } = new();
        [JsonPropertyName("completed_today")] public int CompletedToday { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("current_streak")] public int CurrentStreak { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("total_xp")] public int TotalXp { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("today_mood")] public string? TodayMood { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("available_minutes")] public int AvailableMinutes { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatTaskContext
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("id")] public string Id { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("title")] public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("status")] public string Status { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("category")] public string Category { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("estimated_minutes")] public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatApiResponse
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("intent")] public string Intent { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("confidence")] public float Confidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("response")] public string Response { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment")] public string Sentiment { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment_confidence")] public float SentimentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("suggestions")] public List<string> Suggestions { get; set; } = new();
    }

    private class AIChatContextApiResponse
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("intent")] public string Intent { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("intent_confidence")] public float IntentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment")] public string Sentiment { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("sentiment_confidence")] public float SentimentConfidence { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("urgency_level")] public int UrgencyLevel { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("response")] public string Response { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("suggestions")] public List<string>? Suggestions { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("actions")] public List<AIChatActionItem>? Actions { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("suggested_tasks")] public List<AIChatMiniTask>? SuggestedTasks { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("should_show_mood_selector")] public bool ShouldShowMoodSelector { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatActionItem
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("type")] public string Type { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("label")] public string Label { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("task_id")] public Guid? TaskId { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("payload")] public Dictionary<string, string>? Payload { get; set; }
    }

    private class AIChatMiniTask
    {
        [JsonPropertyName("task_id")] public string TaskId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("title")] public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("category_name")] public string CategoryName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("estimated_minutes")] public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("base_xp")] public int BaseXp { get; set; }
        [JsonPropertyName("difficulty")] public string Difficulty { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        [JsonPropertyName("why_this_task")] public string? WhyThisTask { get; set; }
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure\Services\AI\TaskRecommendationService.cs
==================================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.ML;
using Microsoft.ML.Data;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.AI;

public class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    private readonly MLContext _mlContext;
    private readonly ILogger<TaskRecommendationService> _logger;
    private ITransformer? _model;
    
    // Uygulama kök dizininde Models klasörü
    private readonly string _modelPath = Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Models", "task_recommendation_model.zip");

    public bool IsModelReady => _model != null;

    public TaskRecommendationService(ILogger<TaskRecommendationService> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _mlContext = new MLContext(seed: 42);
        LoadModel();
    }

    private void LoadModel()
    {
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(_modelPath))
            {
                _model = _mlContext.Model.Load(_modelPath, out var schema);
                _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET görev öneri modeli başarıyla yüklendi.");
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("ML.NET görev öneri modeli bulunamadı: {ModelPath}. Model eğitilene kadar kural tabanlı öneri kullanılacak.", _modelPath);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "ML.NET görev öneri modeli yüklenirken hata oluştu.");
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<Guid>> GetRecommendedTasksAsync(AppUser user, List<AppTask> availableTasks, int count = 3)
    {
        if (availableTasks == null || !availableTasks.Any())
            return new List<Guid>();

        // Eğer model yoksa Kural Tabanlı Fallback kullan
        if (!IsModelReady)
        {
            return GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }

        try 
        {
            var predEngine = _mlContext.Model.CreatePredictionEngine<TaskInteractionData, TaskPrediction>(_model);

            var scoredTasks = availableTasks.Select(task =>
            {
                var userCatLevelObj = user.CategoryProgresses?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
                float userCatLevel = userCatLevelObj != null ? userCatLevelObj.Level : 1f;

                var inputData = new TaskInteractionData
                {
                    UserLevel = (float)user.GeneralLevel,
                    UserCategoryLevel = userCatLevel,
                    TaskDifficulty = (float)task.Difficulty,
                    TaskBaseXP = task.BaseXP,
                    DayOfWeek = (float)DateTime.Now.DayOfWeek,
                    HourOfDay = DateTime.Now.Hour,
                    UserCompletedTaskCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0,
                    UserStreakDays = 0 // Eğer streak prop'u varsa kullanılabilir, şu an sabit
                };

                var prediction = predEngine.Predict(inputData);

                return new 
                {
                    Task = task,
                    Score = prediction.Probability
                };
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .Take(count)
            .Select(x => x.Task.Id)
            .ToList();

            return scoredTasks.Any() ? scoredTasks : GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "ML modeli ile görev tahmini yapılırken hata, fallback kullanılacak.");
            return GetRuleBasedRecommendations(user, availableTasks, count);
        }
    }

    private List<Guid> GetRuleBasedRecommendations(AppUser user, List<AppTask> availableTasks, int count)
    {
        return availableTasks.Where(task => 
        {
            if (task.MinLevel > user.GeneralLevel) return false;

            if (task.CategoryId != Guid.Empty && user.CategoryProgresses != null)
            {
                var userCatProgress = user.CategoryProgresses.FirstOrDefault(cp => cp.CategoryId == task.CategoryId);
                int userCatLevel = userCatProgress?.Level ?? 1;

                switch (task.Difficulty)
                {
                    case DifficultyLevel.Medium:
                        if (userCatLevel < 2) return false;
                        break;
                    case DifficultyLevel.Hard:
                        if (userCatLevel < 4) return false;
                        break;
                }
            }
            return true;
        })
        .OrderBy(x => Guid.NewGuid()) // Geçici kural: randomize et
        .Take(count)
        .Select(t => t.Id)
        .ToList();
    }

    public async Task<bool> TrainModelAsync(List<UserTaskInteraction> trainingData)
    {
        if (trainingData == null || trainingData.Count < 50)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Model eğitmek için yetersiz veri. En az 50 kayıt gerekli. Mevcut: {Count}", trainingData?.Count ?? 0);
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            var dataMapped = trainingData.Select(x => new TaskInteractionData
            {
                UserLevel = x.UserLevel,
                UserCategoryLevel = x.UserCategoryLevel,
                TaskDifficulty = x.TaskDifficulty,
                TaskBaseXP = x.TaskBaseXP,
                DayOfWeek = x.DayOfWeek,
                HourOfDay = x.HourOfDay,
                UserCompletedTaskCount = x.UserCompletedTaskCount,
                UserStreakDays = x.UserStreakDays,
                WasCompleted = x.WasCompleted
            }).ToList();

            var dataView = _mlContext.Data.LoadFromEnumerable(dataMapped);

            var pipeline = _mlContext.Transforms.Concatenate("Features",
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserLevel),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserCategoryLevel),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.TaskDifficulty),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.TaskBaseXP),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.DayOfWeek),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.HourOfDay),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserCompletedTaskCount),
                    nameof(TaskInteractionData.UserStreakDays))
                .Append(_mlContext.Transforms.NormalizeMinMax("Features"))
                .Append(_mlContext.BinaryClassification.Trainers.FastTree(labelColumnName: "WasCompleted", featureColumnName: "Features"));

            _model = pipeline.Fit(dataView);

            var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(_modelPath);
            if (dir != null && !Directory.Exists(dir))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
            }

            _mlContext.Model.Save(_model, dataView.Schema, _modelPath);
            _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET modeli başarıyla eğitildi ve {Path} konumuna kaydedildi.", _modelPath);

            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Model eğitilirken bir hata oluştu.");
            return false;
        }
    }

    // --- ML.NET Data Models ---
    public class TaskInteractionData
    {
        public float UserLevel { get; set; }
        public float UserCategoryLevel { get; set; }
        public float TaskDifficulty { get; set; }
        public float TaskBaseXP { get; set; }
        public float DayOfWeek { get; set; }
        public float HourOfDay { get; set; }
        public float UserCompletedTaskCount { get; set; }
        public float UserStreakDays { get; set; }
        public bool WasCompleted { get; set; }
    }

    public class TaskPrediction
    {
        [ColumnName("PredictedLabel")]
        public bool WillComplete { get; set; }
        public float Probability { get; set; }
        public float Score { get; set; }
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure\Services\BehaviorAnalysis\UserBehaviorAnalysisService.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.BehaviorAnalysis;

/// <summary>
/// SP-03: Son 30 günün UserTask davranışını analiz eder.
/// Haftalık rapor sonrası WeeklyReportWorker tarafından tetiklenir.
/// </summary>
public sealed class UserBehaviorAnalysisService : IUserBehaviorAnalysisService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<UserBehaviorAnalysisService> _logger;

    public UserBehaviorAnalysisService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        ILogger<UserBehaviorAnalysisService> logger)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task AnalyzeAndUpdateUserBehaviorAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);

            var tasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
                .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
                .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            if (!tasks.Any()) return;

            var user = await _userReadRepository
                .GetWhere(u => u.Id == userId, tracking: true)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
            if (user == null) return;

            // ── AverageDailyActiveMinutes — EstimatedMinutes proxy olarak kullan ──
            var completedTasks = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
            user.AverageDailyActiveMinutes = completedTasks.Any()
                ? (int)completedTasks
                    .Where(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
                    .DefaultIfEmpty()
                    .Average(t => t?.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes ?? 0)
                : 0;

            // ── MostSkippedCategory ────────────────────────────────────────
            var skippedByCategory = tasks
                .Where(t => t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Abandoned or AppTaskStatus.Expired)
                .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .FirstOrDefault();
            user.MostSkippedCategory = skippedByCategory?.Key;

            // ── TotalPostponeCount ─────────────────────────────────────────
            user.TotalPostponeCount = tasks.Sum(t => t.PostponeCount);

            // ── PreferredMorningTime — en çok tamamlanan saat dilimi ───────
            var bestSlot = completedTasks
                .Where(t => t.DayTimeSlot.HasValue)
                .GroupBy(t => t.DayTimeSlot!.Value)
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
                .Select(g => g.Key)
                .FirstOrDefault();
            user.PreferredMorningTime = SlotToTime(bestSlot);

            _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
            await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("SP-03: Davranış analizi güncellendi — UserId: {UserId}", userId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "SP-03: Davranış analizi hatası — UserId: {UserId}", userId);
        }
    }

    public async Task<UserBehaviorSummaryDto> GetBehaviorSummaryAsync(
        Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var tasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var completed = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
        var abandoned = tasks.Where(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Abandoned).ToList();

        // ── Tamamlama oranı ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        double completionRate = tasks.Count > 0
            ? (double)completed.Count / tasks.Count
            : 0.0;

        // ── En çok tamamlanan / atlanan kategori ──────────────────────────
        var mostCompleted = completed
            .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .FirstOrDefault()?.Key;

        var mostSkipped = tasks
            .Where(t => t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Abandoned or AppTaskStatus.Expired)
            .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask?.Category?.Name ?? "Diğer")
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .FirstOrDefault()?.Key;

        // ── En verimli saat dilimi ─────────────────────────────────────────
        var bestSlot = completed
            .Where(t => t.DayTimeSlot.HasValue)
            .GroupBy(t => t.DayTimeSlot!.Value)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .Select(g => g.Key)
            .FirstOrDefault();
        string bestTimeLabel = SlotToLabel(bestSlot);

        // ── Ortalama aktif dakika (EstimatedMinutes proxy) ─────────────────
        int avgMinutes = completed.Any(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
            ? (int)completed.Where(t => t.AppTask?.EstimatedMinutes > 0)
                .Average(t => t.AppTask!.EstimatedMinutes!.Value)
            : 0;

        // ── Streak hesaplama ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        var (current, longest) = CalculateStreaks(completed, today);

         // ── Son 7 gün günlük özet ──────────────────────────────────────────
        var weeklyProgress = Enumerable.Range(0, 7)
            .Select(i =>
            {
                var date = today.AddDays(-6 + i);
                var completedThatDay = tasks.Where(t =>
                    t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed && t.CompletedAt.HasValue &&
                    DateOnly.FromDateTime(t.CompletedAt.Value) == date).ToList();
                var dayTasks = tasks.Where(t =>
                    DateOnly.FromDateTime(t.AssignedAt) == date).ToList();

                return new DayProgressDto
                {
                    Date = date,
                    DayName = date.DayOfWeek switch
                    {
                        DayOfWeek.Monday    => "Pzt",
                        DayOfWeek.Tuesday   => "Sal",
                        DayOfWeek.Wednesday => "Çar",
                        DayOfWeek.Thursday  => "Per",
                        DayOfWeek.Friday    => "Cum",
                        DayOfWeek.Saturday  => "Cmt",
                        DayOfWeek.Sunday    => "Paz",
                        _                   => "?"
                    },
                    CompletedCount  = completedThatDay.Count,
                    PostponedCount  = dayTasks.Count(t => t.PostponeCount > 0),
                    AbandonedCount  = dayTasks.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Abandoned),
                    TotalXpEarned   = completedThatDay.Sum(t => t.EarnedXp)
                };
            })
            .ToList();

        // ── Insight mesajı ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        string? insight = BuildInsightMessage(completionRate, mostSkipped, bestTimeLabel, current);

        return new UserBehaviorSummaryDto
        {
            AverageDailyActiveMinutes  = avgMinutes,
            BestTimeOfDay              = bestTimeLabel,
            MostCompletedCategory      = mostCompleted,
            MostSkippedCategory        = mostSkipped,
            CompletionRateLast30Days   = Math.Round(completionRate, 2),
            TotalCompletedLast30Days   = completed.Count,
            TotalPostponeCount         = tasks.Sum(t => t.PostponeCount),
            AbandonedTaskCount         = abandoned.Count,
            CurrentStreak              = current,
            LongestStreak              = longest,
            WeeklyProgress             = weeklyProgress,
            InsightMessage             = insight
        };
    }

    // ─── Yardımcı ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static (int current, int longest) CalculateStreaks(
        List<Domain.Entities.UserTask> completed, DateOnly today)
    {
        var completedDays = completed
            .Where(t => t.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .Select(t => DateOnly.FromDateTime(t.CompletedAt!.Value))
            .Distinct()
            .OrderByDescending(d => d)
            .ToList();

        if (!completedDays.Any()) return (0, 0);

        int current = 0;
        var check = today;
        foreach (var day in completedDays)
        {
            if (day == check) { current++; check = check.AddDays(-1); }
            else if (day < check) break;
        }

        int longest = 0, streak = 1;
        var sorted = completedDays.OrderBy(d => d).ToList();
        for (int i = 1; i < sorted.Count; i++)
        {
            streak = sorted[i] == sorted[i - 1].AddDays(1) ? streak + 1 : 1;
            if (streak > longest) longest = streak;
        }

        return (current, Math.Max(longest, current));
    }

    private static TimeOnly? SlotToTime(DayTimeSlot? slot) => slot switch
    {
        DayTimeSlot.Morning   => new TimeOnly(7, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Noon      => new TimeOnly(12, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => new TimeOnly(15, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Evening   => new TimeOnly(19, 0),
        DayTimeSlot.Night     => new TimeOnly(22, 0),
        _                     => null
    };

    private static string SlotToLabel(DayTimeSlot? slot) => slot switch
    {
        DayTimeSlot.Morning   => "Sabah",
        DayTimeSlot.Noon      => "Öğle",
        DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => "Öğleden Sonra",
        DayTimeSlot.Evening   => "Akşam",
        DayTimeSlot.Night     => "Gece",
        _                     => "Bilinmiyor"
    };

    private static string? BuildInsightMessage(
        double completionRate, string? mostSkipped, string bestTime, int streak)
    {
        if (completionRate >= 0.8)
            return $"Harika! Son 30 günde %{(int)(completionRate * 100)} tamamlama oranıyla mükemmel gidiyorsun. 🏆";
        if (completionRate < 0.4 && mostSkipped != null)
            return $"'{mostSkipped}' kategorisinde zorlanıyorsun. Bu hafta oradan 1 küçük görev dene. 💪";
        if (streak >= 7)
            return $"{streak} günlük serine devam et! Yarın da bir görev tamamla. 🔥";
        if (bestTime != "Bilinmiyor")
            return $"En verimli zamanın {bestTime}. Görevlerini bu saate planlamayı dene. ⏰";
        return null;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;
public class DailyQuestService : IDailyQuestService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<DailyQuestService> _logger;
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _taskRecommendationService;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;

    public DailyQuestService(
        ILogger<DailyQuestService> logger,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository,
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository,
        ITaskRecommendationService taskRecommendationService)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
        _logger = logger;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
        _taskRecommendationService = taskRecommendationService;
    }

    public async Task DistributeDailyQuestsAsync()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation($"Toplu görev dağıtımı başlıyor... {DateTime.UtcNow}");

        // SP-03 / Phase 3: Eski görevleri temizle
        await ExpireOldTasksAsync();

        var users = await _userReadRepository.GetAll(false)
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            // SP-04: Tatil modundaki kullanıcılara görev atama
            if (user.IsOnVacation)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug("DailyQuestWorker: {UserId} tatil modunda, görev atlanıyor.", user.Id);
                continue;
            }

            var hasTasksToday = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
                .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date);

            if (!hasTasksToday)
            {
                await AssignTasksToSpecificUser(user);
            }
        }
    }

    public async Task<List<Guid>> AssignQuestsToUserAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        var hasActiveTasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId
                && (ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Selected || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.InProgress));

        if (hasActiveTasks)
        {
            throw new Exception("Mevcut görevlerini tamamlamadan yeni görev alamazsın!");
        }

        // SP-05: Kullanıcının günlük limit kontrolünü sağla
        var tasksTakenToday = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .CountAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.AssignedAt.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date);

        if (tasksTakenToday >= user.DailyTaskLimit * 2)
        {
            throw new Exception($"Günlük görev alma limitine ulaştın. Yeni görevleri yarın talep edebilirsin!");
        }

        return await AssignTasksToSpecificUser(user);
    }

    private async Task<List<Guid>> AssignTasksToSpecificUser(AppUser user)
    {
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var todayMood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == user.Id && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        // SP-01: Akıllı öneri motorunu (ML.NET tabanlı) kullanarak en uygun 6 görevi seç
        // Bu servis kendi içinde UserTask kayıtlarını Suggested olarak oluşturur ve kaydeder.
        var recommendations = await _taskRecommendationService.GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
            user.Id,
            todayMood?.MoodMode ?? MoodMode.Normal,
            DayTimeSlot.Morning, // Default değer, gerekirse saate göre hesaplanabilir
            todayMood?.EnergyLevel ?? 3,
            todayMood?.AvailableMinutes ?? 30,
            6);

        _logger.LogInformation($"✅ {user.UserName} kullanıcısına {recommendations.Count} akıllı görev önerildi.");

        return recommendations.Select(r => r.UserTaskId).ToList();
    }

    private async Task ExpireOldTasksAsync()
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // 1. Süresi dolmuş Suggested görevler -> Expired
        var expiredSuggested = await _userTaskReadRepository.GetWhere(ut =>
            ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Suggested &&
            ut.DueDate < now, tracking: true).ToListAsync();

        foreach (var ut in expiredSuggested)
        {
            ut.Status = AppTaskStatus.Expired;
            _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(ut);
        }

        // 2. Süresi dolmuş Selected/InProgress görevler -> Abandoned (Cezalı durum)
        var abandonedTasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.GetWhere(ut =>
            (ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Selected || ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.InProgress) &&
            ut.DueDate < now, tracking: true).ToListAsync();

        foreach (var ut in abandonedTasks)
        {
            ut.Status = AppTaskStatus.Abandoned;
            _userTaskWriteRepository.Update(ut);
        }

        if (expiredSuggested.Any() || abandonedTasks.Any())
        {
            await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
            _logger.LogInformation("Phase 3: {ExpiredCount} öneri süresi doldu, {AbandonedCount} aktif görev terk edildi (Abandoned).",
                expiredSuggested.Count, abandonedTasks.Count);
        }
    }
}

==================================================
DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure\Services\DailyQuest\TaskRecommendationService.cs

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.DailyQuest;

/// <summary>
/// SP-01 + SP-03: Bağlam-duyarlı görev öneri servisi.
/// SP-01: 6 faktörlü scoring: GoalMatch, TimeMatch, EnergyMatch, DifficultyMatch, WeaknessTarget, StrengthMatch
/// SP-03: +3 faktör: BehaviorBonus, MostSkippedPenalty, TimeOfDayBonus
/// </summary>
public sealed class TaskRecommendationService : ITaskRecommendationService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _taskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWriteRepository;

    public TaskRecommendationService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppTaskReadRepository taskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWriteRepository)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _taskReadRepository = taskReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
        _userTaskWriteRepository = userTaskWriteRepository;
    }

    public async Task<List<TaskRecommendationDto>> GetContextualRecommendationsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel,
        int availableMinutes,
        int count = 6)
    {
        // Mood override: Overwhelmed ise max 1 görev
        if (mood == MoodMode.Overwhelmed) count = 1;

        // Kullanıcı profilini al
        var user = await _userReadRepository
            .GetWhere(u => u.Id == userId, tracking: false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı.");

        // Bugün zaten görev atanmış AppTaskId'leri bul (hariç tut)
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);
        var sevenDaysAgo = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-7);

        var userTaskHistory = await _userTaskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.CreatedAt >= sevenDaysAgo, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync();

        var assignedTaskIds = userTaskHistory
            .Where(ut => ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Expired
                && ut.Status != AppTaskStatus.Abandoned
                && (ut.DueDate == null || DateOnly.FromDateTime(ut.DueDate.Value) == today))
            .Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId)
            .ToList();

        var abandonedTaskIds = userTaskHistory
            .Where(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Abandoned)
            .Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId)
            .ToList();

        var recentlyCompletedTaskIds = userTaskHistory
            .Where(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed)
            .Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId)
            .ToList();

        // Uygun görevleri çek
        var candidateTasks = await _taskReadRepository
            .GetWhere(t => t.IsActive
                && !assignedTaskIds.Contains(t.Id)
                && t.MinLevel <= (int)Math.Floor(user.GeneralLevel),
                tracking: false)
            .Include(t => t.Category)
            .ToListAsync();

        // Eğer veritabanında veya aktif havuzda görev kalmadıysa
        if (!candidateTasks.Any())
        {
            candidateTasks = await _taskReadRepository
                .GetWhere(t => t.IsActive && t.MinLevel <= (int)Math.Floor(user.GeneralLevel), tracking: false)
                .Include(t => t.Category)
                .ToListAsync();

            if (!candidateTasks.Any())
            {
                var defaultCategory = await _taskReadRepository.Table.Select(t => t.Category).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
                candidateTasks = new List<Domain.Entities.AppTask>
                {
                    new() { Title = "10 Dakikalık Meditasyon", Description = "Zihnini dinlendir ve odaklan.", BaseXP = 50, IsActive = true, Category = defaultCategory, MinLevel = 1, WhyThisTask = "Zihinsel sağlık için.", EstimatedMinutes = 10, MinEnergyLevel = 1, MaxEnergyLevel = 5 },
                    new() { Title = "Kısa Bir Yürüyüş", Description = "Açık havada 15 dakika yürüyüş yap.", BaseXP = 60, IsActive = true, Category = defaultCategory, MinLevel = 1, WhyThisTask = "Fiziksel zindelik için.", EstimatedMinutes = 15, MinEnergyLevel = 1, MaxEnergyLevel = 5 },
                    new() { Title = "Kitap Oku", Description = "Gelişimin için en az 10 sayfa oku.", BaseXP = 75, IsActive = true, Category = defaultCategory, MinLevel = 1, WhyThisTask = "Kişisel gelişim için.", EstimatedMinutes = 20, MinEnergyLevel = 1, MaxEnergyLevel = 5 }
                };
            }
        }

        // Her görev için puan hesapla
        var scored = candidateTasks
            .Select(task => new
            {
                Task = task,
                Score = CalculateScore(task, user, mood, timeSlot, energyLevel, availableMinutes, abandonedTaskIds, recentlyCompletedTaskIds),
                Reason = BuildReason(task, user, mood, timeSlot, energyLevel)
            })
            .Where(x => x.Score >= 0) // skoru 0 olanları da alsın eğer görev kalmadıysa
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.Score)
            .Take(count)
            .ToList();

        // UserTask olarak kaydet (Status=Suggested)
        var result = new List<TaskRecommendationDto>();
        var selectedCategories = new Dictionary<Guid, int>();

        foreach (var item in scored)
        {
            // Variety bonus: Aynı kategoriden çok fazla öneri varsa puanı düşürmek yerine 
            // burada bir kontrol yapabiliriz ama scored zaten sıralı. 
            // Planda "3.'yü farklı kategoriden seç" diyor.
            var catId = item.Task.CategoryId;
            selectedCategories.TryGetValue(catId, out int catCount);
            if (catCount >= 2) continue; // Basit bir variety check
            
            selectedCategories[catId] = catCount + 1;

            var userTask = new Domain.Entities.UserTask
            {
                AppUserId = userId,
                AppTaskId = item.Task.Id,
                Status = AppTaskStatus.Suggested,
                DayTimeSlot = timeSlot,
                DueDate = DateTime.UtcNow.Date.AddDays(1).AddTicks(-1) // gün sonu
            };
            await _userTaskWriteRepository.AddAsync(userTask);

            result.Add(new TaskRecommendationDto
            {
                UserTaskId = userTask.Id,
                AppTaskId = item.Task.Id,
                Title = item.Task.Title,
                Description = item.Task.Description,
                CategoryName = item.Task.Category?.Name ?? string.Empty,
                EstimatedMinutes = item.Task.EstimatedMinutes.HasValue && item.Task.EstimatedMinutes.Value > 0 
                    ? item.Task.EstimatedMinutes 
                    : (item.Task.BaseXP > 0 ? (int)Math.Ceiling(item.Task.BaseXP / 5.0) : 15),
                BaseXP = item.Task.BaseXP,
                Difficulty = item.Task.Difficulty.ToString(),
                WhyThisTask = item.Task.WhyThisTask,
                BadgeHint = item.Task.BadgeHint,
                MatchScore = Math.Round(item.Score, 2),
                RecommendationReason = item.Reason,
                Status = "Suggested"
            });
            
            if (result.Count >= count) break;
        }

        await _userTaskWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        return result;
    }

    private static double CalculateScore(
        Domain.Entities.AppTask task,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel,
        int availableMinutes,
        List<Guid> abandonedTaskIds,
        List<Guid> recentlyCompletedTaskIds)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(task);
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(user);

        double score = 0.0;

        // 1. GoalMatch (0.25) — kullanıcının hedefleriyle görev kategorisi eşleşiyor mu?
        var userGoals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();
        var taskGoals = task.TargetedGoals ?? new List<string>();
        var categoryName = task.Category?.Name?.ToLower() ?? string.Empty;
        if (userGoals.Any() && (userGoals.Contains(categoryName) || taskGoals.Any(g => userGoals.Contains(g))))
            score += 0.25;

        // 2. TimeMatch (0.20) — görev müsait süreye sığıyor mu?
        bool timeSlotMatch = task.RecommendedTimeSlots == null || !task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Any()
            || task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Contains(timeSlot);
        bool durationFits = (task.EstimatedMinutes ?? int.MaxValue) <= availableMinutes;
        if (timeSlotMatch && durationFits) score += 0.20;

        // 3. EnergyMatch (0.20) — enerji seviyesi görevin gereksinimlerine uyuyor mu?
        if (energyLevel >= task.MinEnergyLevel && energyLevel <= task.MaxEnergyLevel)
            score += 0.20;

        // 4. DifficultyMatch (0.15)
        var diffPref = user.DifficultyPreference?.ToLower() ?? "mixed";
        bool diffMatch = diffPref == "mixed" || task.Difficulty.ToString().ToLower() == diffPref;
        if (diffMatch) score += 0.15;

        // 5. WeaknessTarget (0.10) — görev kullanıcının zayıflıklarını hedefliyor mu?
        var userWeaknesses = user.Weaknesses ?? new List<string>();
        var taskWeaknesses = task.TargetedWeaknesses ?? new List<string>();
        if (userWeaknesses.Any() && taskWeaknesses.Any(w => userWeaknesses.Contains(w)))
            score += 0.10;

        // 6. StrengthMatch (0.10)
        var userStrengths = user.Strengths ?? new List<string>();
        var taskDescription = task.Description ?? string.Empty;
        var taskTitle = task.Title ?? string.Empty;
        if (userStrengths.Any() && userStrengths.Any(s =>
            taskDescription.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
            taskTitle.Contains(s, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            score += 0.10;

        // ── SP-03 / Phase 2: Davranış Faktörleri ──────────────────────────

        // 7. Abandoned Penalty (-0.30) — Daha önce bırakılan görevlere ceza
        if (abandonedTaskIds.Contains(task.Id))
            score -= 0.30;

        // 8. Recency Penalty (-0.20) — Son 7 günde tamamlananları tekrar önerme
        if (recentlyCompletedTaskIds.Contains(task.Id))
            score -= 0.20;

        // 9. Streak Bonus (+0.05) — Streak varsa besleyen görevlere hafif bonus
        if (user.CurrentStreak > 0)
            score += 0.05;

        // 10. BehaviorBonus (0.10) / MostSkippedPenalty (-0.15)
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user.MostSkippedCategory))
        {
            bool isMostSkipped = string.Equals(
                task.Category?.Name, user.MostSkippedCategory,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            if (isMostSkipped)
                score -= 0.15;
            else
                score += 0.10;
        }

        // 11. TimeOfDayBonus (0.05)
        if (user.PreferredMorningTime.HasValue)
        {
            var preferredSlot = user.PreferredMorningTime.Value.Hour switch
            {
                >= 6 and < 11 => DayTimeSlot.Morning,
                >= 11 and < 14 => DayTimeSlot.Noon,
                >= 14 and < 18 => DayTimeSlot.Afternoon,
                >= 18 and < 22 => DayTimeSlot.Evening,
                _ => DayTimeSlot.Night
            };
            bool slotMatch = task.RecommendedTimeSlots == null || !task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Any()
                || task.RecommendedTimeSlots.Contains(preferredSlot);
            if (slotMatch && preferredSlot == timeSlot)
                score += 0.05;
        }

        // Mood override bonus'lar
        if (mood == MoodMode.Energetic && task.MinEnergyLevel >= 4)
            score += 0.10;
        if (mood == MoodMode.LimitedTime && task.EstimatedMinutes <= 15)
            score += 0.10;
        if (mood == MoodMode.Tired && task.MaxEnergyLevel <= 2)
            score += 0.05;
        if ((mood == MoodMode.Tired || mood == MoodMode.Overwhelmed) && task.MinEnergyLevel > 3)
            score -= 0.20; // Yorgunken zorlu görevleri alt sıralara it

        return Math.Max(0, score);
    }

    private static string BuildReason(
        Domain.Entities.AppTask task,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        MoodMode mood,
        DayTimeSlot timeSlot,
        int energyLevel)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();

        var userGoals = user.UserGoals ?? new List<string>();
        if (userGoals.Any(g => task.Category?.Name?.ToLower()?.Contains(g) == true))
            parts.Add($"{task.Category?.Name} hedefine uygun");

        if (task.EstimatedMinutes.HasValue && task.EstimatedMinutes.Value > 0)
            parts.Add($"{task.EstimatedMinutes} dk içinde tamamlanabilir");

        var slotLabel = timeSlot switch
        {
            DayTimeSlot.Morning => "sabah verimliliğini artırır",
            DayTimeSlot.Noon => "öğle molasında yapılabilir",
            DayTimeSlot.Afternoon => "öğleden sonra enerjini kullanır",
            DayTimeSlot.Evening => "akşam rutinine uygun",
            DayTimeSlot.Night => "gece sessizliğinde odaklanmana yardımcı olur",
            _ => string.Empty
        };
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(slotLabel)) parts.Add(slotLabel);

        if (mood == MoodMode.LimitedTime) parts.Add("az vaktinle yapılabilir");
        if (mood == MoodMode.Tired && task.MaxEnergyLevel <= 2) parts.Add("yorgunken bile kaldırabilirsin");

        return parts.Count > 0
            ? string.Join(", ", parts)
            : "Senin için önerilen bir görev";
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Mail;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Email;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Email;

public class SmtpEmailService : IEmailService
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<SmtpEmailService> _logger;

    public SmtpEmailService(IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<SmtpEmailService> logger)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task SendEmailAsync(string toEmail, string subject, string htmlMessage)
    {
        try
        {
            var host = _configuration["EmailSettings:Host"] ?? "localhost";
            var portString = _configuration["EmailSettings:Port"] ?? "1025";
            var port = int.Parse(portString);
            var fromEmail = _configuration["EmailSettings:FromEmail"] ?? "noreply@lifequest.com";
            var fromName = _configuration["EmailSettings:FromName"] ?? "LifeQuest";

            using var client = new SmtpClient(host, port);
            
            var mailMessage = new MailMessage
            {
                From = new MailAddress(fromEmail, fromName),
                Subject = subject,
                Body = htmlMessage,
                IsBodyHtml = true
            };
            
            mailMessage.To.Add(toEmail);

            await client.SendMailAsync(mailMessage);
            _logger.LogInformation("Email sent successfully to {toEmail}", toEmail);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error sending email to {toEmail}", toEmail);
            // We shouldn't throw an exception to interrupt the registration flow
            // in a real app, maybe enqueue this or handle gracefully.
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;

public class AchievementService : IAchievementService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAchievementReadRepository _achievementReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserAchievementReadRepository _userAchievementReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserAchievementWriteRepository _userAchievementWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly ILogger<AchievementService> _logger;

    public AchievementService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAchievementReadRepository achievementReadRepository,
        IUserAchievementReadRepository userAchievementReadRepository,
        IUserAchievementWriteRepository userAchievementWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService,
        ILogger<AchievementService> logger)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _achievementReadRepository = achievementReadRepository;
        _userAchievementReadRepository = userAchievementReadRepository;
        _userAchievementWriteRepository = userAchievementWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task CheckAchievementsAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.UserTasks)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);

        if (user == null) return;

        var allAchievements = await _achievementReadRepository.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();
        var userAchievementIds = await _userAchievementReadRepository.Table
            .Where(ua => ua.AppUserId == userId)
            .Select(ua => ua.AchievementId)
            .ToListAsync();

        var completedTasksCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0;

        foreach (var ach in allAchievements)
        {
            // Eger onceden acildiysa atla
            if (userAchievementIds.Contains(ach.Id)) continue;

            bool isEarned = false;

            // Simple rule checks (Based on enum string or logic)
            // Varsayılarak AchievementType enum veya isimlendirme:
            if (ach.Title.Contains("Seviye") && user.GeneralLevel >= ach.RequiredCount)
            {
                isEarned = true;
            }
            else if (ach.Title.Contains("Görev") && completedTasksCount >= ach.RequiredCount)
            {
                isEarned = true;
            }
            // Dilersen burada AchievementType Enum'una göre net kontroller yapılabilir.

            if (isEarned)
            {
                var newUserAchievement = new UserAchievement
                {
                    AppUserId = userId,
                    AchievementId = ach.Id,
                    EarnedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    IsCompleted = true
                };

                await _userAchievementWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserAchievement);
                
                // Anlık Bildirim (SignalR + veritabanı)
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId, 
                    $"🏆 Yeni Başarım: {ach.Title}!", 
                    $"Tebrikler! {ach.Description} görevini başarıyla tamamladın.", 
                    "Achievement");
                
                _logger.LogInformation($"Kullanıcı {userId} yeni başarım kazandı: {ach.Title}");
            }
        }
        
        await _userAchievementWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Gamification;

public sealed class GamificationService : IGamificationService
{
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userReadRepository;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWriteRepository;
    private readonly IBadgeReadRepository _badgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeReadRepository _userBadgeReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserBadgeWriteRepository _userBadgeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository _categoryProgressReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository _categoryProgressWriteRepository;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public GamificationService(
        IAppUserReadRepository userReadRepository,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWriteRepository,
        IBadgeReadRepository badgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeReadRepository userBadgeReadRepository,
        IUserBadgeWriteRepository userBadgeWriteRepository,
        IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository categoryProgressReadRepository,
        IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository categoryProgressWriteRepository,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _userReadRepository = userReadRepository;
        _userWriteRepository = userWriteRepository;
        _badgeReadRepository = badgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeReadRepository = userBadgeReadRepository;
        _userBadgeWriteRepository = userBadgeWriteRepository;
        _categoryProgressReadRepository = categoryProgressReadRepository;
        _categoryProgressWriteRepository = categoryProgressWriteRepository;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task<AppUser> AddExperienceAsync(Guid userId, int xpAmount, Guid? categoryId = null)
    {
        return await AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(userId, xpAmount, null, categoryId);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// SP-01: XpCompensationRate ve IsCompensated bonus destekli XP ekleme.
    /// Ertelenen görevlerde rate=0.70, normal tamamlamada rate=1.0, telafi tamamlamada +%10 bonus.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task<AppUser> AddExperienceWithTaskAsync(Guid userId, int baseXpAmount, UserTask? userTask, Guid? categoryId = null)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null) throw new Exception("Kullanıcı bulunamadı!");

        // XP hesabı: CompensationRate uygula
        decimal compensationRate = userTask?.XpCompensationRate ?? 1.0m;
        // Telafi bonusu: Postponed görev tamamlanıyorsa +%10
        if (userTask?.IsCompensated == true)
            compensationRate = Math.Min(compensationRate + 0.10m, 1.0m);

        int finalXp = (int)(baseXpAmount * compensationRate);

        if (userTask != null)
            userTask.EarnedXp = finalXp;

        user.TotalXP += finalXp;
        user.GeneralLevel = CalculateLevel(user.TotalXP);
        user.LastActiveAt = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Seviye arttıkça günlük görev limitini güncelle (Max 10)
        UpdateDailyTaskLimit(user);

        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);

        if (categoryId.HasValue)
            await HandleCategoryProgression(userId, categoryId.Value, finalXp);

        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
        await CheckAndAwardBadges(user.Id, (int)user.GeneralLevel);

        return user;
    }

    private async Task HandleCategoryProgression(Guid userId, Guid categoryId, int xpAmount)
    {
        var progress = await _categoryProgressReadRepository.Table
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cp => cp.AppUserId == userId && cp.CategoryId == categoryId);

        if (progress == null)
        {
            progress = new UserCategoryProgress
            {
                AppUserId = userId,
                CategoryId = categoryId,
                Level = 1,
                CurrentXp = 0,
                XpToNextLevel = 100
            };
            await _categoryProgressWriteRepository.AddAsync(progress);
        }

        progress.CurrentXp += xpAmount;

        while (progress.CurrentXp >= progress.XpToNextLevel)
        {
            progress.CurrentXp -= progress.XpToNextLevel;
            progress.Level++;
            progress.XpToNextLevel += 50;
        }

        await _categoryProgressWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }

    private async Task CheckAndAwardBadges(Guid userId, int currentLevel)
    {
        var user = await _userReadRepository.Table
            .Include(u => u.UserTasks)
            .Include(u => u.CategoryProgresses)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);
            
        if (user == null) return;

        var eligibleBadges = await _badgeReadRepository.GetAll(tracking: false).ToListAsync();
        
        var ownedBadgeIds = await _userBadgeReadRepository.Table
            .Where(ub => ub.AppUserId == userId)
            .Select(ub => ub.BadgeId)
            .ToListAsync();

        var completedTasksCount = user.UserTasks?.Count(ut => ut.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed) ?? 0;

        foreach (var badge in eligibleBadges)
        {
            if (ownedBadgeIds.Contains(badge.Id)) continue;

            bool isEarned = badge.Type switch
            {
                BadgeType.Level => currentLevel >= badge.RequiredValue,
                BadgeType.Streak => user.CurrentStreak >= badge.RequiredValue,
                BadgeType.TaskCount => completedTasksCount >= badge.RequiredValue,
                BadgeType.CategoryMaster => badge.CategoryId.HasValue && 
                    (user.CategoryProgresses?.FirstOrDefault(cp => cp.CategoryId == badge.CategoryId.Value)?.Level ?? 0) >= badge.RequiredValue,
                BadgeType.FirstTime => completedTasksCount >= 1,
                _ => false
            };

            if (isEarned)
            {
                var newUserBadge = new UserBadge
                {
                    AppUserId = userId,
                    BadgeId = badge.Id,
                    EarnedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
                await _userBadgeWriteRepository.AddAsync(newUserBadge);
                
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId,
                    "Yeni Rozet Kazanıldı! 🏆",
                    $"Tebrikler! '{badge.Name}' rozetini kazandın!",
                    "BadgeEarned");
            }
        }

        await _userBadgeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }

    private void UpdateDailyTaskLimit(AppUser user)
    {
        int level = (int)Math.Floor(user.GeneralLevel);
        // Formül: 1-2->3, 3-4->4, 5-6->5, 7-8->6, 9-10->7, 11-12->8, 13-14->9, 15+->10
        int calculatedLimit = 3 + (level - 1) / 2;
        if (calculatedLimit > 10) calculatedLimit = 10;

        // Kullanıcının limiti mevcut seviyesine göre düşük kalmışsa otomatik yükselt
        if (calculatedLimit > user.DailyTaskLimit)
        {
            user.DailyTaskLimit = calculatedLimit;
        }
    }

    private double CalculateLevel(int totalXp)
    {
        // L1: 0, L2: 500, L3: 1500, L5: 4000, L10: 15000, 10+ için her +5000 XP
        if (totalXp < 500) return 1.0 + (totalXp / 500.0);
        if (totalXp < 1500) return 2.0 + ((totalXp - 500) / 1000.0);
        if (totalXp < 4000) return 3.0 + ((totalXp - 1500) / 1250.0); // L3->L5 arası (2 level fark, 2500 XP)
        if (totalXp < 15000) return 5.0 + ((totalXp - 4000) / 2200.0); // L5->L10 arası (5 level fark, 11000 XP)
        
        // 10+ seviye: 15000 + (level - 10) * 5000
        return 10.0 + ((totalXp - 15000) / 5000.0);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Social;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Social;

public sealed class ChallengeService : IChallengeService
{
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeReadRepository;
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWriteRepository;
    private readonly IGamificationService _gamificationService;
    private readonly IAppNotificationService _notificationService;

    public ChallengeService(
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeReadRepository,
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWriteRepository,
        IGamificationService gamificationService,
        IAppNotificationService notificationService)
    {
        _challengeReadRepository = challengeReadRepository;
        _challengeWriteRepository = challengeWriteRepository;
        _gamificationService = gamificationService;
        _notificationService = notificationService;
    }

    public async Task UpdateChallengeProgressAsync(Guid userId, Guid? categoryId, int earnedXp)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // Status enum ile aktif mücadeleleri getir
        var activeChallenges = await _challengeReadRepository.Table
            .Where(c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active &&
                        c.StartDate <= now &&
                        c.EndDate >= now &&
                        (c.ChallengerId == userId || c.OpponentId == userId))
            .ToListAsync();

        if (!activeChallenges.Any()) return;

        foreach (var challenge in activeChallenges)
        {
            // CategoryFocus: Sadece hedef kategoride tamamlanan görevler sayılır
            if (challenge.ChallengeType == ChallengeType.CategoryFocus)
            {
                var targetCat = challenge.TargetCategoryId ?? challenge.CategoryId;
                if (targetCat.HasValue && categoryId.HasValue && targetCat != categoryId)
                    continue;
            }

            bool isWinnerDetermined = false;
            bool isChallenger = challenge.ChallengerId == userId;

            // Puan artışı (XPRace ise XP kadar, değilse 1 birim)
            int increment = challenge.ChallengeType == ChallengeType.XPRace ? earnedXp : 1;

            if (isChallenger)
                challenge.ChallengerProgress += increment;
            else
                challenge.OpponentProgress += increment;

            // TargetValue varsa — kazanan kontrolü
            if (challenge.TargetValue.HasValue)
            {
                int myProgress = isChallenger ? challenge.ChallengerProgress : challenge.OpponentProgress;
                if (myProgress >= challenge.TargetValue.Value)
                {
                    challenge.WinnerId = userId;
                    challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Completed;
                    isWinnerDetermined = true;
                }
            }

            if (isWinnerDetermined)
            {
                var loserId = isChallenger ? challenge.OpponentId : challenge.ChallengerId;
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    userId, "Mücadele Kazandın! 🏆",
                    $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesini kazandın!",
                    "ChallengeCompleted");
                await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    loserId, "Mücadele Sona Erdi",
                    $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin seni geçti. Bir dahaki sefere!",
                    "ChallengeCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Canlı ilerleme bildirimi (her 25% de bir veya XPRace için her güncellemede?)
                int myProg = isChallenger ? challenge.ChallengerProgress : challenge.OpponentProgress;
                int target = challenge.TargetValue ?? 100;
                int pct = (int)((double)myProg / target * 100);
                
                // XPRace ise her zaman bildirim gönderilebilir veya belli eşiklerde
                if (challenge.ChallengeType == ChallengeType.XPRace || (pct > 0 && pct % 25 == 0))
                {
                    var opponentId = isChallenger ? challenge.OpponentId : challenge.ChallengerId;
                    await _notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        opponentId, "Rakibin İlerliyor! ⚠️",
                        $"'{challenge.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin ilerleme kaydetti!",
                        "ChallengeProgressUpdated");
                }
            }
        }

        await _challengeWriteRepository.SaveAsync();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Token;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure.Services.Token;

public class JwtTokenService : ITokenService
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

    public JwtTokenService(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
    }

    public string CreateToken(AppUser user)
    {
        var claims = new List<Claim>
            {
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Email, user.Email),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.UserName),
                new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, user.AppRole?.Name ?? "User")
            };

        var jwtSecret = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("JWT_SECRET") ?? _configuration["AppSettings:Token"];
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(jwtSecret))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT_SECRET is not configured.");
        }
        var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtSecret));

        var creds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha512Signature);

        var tokenDescriptor = new SecurityTokenDescriptor
        {
            Subject = new ClaimsIdentity(claims),
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1),
            SigningCredentials = creds
        };

        var tokenHandler = new JwtSecurityTokenHandler();
        var token = tokenHandler.CreateToken(tokenDescriptor);

        return tokenHandler.WriteToken(token);
    }

    public string CreateRefreshToken()
    {
        var randomNumber = new byte[64];
        using var rng = System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(randomNumber);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(randomNumber);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence;

public static class ServiceRegistration
{
    public static void AddPersistenceServices(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        var dataSourceBuilder = new Npgsql.NpgsqlDataSourceBuilder(configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"));
        dataSourceBuilder.EnableDynamicJson();
        var dataSource = dataSourceBuilder.Build();

        services.AddDbContext<LifeQuestDbContext>(options =>
            options.UseNpgsql(dataSource, npgsqlOptions => 
            {
                npgsqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(
                    maxRetryCount: 5,
                    maxRetryDelay: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10),
                    errorCodesToAdd: null);
            }));

        services.AddScoped<IAppUserReadRepository, AppUserReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppUserWriteRepository, AppUserWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppRoleReadRepository, AppRoleReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppRoleWriteRepository, AppRoleWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppTaskReadRepository, AppTaskReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAppTaskWriteRepository, AppTaskWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskReadRepository, UserTaskReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskWriteRepository, UserTaskWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IBadgeReadRepository, BadgeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IBadgeWriteRepository, BadgeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserBadgeReadRepository, UserBadgeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserBadgeWriteRepository, UserBadgeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ICategoryReadRepository, CategoryReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ICategoryWriteRepository, CategoryWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserCategoryProgressReadRepository, UserCategoryProgressReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserCategoryProgressWriteRepository, UserCategoryProgressWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserGoalReadRepository, UserGoalReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserGoalWriteRepository, UserGoalWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementReadRepository, AchievementReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IAchievementWriteRepository, AchievementWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserAchievementReadRepository, UserAchievementReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserAchievementWriteRepository, UserAchievementWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<INotificationReadRepository, NotificationReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<INotificationWriteRepository, NotificationWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IWeeklyReportReadRepository, WeeklyReportReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IWeeklyReportWriteRepository, WeeklyReportWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IFriendshipReadRepository, FriendshipReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IFriendshipWriteRepository, FriendshipWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeReadRepository, ChallengeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IChallengeWriteRepository, ChallengeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository, UserTaskInteractionReadRepository>();

        services.AddScoped<IChallengeParticipantWriteRepository, ChallengeParticipantWriteRepository>();

        // Social Feed
        services.AddScoped<IPostReadRepository, PostReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostWriteRepository, PostWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostTagWriteRepository, PostTagWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostLikeReadRepository, PostLikeReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostLikeWriteRepository, PostLikeWriteRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostCommentReadRepository, PostCommentReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IPostCommentWriteRepository, PostCommentWriteRepository>();
        
        // Kudos — FEAT-005
        services.AddScoped<IKudosReadRepository, KudosReadRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IKudosWriteRepository, KudosWriteRepository>();
    }

            .IsUnique();

        // PostComment
        modelBuilder.Entity<PostComment>()
            .HasOne(pc => pc.Post)
            .WithMany(p => p.Comments)
            .HasForeignKey(pc => pc.PostId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

            .HasOne(pc => pc.AppUser)

        // Kudos — FEAT-005
        modelBuilder.Entity<Kudos>()
            .HasOne(k => k.Sender)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(k => k.SenderId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Kudos>()
            .HasOne(k => k.Receiver)

            .HasForeignKey(k => k.ReceiverId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Kudos>()
            .HasOne(k => k.UserTask)
            .WithMany()
            .HasForeignKey(k => k.UserTaskId)
            .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);

        modelBuilder.Entity<Kudos>()
            .HasIndex(k => new { k.SenderId, k.UserTaskId })
            .IsUnique();

        // Soft Delete Global Filter
        foreach (var entityType in modelBuilder.Model.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            if (typeof(BaseEntity).IsAssignableFrom(entityType.ClrType))
            {
                modelBuilder.Entity(entityType.ClrType).HasQueryFilter(ConvertFilterExpression(entityType.ClrType));
            }
        }

        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.LambdaExpression ConvertFilterExpression(Type type)
    {
        var parameter = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(type, "e");
        var property = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Property(parameter, "IsDeleted");
        var comparison = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Equal(property, System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Constant(false));
        return System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda(comparison, parameter);
    }

    public override Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var entries = ChangeTracker.Entries<BaseEntity>();

        foreach (var entry in entries)
        {
            switch (entry.State)
            {
                case EntityState.Added:
                    entry.Entity.CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    break;
                case EntityState.Modified:
                    entry.Entity.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    break;
                case EntityState.Deleted:
                    entry.State = EntityState.Modified;
                    entry.Entity.IsDeleted = true;
                    entry.Entity.DeletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    break;
            }
        }

        return base.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Common.Security;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts.SeedData;

public static class SeedData
{
    public static async Task Initialize(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        using var context = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<LifeQuestDbContext>();

        context.Database.Migrate();

        // ---- KATEGORİLER ----
        var egitim = await context.Categories.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Name == "Eğitim");
        if (egitim == null)
        {
            egitim = new Category { Name = "Eğitim", Description = "Akademik ve kişisel gelişim", IconPath = "📚" };
            context.Categories.Add(egitim);
        }

        var saglik = await context.Categories.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Name == "Sağlık");
        if (saglik == null)
        {
            saglik = new Category { Name = "Sağlık", Description = "Fiziksel ve zihinsel sağlık", IconPath = "💪" };
            context.Categories.Add(saglik);
        }

        var kariyer = await context.Categories.FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Name == "Kariyer");
        if (kariyer == null)
        {
            kariyer = new Category { Name = "Kariyer", Description = "İş hayatı ve profesyonel hedefler", IconPath = "💼" };
            context.Categories.Add(kariyer);
        }

        if (sosyal == null)
        {
