                new Achievement { Title = "Hız Koşucusu", Description = "Bir görevi 10 dakikadan kısa sürede tamamla.", IconPath = "⚡", Type = AchievementType.SpeedRunner, RequiredCount = 1, BonusXP = 100, IsHidden = true },
            };
            await context.Achievements.AddRangeAsync(achievements);
            await context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        // ---- ROLLER ----
        var adminRole = await context.AppRoles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Name == "Admin");
        if (adminRole == null)
        {
            adminRole = new AppRole { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Name = "Admin" };
            context.AppRoles.Add(adminRole);
        }

        var userRole = await context.AppRoles.FirstOrDefaultAsync(r => r.Name == "User");
        if (userRole == null)
        {
            userRole = new AppRole { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Name = "User" };
            context.AppRoles.Add(userRole);
        }

        await context.SaveChangesAsync();

        // ---- ADMIN KULLANICI ----
        if (!await context.AppUsers.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == "admin@lifequest.com"))
        {
            byte[] passwordHash, passwordSalt;
            HashingHelper.CreatePasswordHash("Admin123!", out passwordHash, out passwordSalt);

            var adminUser = new AppUser
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Name = "System",
                Surname = "Admin",
                UserName = "system_admin",
                Email = "admin@lifequest.com",
                PasswordHash = passwordHash,
                PasswordSalt = passwordSalt,
                TotalXP = 99999,
                GeneralLevel = 99,
                AppRoleId = adminRole.Id,
            };

            await context.AppUsers.AddAsync(adminUser);
            await context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;

public class ReadRepository<T> : IReadRepository<T> where T : BaseEntity
{
    private readonly LifeQuestDbContext _context;

    public ReadRepository(LifeQuestDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public DbSet<T> Table => _context.Set<T>();

    public IQueryable<T> GetAll(bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return query;
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetByIdAsync(string id, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == Guid.Parse(id));
    }

    public async Task<T?> GetSingleAsync(Expression<Func<T, bool>> method, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.AsQueryable();
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(method);
    }

    public IQueryable<T> GetWhere(Expression<Func<T, bool>> method, bool tracking = true)
    {
        var query = Table.Where(method);
        if (!tracking)
            query = query.AsNoTracking();
        return query;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Infrastructure\LifeQuestAPI.Persistence\Repositories\WriteRepository.cs
==================================================

﻿using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities.Common;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.ChangeTracking;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Repositories;

public class WriteRepository<T> : IWriteRepository<T> where T : BaseEntity
{
    private readonly LifeQuestDbContext _context;

    public WriteRepository(LifeQuestDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public DbSet<T> Table => _context.Set<T>();

    public async Task<bool> AddAsync(T entity)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = await Table.AddAsync(entity);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Added;
    }

    public async Task<bool> AddRangeAsync(List<T> entities)
    {
        await Table.AddRangeAsync(entities);
        return true;
    }

    public bool Remove(T entity)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = Table.Remove(entity);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Deleted;
    }

    public async Task<bool> RemoveAsync(string id)
    {
        T? t = await Table.FindAsync(Guid.Parse(id));
        if (t == null)
        {
            return false;
        }
        Table.Remove(t);
        return true;
    }


    public bool Update(T model)
    {
        EntityEntry<T> entityEntry = Table.Update(model);
        return entityEntry.State == EntityState.Modified;
    }
    public async Task<int> SaveAsync() => await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\Program.cs
==================================================

using System.Text;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;
using LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application;
using LifeQuestAPI.Infrastructure;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts.SeedData;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Serilog;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Serilog Yapılandırması
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
    .ReadFrom.Configuration(builder.Configuration)
    .Enrich.FromLogContext()
    .WriteTo.Console()
    .WriteTo.File("logs/lifequest-.txt", rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day)
    .CreateLogger();

builder.Host.UseSerilog();

builder.Services.AddApplicationServices();
builder.Services.AddPersistenceServices(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddInfrastructureServices(builder.Configuration);
builder.Services.AddHostedService<DailyQuestWorker>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices.WeeklyReportWorker>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<NudgeWorker>(); // SP-03
builder.Services.AddHostedService<GoalRevisionWorker>(); // SP-04
builder.Services.AddHostedService<GoalReminderWorker>(); // SP-05
builder.Services.AddHostedService<ChallengeExpiryWorker>(); // SP-05

// API Versioning (Phase 3)
builder.Services.AddApiVersioning(options =>
{
    options.DefaultApiVersion = new Asp.Versioning.ApiVersion(1, 0);
    options.AssumeDefaultVersionWhenUnspecified = true;
    options.ReportApiVersions = true;
    options.ApiVersionReader = Asp.Versioning.ApiVersionReader.Combine(
        new Asp.Versioning.UrlSegmentApiVersionReader(),
        new Asp.Versioning.QueryStringApiVersionReader("api-version"),
        new Asp.Versioning.HeaderApiVersionReader("X-Version")
    );
}).AddMvc().AddApiExplorer(options =>
{
    options.GroupNameFormat = "'v'VVV";
    options.SubstituteApiVersionInUrl = true;
});

builder.Services.AddControllers()
    .AddJsonOptions(options =>
    {
        options.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonStringEnumConverter());
    });
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
builder.Services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
{
    c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiInfo { Title = "LifeQuest API", Version = "v1" });
    c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityScheme
    {
        Name = "Authorization",
        Type = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.SecuritySchemeType.ApiKey,
        Scheme = "Bearer",
        BearerFormat = "JWT",
        In = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.ParameterLocation.Header,
        Description = "JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. \r\n\r\n Enter 'Bearer' [space] and then your token in the text input below.\r\n\r\nExample: \"Bearer 1safsfsdfdfd\""
    });
    c.AddSecurityRequirement(new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityRequirement
    {
        {
            new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiSecurityScheme
            {
                Reference = new Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.OpenApiReference
                {
                    Type = Microsoft.OpenApi.Models.ReferenceType.SecurityScheme,
                    Id = "Bearer"
                }
            },
            new string[] {}
        }
    });
});
builder.Services.AddSignalR();
builder.Services.AddScoped<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService, LifeQuestAPI.API.Services.AppNotificationService>();

// CORS Politikası
builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
{
    var allowedOrigins = builder.Configuration.GetSection("AppSettings:AllowedOrigins").Get<string[]>() 
                         ?? new[] { "http://localhost:5173" };

    options.AddPolicy("AllowFrontend",
        policy =>
        {
            policy.WithOrigins(allowedOrigins)
                  .AllowAnyMethod()
                  .AllowAnyHeader()
                  .AllowCredentials(); // SignalR için gerekli
        });
});

// Rate Limiting
builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>
{
    options.GlobalLimiter = PartitionedRateLimiter.Create<HttpContext, string>(httpContext =>
        RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
            partitionKey: httpContext.User.Identity?.Name ?? httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "global",
            factory: partition => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
            {
                AutoReplenishment = true,
                PermitLimit = 500,
                QueueLimit = 0,
                Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
            }));

    options.AddPolicy("AuthRateLimit", httpContext =>
        RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter(
            partitionKey: httpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress?.ToString() ?? "global",
            factory: partition => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
            {
                AutoReplenishment = true,
                PermitLimit = 5,
                QueueLimit = 0,
                Window = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
            }));

    options.RejectionStatusCode = 429;
});

builder.Services.AddAuthentication(options =>
{
    options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
    options.DefaultChallengeScheme = JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
})
.AddJwtBearer(options =>
{
    var jwtSecret = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("JWT_SECRET") ?? builder.Configuration["AppSettings:Token"];
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(jwtSecret))
    {
        throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT_SECRET is not configured.");
    }

    options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
    {
        ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
        IssuerSigningKey = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(jwtSecret)),
        ValidateIssuer = false,
        ValidateAudience = false,
        ValidateLifetime = true,
        ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
    };
    options.Events = new JwtBearerEvents
    {
        OnMessageReceived = context =>
        {
            if (context.Request.Cookies.TryGetValue("accessToken", out var cookieToken))
            {
                context.Token = cookieToken;
            }

            var accessToken = context.Request.Query["access_token"];
            var path = context.HttpContext.Request.Path;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(accessToken) && path.StartsWithSegments("/hubs"))
            {
                context.Token = accessToken;
            }
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    };
});

var app = builder.Build();
app.UseSerilogRequestLogging();
app.UseMiddleware<LifeQuestAPI.API.Middlewares.GlobalExceptionMiddleware>();

app.UseSwagger();
app.UseSwaggerUI(c => c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "LifeQuest API v1"));

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseHsts();
}
// app.UseHttpsRedirection(); // Dev ortamında (Docker) localhost mixed-content ve sertifika sorunlarını önlemek için kapatıldı
app.UseCors("AllowFrontend");
app.UseRateLimiter();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

// Statik dosyalar (uploads klasoru icin)
app.UseStaticFiles();

app.MapControllers();
app.MapHub<LifeQuestAPI.API.Hubs.NotificationHub>("/hubs/notification");

using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var services = scope.ServiceProvider;
    try
    {
        await SeedData.Initialize(services);
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        var logger = services.GetRequiredService<ILogger<Program>>();
        logger.LogError(ex, "Veritabanina seed data eklenirken bir hata olustu.");
    }
}

app.Run();

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\ChallengeExpiryWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Gamification;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>SP-05: Süresi dolan mücadeleler için saatlik kontrol.</summary>
public class ChallengeExpiryWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<ChallengeExpiryWorker> _logger;

    public ChallengeExpiryWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<ChallengeExpiryWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("ChallengeExpiryWorker başlatıldı.");

        using PeriodicTimer timer = new(TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested && await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
        {
            try
            {
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                await ProcessExpiredChallengesAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "ChallengeExpiryWorker hata aldı.");
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task ProcessExpiredChallengesAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var challengeReadRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IChallengeReadRepository>();
        var challengeWriteRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IChallengeWriteRepository>();
        var gamificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IGamificationService>();
        var notificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

        // 1. Invited + 48 saat geçmiş → Expired
        var expiredInvites = await challengeReadRepo.GetWhere(
            c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Invited &&
                 c.InvitedAt.AddHours(48) < now,
            tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var c in expiredInvites)
        {
            c.Status = ChallengeStatus.Expired;
            challengeWriteRepo.Update(c);
        }

        // 2. Active + EndDate geçmiş → Complete
        var expiredActive = await challengeReadRepo.GetWhere(
            c => c.Status == ChallengeStatus.Active && c.EndDate < now,
            tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var c in expiredActive)
        {
            c.Status = ChallengeStatus.Completed;

            // Kazananı belirle
            Guid? winnerId = null;
            int challengerProg = c.ChallengerProgress;
            int opponentProg = c.OpponentProgress;

            if (challengerProg > opponentProg) winnerId = c.ChallengerId;
            else if (opponentProg > challengerProg) winnerId = c.OpponentId;
            // Eşitlik → winnerId = null, her ikisine yarı bonus

            c.WinnerId = winnerId;

            if (winnerId.HasValue)
            {
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(winnerId.Value, c.WinnerXPBonus);
                var loserId = winnerId.Value == c.ChallengerId ? c.OpponentId : c.ChallengerId;

                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    winnerId.Value, "Mücadele Kazandın! 🏆",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesini kazandın! +{c.WinnerXPBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    loserId, "Mücadele Bitti",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesinde rakibin daha iyi oldu. Bir daha dene!", "ChallengeCompleted");
            }
            else
            {
                // Beraberlik
                int halfBonus = c.WinnerXPBonus / 2;
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(c.ChallengerId, halfBonus);
                await gamificationService.AddExperienceAsync(c.OpponentId, halfBonus);

                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    c.ChallengerId, "Mücadele Bitti — Beraberlik!",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesi berabere bitti! +{halfBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
                await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    c.OpponentId, "Mücadele Bitti — Beraberlik!",
                    $"'{c.Title}' mücadelesi berabere bitti! +{halfBonus} XP", "ChallengeCompleted");
            }

            challengeWriteRepo.Update(c);
        }

        await challengeWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("ChallengeExpiryWorker: {Exp} süresi doldu, {Comp} tamamlandı.",
            expiredInvites.Count, expiredActive.Count);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

public class DailyQuestWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<DailyQuestWorker> _logger;
    private readonly TimeSpan _period = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);

    public DailyQuestWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<DailyQuestWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Worker Başlatıldı.");

        var configuration = _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>();
        var timeZoneId = configuration["AppTimezone"] ?? "Europe/Istanbul";
        TimeZoneInfo tz;
        try
        {
            tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(timeZoneId);
        }
        catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException)
        {
            tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Turkey Standard Time");
        }

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nowUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var nowInTz = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(nowUtc, tz);
            var nextMidnightInTz = nowInTz.Date.AddDays(1);
            var nextMidnightUtc = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(nextMidnightInTz, tz);
            var delay = nextMidnightUtc - nowUtc;

            _logger.LogInformation("Bir sonraki görev dağıtımı {delay} sonra yapılacak. (TSİ: {time})", delay, nextMidnightInTz);

            try
            {
                await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);

                if (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested) break;

                using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
                {
                    var dailyQuestService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IDailyQuestService>();
                    await dailyQuestService.DistributeDailyQuestsAsync();

                    // SP-05: Günlük sayaçları sıfırla
                    await ResetDailyCountersAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
                }
            }
            catch (TaskCanceledException)
            {
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Worker hata aldı! 1 saat sonra tekrar denenecek.");
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(1), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05 + MISS-004: Gece yarısı sayaçları sıfırla, streak'leri güncelle. BUG-008: Paralel batch işleme.</summary>
    private async Task ResetDailyCountersAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var userReadRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        
        var userIds = await userReadRepo.GetAll(tracking: false)
            .Select(u => u.Id)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var isMonday = DateTime.UtcNow.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Monday;
        var yesterday = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1));

        // 100'lük batch'ler halinde paralel işleme
        var batches = userIds.Chunk(100).ToList();
        
        await Parallel.ForEachAsync(batches, new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = 4, CancellationToken = ct }, async (batch, token) =>
        {
            using (var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope())
            {
                var writeRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserWriteRepository>();
                var readRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
                
                var usersInBatch = await readRepo.GetWhere(u => batch.Contains(u.Id), tracking: true).ToListAsync(token);

                foreach (var user in usersInBatch)
                {
                    user.TodayTaskCount = 0;
                    user.OverLimitWarningShown = false;
                    if (isMonday) user.WeeklyCompletedCount = 0;

                    if (!user.IsOnVacation)
                    {
                        if (user.LastTaskCompletedDate.HasValue && user.LastTaskCompletedDate.Value < yesterday)
                        {
                            user.CurrentStreak = 0;
                        }
                    }
                    writeRepo.Update(user);
                }
                await writeRepo.SaveAsync();
            }
        });

        _logger.LogInformation("SP-05 + MISS-004: {Count} kullanıcının günlük sayaçları ve streak'leri paralel olarak güncellendi.", userIds.Count);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>SP-05: Hedef hatırlatma bildirimleri. Her gün 09:00'da çalışır.</summary>
public class GoalReminderWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<GoalReminderWorker> _logger;

    public GoalReminderWorker(IServiceProvider serviceProvider, ILogger<GoalReminderWorker> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalReminderWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var nextRun = now.Date.AddDays(1).AddHours(6); // UTC 06:00 = TR 09:00
            var delay = nextRun - now;
            if (delay < TimeSpan.Zero) delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

            await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);

            try
            {
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                await SendGoalRemindersAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "GoalReminderWorker hata aldı.");
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task SendGoalRemindersAsync(IServiceProvider services, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var goalRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IUserGoalReadRepository>();
        var goalWriteRepo = services.GetRequiredService<IUserGoalWriteRepository>();
        var notificationService = services.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();

        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var goals = await goalRepo.GetWhere(
            g => !g.IsCompleted && !g.IsArchived && g.ReminderEnabled, tracking: true)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        var dayOfWeek = now.DayOfWeek;
        int remindedCount = 0;

        foreach (var goal in goals)
        {
            bool shouldRemind = goal.ReminderFrequency switch
            {
                "daily" => true,
                "weekly" => dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Monday,
                "on_lag" => IsGoalOnLag(goal, now),
                _ => false
            };

            if (!shouldRemind) continue;
            if (goal.LastReminderAt?.Date == now.Date) continue; // Bugün zaten gönderildi

            var progressPct = goal.TargetValue > 0
                ? (int)((double)goal.CurrentValue / goal.TargetValue * 100)
                : 0;

            await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                goal.AppUserId,
                "Hedef Hatırlatması 🎯",
                $"'{goal.Title}' hedefinizde %{progressPct} tamamlandı. Devam et!",
                "GoalReminder");

            goal.LastReminderAt = now;
            goalWriteRepo.Update(goal);
            remindedCount++;
        }

        await goalWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalReminderWorker: {Count} hedef hatırlatması gönderildi.", remindedCount);
    }

    private static bool IsGoalOnLag(Domain.Entities.UserGoal goal, DateTime now)
    {
        var totalDays = (goal.EndDate - goal.StartDate).TotalDays;
        if (totalDays <= 0) return false;
        var elapsedDays = (now - goal.StartDate).TotalDays;
        var expectedProgress = elapsedDays / totalDays;
        var actualProgress = goal.TargetValue > 0 ? (double)goal.CurrentValue / goal.TargetValue : 0;
        return actualProgress < expectedProgress * 0.8;
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\GoalRevisionWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// SP-04: Her Pazar 20:00'de çalışır.
/// Son 14 günde tamamlama oranı %20'nin altında olan ve kullanıcı hedefinde yer alan
/// kategorileri tespit eder; chatbot üzerinden hedef revizyon sorusu gönderir.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GoalRevisionWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<GoalRevisionWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    private static readonly TimeZoneInfo TurkeyTz =
        TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Turkey Standard Time") ??
        TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone("Turkey Standard Time", TimeSpan.FromHours(3), "Turkey", "Turkey");

    public GoalRevisionWorker(ILogger<GoalRevisionWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("GoalRevisionWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nowLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(DateTime.UtcNow, TurkeyTz);

            // Her Pazar 20:00
            if (nowLocal.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday && nowLocal.Hour == 20)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("GoalRevisionWorker: Hedef revizyonu başlıyor.");
                await RunRevisionAsync(stoppingToken);

                // 2 saat bekle (aynı gün tekrar çalışmasın)
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(2), stoppingToken);
            }
            else
            {
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task RunRevisionAsync(CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var notifService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();
        var chatWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageWriteRepository>();

        var cutoff = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-14);

        var users = await userReadRepo
            .GetWhere(u => u.UserGoals != null && u.UserGoals.Any() && !u.IsOnVacation, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try
            {
                var tasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                    .Include(ut => ut.AppTask).ThenInclude(t => t!.Category)
                    .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt >= cutoff)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                if (!tasks.Any()) continue;

                // Kategori bazlı tamamlama oranı
                var categoryStats = tasks
                    .Where(t => t.AppTask?.Category != null)
                    .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask!.Category!.Name)
                    .Select(g => new
                    {
                        Category = g.Key,
                        Total = g.Count(),
                        Completed = g.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed),
                        Rate = g.Count() > 0
                            ? (double)g.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed) / g.Count()
                            : 0.0
                    })
                    .ToList();

                // %20 altında olan, kullanıcı hedefinde yer alan kategoriler
                var weakGoals = categoryStats
                    .Where(s => s.Rate < 0.20 && s.Total >= 3 // en az 3 görev atanmış olmalı
                        && (user.UserGoals ?? new()).Any(g =>
                            g.Contains(s.Category, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                    .ToList();

                foreach (var weak in weakGoals)
                {
                    string message =
                        $"'{weak.Category}' hedefini son 2 haftadır zor buluyor gibisin " +
                        $"(tamamlama: %{(int)(weak.Rate * 100)}). Bu hedefi güncellemek ister misin?";

                    // ChatBotMessage olarak kaydet (aksiyonlu)
                    var chatMsg = new Domain.Entities.ChatBotMessage
                    {
                        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                        AppUserId = user.Id,
                        Content = message,
                        SenderType = Domain.Enums.SenderType.Bot,
                        IsProactive = true,
                        Intent = "goal_revision",
                        // Aksiyonlar JSON string formatında saklanır
                        ActionsOfferedJson = new List<string>
                        {
                            $"{{\"type\":\"update_goal\",\"label\":\"Evet, güncelle\",\"payload\":\"{weak.Category}\"}}",
                            $"{{\"type\":\"keep_goal\",\"label\":\"Hayır, devam et\",\"payload\":\"{weak.Category}\"}}"
                        },
                        CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                        UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                    };

                    await chatWriteRepo.AddAsync(chatMsg);
                    await chatWriteRepo.SaveAsync();

                    // SignalR push
                    await notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
                        user.Id,
                        "Hedef Revizyonu 🎯",
                        message,
                        "GoalRevision");

                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "GoalRevisionWorker: {Category} → {UserId}", weak.Category, user.Id);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "GoalRevisionWorker: {UserId} için hata.", user.Id);
            }
        }
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\NudgeWorker.cs
==================================================

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

/// <summary>
/// SP-03: Belirli saatlerde pasif kullanıcılara proaktif chatbot nudge mesajı gönderir.
/// Zamanlama (UTC+3): 13:00, 19:00, 21:30
/// </summary>
public sealed class NudgeWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<NudgeWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    // Türkiye saati (UTC+3) — offset
    private static readonly TimeZoneInfo TurkeyTz =
        TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById("Turkey Standard Time") ??
        TimeZoneInfo.CreateCustomTimeZone("Turkey Standard Time", TimeSpan.FromHours(3), "Turkey", "Turkey");

    // Günlük gönderim zamanları (yerel saat)
    private static readonly (TimeOnly Time, NudgeType Type)[] Schedule =
    [
        (new TimeOnly(13, 0), NudgeType.Midday),
        (new TimeOnly(19, 0), NudgeType.Evening),
        (new TimeOnly(21, 30), NudgeType.NightStreak)
    ];

    public NudgeWorker(ILogger<NudgeWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var nowUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
            var nowLocal = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(nowUtc, TurkeyTz);
            var nowTime = TimeOnly.FromDateTime(nowLocal);

            foreach (var (scheduleTime, nudgeType) in Schedule)
            {
                // ±2 dakika tolerans penceresi
                var diff = Math.Abs((nowTime - scheduleTime).TotalMinutes);
                if (diff <= 2)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker: {NudgeType} zamanı geldi.", nudgeType);
                    await RunNudgeAsync(nudgeType, nowLocal, stoppingToken);
                    break;
                }
            }

            // Bir dakika bekle — gereksiz döngü yok
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), stoppingToken);
        }
    }

    private async Task RunNudgeAsync(NudgeType nudgeType, DateTime nowLocal, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var chatWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageWriteRepository>();
        var notifService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppNotificationService>();

        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(nowLocal);

        // NudgeEnabled=true olan kullanıcıları çek
        var users = await userReadRepo
            .GetWhere(u => u.NudgeEnabled, tracking: false)
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try
            {
                // Bugün bu türden nudge gönderildi mi? (ChatBotMessage kontrolü)
                var chatReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatBotMessageReadRepository>();
                var alreadySent = await chatReadRepo.GetWhere(
                    m => m.AppUserId == user.Id
                        && m.IsProactive
                        && m.Intent == nudgeType.ToString()
                        && DateOnly.FromDateTime(m.CreatedAt) == today,
                    tracking: false).AnyAsync(ct);

                if (alreadySent) continue;

                // Bugünkü görev durumunu kontrol et
                var todayTasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                    .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id)
                    .ToListAsync(ct);

                string? message = BuildNudgeMessage(nudgeType, user, todayTasks);
                if (message == null) continue;

                // ChatBotMessage kaydı (IsProactive=true)
                var chatMsg = new ChatBotMessage
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    AppUserId = user.Id,
                    Content = message,
                    SenderType = SenderType.Bot,
                    IsProactive = true,
                    Intent = nudgeType.ToString(),
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
                await chatWriteRepo.AddAsync(chatMsg);
                await chatWriteRepo.SaveAsync();

                // SignalR ile push
                await notifService.SendNotificationAsync(
                    user.Id,
                    "LifeQuest AI 🤖",
                    message,
                    "ProactiveNudge");

                _logger.LogInformation("NudgeWorker: {NudgeType} → {UserId}", nudgeType, user.Id);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "NudgeWorker: {UserId} için nudge gönderilemedi.", user.Id);
            }
        }
    }

    private static string? BuildNudgeMessage(
        NudgeType nudgeType,
        Domain.Entities.Identity.AppUser user,
        List<Domain.Entities.UserTask> todayTasks)
    {
        var name = user.Name;
        var completed = todayTasks.Count(t => t.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed);
        var remaining = todayTasks.Count(t =>
            t.Status is AppTaskStatus.Suggested or AppTaskStatus.Selected or AppTaskStatus.InProgress);

        return nudgeType switch
        {
            NudgeType.Midday when completed == 0 =>
                $"Merhaba {name}! 🌞 Öğlen oldu ama henüz hiç göreve başlamadın. 15 dakikan varsa hızlı bir görev seni bekliyor!",

            NudgeType.Evening when completed == 0 =>
                $"Hey {name}! 🌆 Akşam oldu, bugün henüz hiç görev tamamlamadın. Streak'ini kurtarmak ister misin?",

            NudgeType.Evening when remaining > 0 =>
                $"{name}, bugün {completed} görev tamamladın! 💪 Hâlâ {remaining} görev bekliyor. Son bir hamle?",

            NudgeType.NightStreak when completed == 0 =>
                $"Gece olmadan önce {name}! 🌙 Sadece 5 dakikalık mini bir görev bile serini kurtarır. Hadi!",

            _ => null // Koşul sağlanmıyorsa mesaj gönderme
        };
    }
}

public enum NudgeType { Midday, Evening, NightStreak }

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\BackgroundServices\WeeklyReportWorker.cs
==================================================

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.BackgroundServices;

public class WeeklyReportWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly ILogger<WeeklyReportWorker> _logger;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

    public WeeklyReportWorker(ILogger<WeeklyReportWorker> logger, IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Haftalık Rapor İşçisi (WeeklyReportWorker) başlatıldı.");

        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

            // Pazar günü (Sunday) saat 23:00'te çalışsın
            if (now.DayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.Sunday && now.Hour == 23)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation("Haftalık raporlar hesaplanmaya başlanıyor...");
                await GenerateReportsAsync(stoppingToken);
                
                // Bir kez çalıştıktan sonra sonraki haftaya kadar veya ertesi saate kadar uyusun
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromHours(2), stoppingToken);
            }
            else
            {
                // Her 30 dakikada bir kontrol et
                await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30), stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }

    private async Task GenerateReportsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var userReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var reportWriteRepo = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IWeeklyReportWriteRepository>();
        var notificationService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<Application.Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService>();

        var weekEnd = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var weekStart = weekEnd.AddDays(-7);

        var users = await userReadRepo.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();

        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            var thisWeekTasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt >= weekStart)
                .ToListAsync();

            if (!thisWeekTasks.Any()) continue;

            var completedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
            var failedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Abandoned
                || t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Expired
                || (t.DueDate < DateTime.UtcNow && t.Status != Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed)).ToList();

            var totalXpEarned = completedTasks.Sum(t => t.EarnedXp);

            // Basit AI/Hesaplama özetleri
            string insight = "Bu hafta harika bir iş çıkardın!";
            string recommendation = "Önümüzdeki hafta Sağlık kategorisine daha fazla odaklanabilirsin.";

            var categoryGroups = completedTasks
                .Where(t => t.AppTask != null)
                .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask.CategoryId)
                .Select(g => new { CategoryId = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count)
                .ToList();

            var report = new WeeklyReport
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                AppUserId = user.Id,
                WeekStartDate = weekStart,
                WeekEndDate = weekEnd,
                TasksCompleted = completedTasks.Count,
                TasksFailed = failedTasks.Count,
                TotalXPEarned = totalXpEarned,
                StreakDays = 0, // Günlük streak logu eklendiğinde buradan çekilebilir
                StrongestCategory = categoryGroups.FirstOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                WeakestCategory = categoryGroups.LastOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                AIInsight = insight,
                AIRecommendation = recommendation,
                OverallPerformanceScore = (thisWeekTasks.Count > 0) ? ((float)completedTasks.Count / thisWeekTasks.Count * 100) : 0,
                CategoryBreakdownJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(categoryGroups),
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await reportWriteRepo.AddAsync(report);
            
            // Bildirim At
            await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                user.Id, 
                "Haftalık Raporun Hazır! 📊", 
                $"Bu hafta {completedTasks.Count} görev tamamladın ve toplam {totalXpEarned} XP kazandın.", 
                "Report");
        }

        await reportWriteRepo.SaveAsync();
        _logger.LogInformation($"Haftalık raporlar {users.Count} kullanıcı için oluşturuldu ve kaydedildi.");

        // SP-03: Davranış analizi güncelle
        var behaviorService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IUserBehaviorAnalysisService>();
        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            try { await behaviorService.AnalyzeAndUpdateUserBehaviorAsync(user.Id, ct); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Davranış analizi hatası — UserId: {Id}", user.Id); }
        }
        _logger.LogInformation("SP-03: Davranış analizi tüm kullanıcılar için tamamlandı.");
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/admin/analytics")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
public class AdminAnalyticsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskRead;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly ICategoryReadRepository _categoryRead;

    public AdminAnalyticsController(
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskRead,
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        ICategoryReadRepository categoryRead)
    {
        _userTaskRead = userTaskRead;
        _userRead = userRead;
        _categoryRead = categoryRead;
    }

    [HttpGet("task-dropout")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTaskDropout()
    {
        var stats = await _userTaskRead.Table
            .GroupBy(ut => ut.Status)
            .Select(g => new { Status = g.Key.ToString(), Count = g.Count() })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(stats);
    }

    [HttpGet("category-performance")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetCategoryPerformance()
    {
        var stats = await _userTaskRead.Table
            .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.Category)
            .Where(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed)
            .GroupBy(ut => ut.AppTask.Category.Name)
            .Select(g => new { Category = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(stats);
    }

    [HttpGet("hourly-completions")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetHourlyCompletions()
    {
        var stats = await _userTaskRead.Table
            .Where(ut => ut.Status == AppTaskStatus.Completed && ut.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .GroupBy(ut => ut.CompletedAt!.Value.Hour)
            .Select(g => new { Hour = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
            .OrderBy(x => x.Hour)
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(stats);
    }

    [HttpGet("user-retention")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetUserRetention()
    {
        var today = DateTime.UtcNow.Date;
        var last7Days = today.AddDays(-7);

        var activeUsers = await _userRead.Table
            .CountAsync(u => u.LastTaskCompletedDate >= DateOnly.FromDateTime(last7Days));
        
        var totalUsers = await _userRead.Table.CountAsync();

        return Ok(new
        {
            TotalUsers = totalUsers,
            ActiveUsersLast7Days = activeUsers,
            RetentionRate = totalUsers > 0 ? (double)activeUsers / totalUsers : 0
        });
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\Controllers\AdminController.cs
==================================================

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/admin")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class AdminController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly LifeQuestDbContext _context;

    public AdminController(LifeQuestDbContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    [HttpPost("wipe-and-seed")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> WipeAndSeed([FromBody] WipeAndSeedRequest request)
    {
        if (request == null || (request.Categories == null && request.Badges == null && request.Achievements == null))
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Geçersiz veya boş veri!" });

        var strategy = _context.Database.CreateExecutionStrategy();
        try
        {
            return await strategy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
            {
                using var transaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();
                try
                {
                    var categoryMapping = new Dictionary<string, Category>();

                    if (request.WipeDatabase)
                    {
                        // 1. Wipe everything safely
                        _context.UserCategoryProgresses.RemoveRange(_context.UserCategoryProgresses);
                        _context.UserTasks.RemoveRange(_context.UserTasks);
                        _context.AppTasks.RemoveRange(_context.AppTasks);
                        _context.Categories.RemoveRange(_context.Categories);
                        _context.UserBadges.RemoveRange(_context.UserBadges);
                        _context.Badges.RemoveRange(_context.Badges);
                        _context.UserAchievements.RemoveRange(_context.UserAchievements);
                        _context.Achievements.RemoveRange(_context.Achievements);

                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        // Load existing categories to avoid duplicates
                        var existingCats = await _context.Categories.ToListAsync();
                        foreach (var cat in existingCats)
                        {
                            categoryMapping[cat.Name.ToLower()] = cat;
                        }
                    }

                    // 2. Insert Categories and map to their IDs
                    if (request.Categories != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var cat in request.Categories)
                        {
                            var catKey = cat.Name.ToLower();
                            if (!categoryMapping.ContainsKey(catKey))
                            {
                                var newCat = new Category
                                {
                                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                    Name = cat.Name,
                                    Description = cat.Description,
                                    IconPath = cat.IconPath
                                };
                                _context.Categories.Add(newCat);
                                categoryMapping[catKey] = newCat;
                            }
                        }
                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    // 3. Insert Tasks
                    if (request.Tasks != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var t in request.Tasks)
                        {
                            var catKey = (t.CategoryName ?? "genel").ToLower();
                            var category = categoryMapping.ContainsKey(catKey) 
                                ? categoryMapping[catKey] 
                                : (categoryMapping.Values.FirstOrDefault() ?? new Category { Id = Guid.NewGuid(), Name = "Genel", IconPath = "🎯" });

                            if (category.Id == Guid.Empty || !_context.Categories.Any(c => c.Id == category.Id))
                            {
                                _context.Categories.Add(category);
                                await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                                categoryMapping[category.Name.ToLower()] = category;
                            }

                            var newAppTask = new AppTask
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                Title = t.Title,
                                Description = t.Description,
                                CategoryId = category.Id,
                                BaseXP = t.BaseXP,
                                MinLevel = t.MinLevel,
                                MaxLevel = t.MaxLevel,
                                Difficulty = t.Difficulty,
                                IsDaily = t.IsDaily,
                                IsActive = true,
                                EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes,
                                WhyThisTask = t.WhyThisTask
                            };

                            _context.AppTasks.Add(newAppTask);
                        }
                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    // 4. Insert Badges
                    if (request.Badges != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var b in request.Badges)
                        {
                            _context.Badges.Add(new Badge
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                Name = b.Name,
                                Description = b.Description,
                                IconPath = b.IconPath,
                                RequiredLevel = b.RequiredLevel
                            });
                        }
                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    // 5. Insert Achievements
                    if (request.Achievements != null)
                    {
                        foreach (var a in request.Achievements)
                        {
                            _context.Achievements.Add(new Achievement
                            {
                                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                                Title = a.Title,
                                Description = a.Description,
                                IconPath = a.IconPath,
                                Type = a.Type,
                                RequiredCount = a.RequiredCount,
                                BonusXP = a.BonusXP,
                                IsHidden = a.IsHidden
                            });
                        }
                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    await transaction.CommitAsync();

                    var msg = request.WipeDatabase 
                        ? "DB tamamen sıfırlandı ve yeni JSON verileriyle tekrar dolduruldu!" 
                        : "Mevcut veriler korundu ve yeni JSON verileri başarıyla eklendi!";

                    return Ok(new { success = true, message = msg });
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    await transaction.RollbackAsync();
                    throw;
                }
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Seeding hatası: " + ex.Message });
        }
    }
}

public class WipeAndSeedRequest
{
    public bool WipeDatabase { get; set; } = false;
    public List<CategorySeedDto>? Categories { get; set; }
    public List<TaskSeedDto>? Tasks { get; set; }
    public List<BadgeSeedDto>? Badges { get; set; }
    public List<AchievementSeedDto>? Achievements { get; set; }
}

public class CategorySeedDto

    public string? Description { get; set; }
    public string? IconPath { get; set; }
}

public class TaskSeedDto
{

    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CategoryName { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int BaseXP { get; set; }
    public int MinLevel { get; set; } = 1;
    public int MaxLevel { get; set; } = 99;
    public DifficultyLevel Difficulty { get; set; } = DifficultyLevel.Easy;
    public bool IsDaily { get; set; }
    public int? EstimatedMinutes { get; set; }
    public string? WhyThisTask { get; set; }
}

public class BadgeSeedDto
{
    public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string IconPath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int RequiredLevel { get; set; }
}

public class AchievementSeedDto
{
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string IconPath { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public AchievementType Type { get; set; }
    public int RequiredCount { get; set; }
    public int BonusXP { get; set; }
    public bool IsHidden { get; set; }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.Login;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.Register;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/[controller]")]
[ApiController]
public sealed class AuthController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public AuthController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpPost("register")]
    [Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting.EnableRateLimiting("AuthRateLimit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Register(RegisterUserCommandRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    [HttpPost("login")]
    [Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting.EnableRateLimiting("AuthRateLimit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Login(LoginUserCommandRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        
        SetTokenCookies(response.Token, response.RefreshToken, response.RefreshTokenExpiration);
        
        // Return without sensitive tokens in body
        return Ok(new { 
            response.IsSuccess, 
            response.Message,
            response.UserId,
            response.UserName,
            response.Role
        });
    }

    [HttpPatch("verify-email")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> VerifyEmail([FromQuery] string token)
    {
        var request = new LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.VerifyEmail.VerifyEmailCommandRequest { Token = token };
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        if (response.IsSuccess)
        {
            return Ok(response);
        }
        return BadRequest(response);
    }

    [HttpPost("forgot-password")]
    [Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting.EnableRateLimiting("AuthRateLimit")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ForgotPassword(LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.ForgotPassword.ForgotPasswordCommandRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    [HttpPost("reset-password")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ResetPassword(LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.ResetPassword.ResetPasswordCommandRequest request)
    {
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        if (response.IsSuccess)
        {
            return Ok(response);
        }
        return BadRequest(response);
    }

    [HttpPost("refresh-token")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RefreshToken()
    {
        if (!Request.Cookies.TryGetValue("refreshToken", out var refreshToken) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(refreshToken))
        {
            return Unauthorized(new { IsSuccess = false, Message = "Refresh token bulunamadı." });
        }

        var request = new LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Auth.Commands.RefreshToken.RefreshTokenCommandRequest { RefreshToken = refreshToken };
        var response = await _mediator.Send(request);
        
        if (response.IsSuccess)
        {
            SetTokenCookies(response.Token, response.RefreshToken, response.RefreshTokenExpiration);
            return Ok(new { response.IsSuccess, response.Message });
        }
        
        return Unauthorized(response);
    }

    [HttpPost("revoke")]
    public IActionResult Revoke()
    {
        Response.Cookies.Delete("accessToken");
        Response.Cookies.Delete("refreshToken");
        // We could also call a command to clear it in DB, but just clearing cookie is fine for frontend logout.
        return Ok(new { IsSuccess = true, Message = "Çıkış yapıldı." });
    }

    private void SetTokenCookies(string accessToken, string refreshToken, DateTime? refreshTokenExpiration)
    {
        // Secure=true yalnızca HTTPS'te çalışır. Dev/Docker ortamında HTTP kullanıldığında
        // Secure=true cookie göndermez ve auth tamamen bozulur.
        var isSecure = !HttpContext.RequestServices
            .GetRequiredService<IWebHostEnvironment>()
            .IsDevelopment();

        var cookieOptions = new CookieOptions
        {
            HttpOnly = true,
            Secure = isSecure,
            SameSite = isSecure ? SameSiteMode.Strict : SameSiteMode.Lax,
            Expires = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(15)
        };
        Response.Cookies.Append("accessToken", accessToken, cookieOptions);

        var refreshCookieOptions = new CookieOptions
        {
            HttpOnly = true,
            Secure = isSecure,
            SameSite = isSecure ? SameSiteMode.Strict : SameSiteMode.Lax,
            Expires = refreshTokenExpiration ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(7)
        };
        Response.Cookies.Append("refreshToken", refreshToken, refreshCookieOptions);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.ProcessChatAction;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Chat.Commands.SendMessage;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/chat")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class ChatController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public ChatController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    /// <summary>AI chatbot'a mesaj gönder ve bağlam-duyarlı cevap al.</summary>
    [HttpPost("send")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendMessage([FromBody] ChatMessageBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var response = await _mediator.Send(new SendMessageCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            Message = body.Message
        });

        if (!response.Success) return BadRequest(response);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>SP-02: Chatbot aksiyon butonuna tıklandığında aksiyonu işle.</summary>
    [HttpPost("action")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ProcessAction([FromBody] ProcessChatActionBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var result = await _mediator.Send(new ProcessChatActionCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            MessageId = body.MessageId,
            ActionType = body.ActionType,
            TaskId = body.TaskId,
            Payload = body.Payload
        });

        if (!result.Success) return BadRequest(result);
        return Ok(result);
    }

using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using System.Security.Claims;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.Mood.Commands.RecordDailyMood;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.DTOs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/mood")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class MoodController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly IUserDailyMoodReadRepository _moodReadRepository;

    public MoodController(IMediator mediator, IUserDailyMoodReadRepository moodReadRepository)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _moodReadRepository = moodReadRepository;
    }

    /// <summary>POST /api/mood/daily — Günlük mood kaydet (UPSERT)</summary>
    [HttpPost("daily")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RecordDailyMood([FromBody] RecordDailyMoodRequest request)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var result = await _mediator.Send(new RecordDailyMoodCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            MoodMode = request.MoodMode,
            AvailableMinutes = request.AvailableMinutes,
            EnergyLevel = request.EnergyLevel
        });

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = result });
    }

    /// <summary>GET /api/mood/today — Bugünkü mood kaydını getir</summary>
    [HttpGet("today")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTodayMood()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);
        var today = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow);

        var mood = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == userId && m.Date == today, tracking: false)
            .Select(m => new UserDailyMoodDto
            {
                Id = m.Id,
                AppUserId = m.AppUserId,
                Date = m.Date,
                MoodMode = m.MoodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = m.AvailableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = m.EnergyLevel,
                JournalEntry = m.JournalEntry,
                SleepQuality = m.SleepQuality,
                RecordedAt = m.RecordedAt
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = mood });
    }

    /// <summary>GET /api/mood/history — Son 30 günün mood geçmişi</summary>
    [HttpGet("history")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMoodHistory()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);
        var thirtyDaysAgo = DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30));

        var history = await _moodReadRepository
            .GetWhere(m => m.AppUserId == userId && m.Date >= thirtyDaysAgo, tracking: false)
            .OrderByDescending(m => m.Date)
            .Select(m => new UserDailyMoodDto
            {
                Id = m.Id,
                AppUserId = m.AppUserId,
                Date = m.Date,
                MoodMode = m.MoodMode,
                AvailableMinutes = m.AvailableMinutes,
                EnergyLevel = m.EnergyLevel,
                JournalEntry = m.JournalEntry,
                SleepQuality = m.SleepQuality,
                RecordedAt = m.RecordedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, data = history });
    }
}

public record RecordDailyMoodRequest(Domain.Enums.MoodMode MoodMode, int AvailableMinutes, int EnergyLevel, string? JournalEntry, int? SleepQuality);

using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Linq;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/notifications")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class NotificationsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly INotificationReadRepository _notificationRead;
    private readonly INotificationWriteRepository _notificationWrite;

    public NotificationsController(
        INotificationReadRepository notificationRead,
        INotificationWriteRepository notificationWrite)
    {
        _notificationRead = notificationRead;
        _notificationWrite = notificationWrite;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyNotifications()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var notifications = await _notificationRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(n => n.AppUserId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(n => n.CreatedAt)
            .Take(100)
            .ToListAsync();

        var unreadCount = await _notificationRead.GetAll(false)
            .CountAsync(n => n.AppUserId == userId && !n.IsRead);

        var grouped = notifications
            .GroupBy(n => n.Type)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key.ToString(), g => g.ToList());

        return Ok(new 
        { 
            success = true, 
            unreadCount,
            notifications, // Düz liste de kalsın
            grouped 
        });
    }

    [HttpPatch("{id}/mark-as-read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> MarkAsRead(Guid id)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var notification = await _notificationRead.GetByIdAsync(id.ToString());
        if (notification == null) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Bildirim bulunamadı." });
        if (notification.AppUserId != userId) return Unauthorized();

        notification.IsRead = true;
        await _notificationWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }

    [HttpPatch("mark-all-as-read")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> MarkAllAsRead()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var unreadNotifications = await _notificationRead.GetAll(true)
            .Where(n => n.AppUserId == userId && !n.IsRead)
            .ToListAsync();

        foreach (var notification in unreadNotifications)
        {
            notification.IsRead = true;
        }

        if (unreadNotifications.Any())
        {
            await _notificationWrite.SaveAsync();
        }

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }
}

DOSYA YOLU: LifeQuestAPI\Presentation\LifeQuestAPI.API\Controllers\PostsController.cs
