using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/posts")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class PostsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IPostReadRepository _postRead;
    private readonly IPostWriteRepository _postWrite;
    private readonly IPostTagWriteRepository _postTagWrite;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IFriendshipReadRepository _friendshipRead;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskRead;
    private readonly IPostLikeReadRepository _postLikeRead;
    private readonly IPostLikeWriteRepository _postLikeWrite;
    private readonly IPostCommentReadRepository _postCommentRead;
    private readonly IPostCommentWriteRepository _postCommentWrite;
    private readonly IWebHostEnvironment _env;

    public PostsController(
        IPostReadRepository postRead,
        IPostWriteRepository postWrite,
        IPostTagWriteRepository postTagWrite,
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IFriendshipReadRepository friendshipRead,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskRead,
        IPostLikeReadRepository postLikeRead,
        IPostLikeWriteRepository postLikeWrite,
        IPostCommentReadRepository postCommentRead,
        IPostCommentWriteRepository postCommentWrite,
        IWebHostEnvironment env)
    {
        _postRead = postRead;
        _postWrite = postWrite;
        _postTagWrite = postTagWrite;
        _userRead = userRead;
        _friendshipRead = friendshipRead;
        _userTaskRead = userTaskRead;
        _postLikeRead = postLikeRead;
        _postLikeWrite = postLikeWrite;
        _postCommentRead = postCommentRead;
        _postCommentWrite = postCommentWrite;
        _env = env;
    }

    // ─── GET /api/posts/feed ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Arkadaşların ve kendi paylaşımlarını kronolojik sırayla getir.</summary>
    [HttpGet("feed")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetFeed([FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 20)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        // Kabul edilmiş arkadaşlıklar
        var friendIds = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(f => (f.RequesterId == userId || f.AddresseeId == userId)
                        && f.Status == Domain.Enums.FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
            .Select(f => f.RequesterId == userId ? f.AddresseeId : f.RequesterId)
            .ToListAsync();

        // Kendi id'si de dahil
        friendIds.Add(userId.Value);

        var posts = await _postRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(p => friendIds.Contains(p.AppUserId))
            .Include(p => p.AppUser)
            .Include(p => p.Tags)
                .ThenInclude(t => t.AppTask)
            .Include(p => p.Likes)
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.CreatedAt)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(p => new
            {
                id = p.Id,
                content = p.Content,
                imageUrl = p.ImageUrl,
                createdAt = p.CreatedAt,
                author = new
                {
                    id = p.AppUser.Id,
                    userName = p.AppUser.UserName,
                    fullName = p.AppUser.FullName,
                    avatarId = p.AppUser.AvatarId,
                    level = p.AppUser.GeneralLevel
                },
                tags = p.Tags.Select(t => new
                {
                    id = t.Id,
                    taskId = t.AppTaskId,
                    taskTitle = t.AppTask.Title,
                    x = t.CoordinateX,
                    y = t.CoordinateY
                }),
                likeCount = p.Likes.Count,
                commentCount = p.Comments.Count(),
                isLikedByMe = p.Likes.Any(l => l.AppUserId == userId)
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, posts });
    }

    // ─── POST /api/posts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    /// <summary>Yeni gönderi oluştur (metin veya resimli + etiket).</summary>
    [HttpPost]
    [Consumes("multipart/form-data")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreatePost([FromForm] CreatePostDto request)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Content) && request.Image == null)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Gönderi metni veya görsel zorunludur." });

        string? imageUrl = null;

        // 1. Görsel yükleme
        if (request.Image != null && request.Image.Length > 0)
        {
            var allowedTypes = new[] { "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif" };
            if (!allowedTypes.Contains(request.Image.ContentType.ToLower()))
                return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Sadece JPEG, PNG, WEBP veya GIF yükleyebilirsiniz." });

            if (request.Image.Length > 10 * 1024 * 1024) // 10 MB limit
                return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Görsel boyutu 10MB'yi geçemez." });

            var wwwroot = _env.WebRootPath;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(wwwroot))
            {
                wwwroot = Path.Combine(_env.ContentRootPath, "wwwroot");
            }
            var uploadsFolder = Path.Combine(wwwroot, "uploads", "posts");
            if (!Directory.Exists(uploadsFolder)) Directory.CreateDirectory(uploadsFolder);

            var ext = Path.GetExtension(request.Image.FileName);
            var uniqueFileName = $"{Guid.NewGuid()}{ext}";
            var filePath = Path.Combine(uploadsFolder, uniqueFileName);

            using var fileStream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create);
            await request.Image.CopyToAsync(fileStream);

            imageUrl = $"/uploads/posts/{uniqueFileName}";
        }

        // 3. Etiketleri doğrula (Kaydetmeden önce)
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.TagsJson))
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Bu paylaşımı yapabilmek için en az bir tamamlanmış görev etiketlemelisiniz." });

        List<TagDto>? tags = null;
        try
        {
            tags = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<TagDto>>(request.TagsJson,
                new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true });
        }
        catch 
        { 
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Etiket verisi geçersiz." });
        }

        if (tags == null || tags.Count == 0)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "En az bir görev etiketlemelisiniz." });

        // Görevlerin gerçekten bu kullanıcı tarafından tamamlanıp tamamlanmadığını kontrol et
        var taskIds = tags.Select(t => t.TaskId).ToList();
        
        // Debug için konsola yazdır
        Console.WriteLine($"[SocialFeed] User: {userId}, Received TaskIds: {string.Join(", ", taskIds)}");

        var validUserTasks = await _userTaskRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && 
                         (ut.CompletedAt.HasValue || ut.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed) &&
                         (taskIds.Contains(ut.Id) || taskIds.Contains(ut.AppTaskId)))
            .ToListAsync();

        if (validUserTasks.Count == 0)
        {
            return BadRequest(new 
            { 
                success = false, 
                message = "Etiketlediğiniz görev(ler) henüz tamamlanmamış veya size ait değil.",
                error_detail = "Seçilen görev(ler) sistemde tamamlanmış olarak bulunamadı. Lütfen görevi bitirdiğinizden emin olun.",
                debug_info = $"Received {taskIds.Count} IDs, found 0 valid tasks for user {userId}."
            });
        }

        // 4. Gönderiyi kaydet (Doğrulama başarılı ise)
        var post = new Post
        {
            AppUserId = userId.Value,
            Content = request.Content?.Trim(),
            ImageUrl = imageUrl
        };

        await _postWrite.AddAsync(post);
        await _postWrite.SaveAsync();

        // 5. Etiketleri kaydet
        var postTags = new List<PostTag>();
        foreach (var ut in validUserTasks)
        {
            if (!postTags.Any(pt => pt.AppTaskId == ut.AppTaskId))
            {
                postTags.Add(new PostTag
                {
                    PostId = post.Id,
                    AppTaskId = ut.AppTaskId,
                    CoordinateX = 0,
                    CoordinateY = 0
                });
            }
        }

        await _postTagWrite.AddRangeAsync(postTags);
        await _postTagWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Gönderi başarıyla paylaşıldı! 🎉", postId = post.Id });
    }

    // ─── DELETE /api/posts/{id} ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    [HttpDelete("{id}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeletePost(Guid id)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var post = await _postRead.GetByIdAsync(id.ToString());
        if (post == null) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Gönderi bulunamadı." });
        if (post.AppUserId != userId) return Forbid();

        // Görseli diskten sil
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(post.ImageUrl))
        {
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory(), "wwwroot", post.ImageUrl.TrimStart('/'));
            if (System.IO.File.Exists(fullPath))
                System.IO.File.Delete(fullPath);
        }

        _postWrite.Remove(post);
        await _postWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Gönderi silindi." });
    }

    // ─── POST /api/posts/{id}/like ───────────────────────────────────────────
    [HttpPost("{id}/like")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> LikePost(Guid id)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var existingLike = await _postLikeRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(l => l.PostId == id && l.AppUserId == userId);

        if (existingLike != null)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Zaten beğendiniz." });

        await _postLikeWrite.AddAsync(new PostLike { PostId = id, AppUserId = userId.Value });
        await _postLikeWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }

    // ─── DELETE /api/posts/{id}/like ─────────────────────────────────────────
    [HttpDelete("{id}/like")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UnlikePost(Guid id)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var existingLike = await _postLikeRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(l => l.PostId == id && l.AppUserId == userId);

        if (existingLike == null)
            return NotFound();

        _postLikeWrite.Remove(existingLike);
        await _postLikeWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true });
    }

    // ─── POST /api/posts/{id}/comments ───────────────────────────────────────
    [HttpPost("{id}/comments")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AddComment(Guid id, [FromBody] AddCommentDto request)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Content))
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Yorum içeriği boş olamaz." });

        var comment = new PostComment
        {
            PostId = id,
            AppUserId = userId.Value,
            Content = request.Content.Trim()
        };

        await _postCommentWrite.AddAsync(comment);
        await _postCommentWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, commentId = comment.Id });
    }

    // ─── GET /api/posts/{id}/comments ────────────────────────────────────────
    [HttpGet("{id}/comments")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetComments(Guid id)
    {
        var comments = await _postCommentRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(c => c.PostId == id)
            .Include(c => c.AppUser)
            .OrderBy(c => c.CreatedAt)
            .Select(c => new
            {
                id = c.Id,
                content = c.Content,
                createdAt = c.CreatedAt,
                author = new
                {
                    id = c.AppUser.Id,
                    userName = c.AppUser.UserName,
                    fullName = c.AppUser.FullName,
                    avatarId = c.AppUser.AvatarId
                }
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, comments });
    }

    private Guid? GetUserId()
    {
        var value = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? null : Guid.Parse(value);
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.AI;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/recommendation")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")] // Sadece Admin tetikleyebilir
public class RecommendationController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITaskRecommendationService _recommendationService;
    private readonly IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository _interactionReadRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<RecommendationController> _logger;

    public RecommendationController(
        ITaskRecommendationService recommendationService,
        IUserTaskInteractionReadRepository interactionReadRepository,
        ILogger<RecommendationController> logger)
    {
        _recommendationService = recommendationService;
        _interactionReadRepository = interactionReadRepository;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [HttpPost("train")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TrainModel()
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("ML.NET model eğitimi API üzerinden tetiklendi.");
        
        var allInteractions = await _interactionReadRepository.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();
        
        if (allInteractions.Count < 50)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = $"Yetersiz etkileşim verisi. En az 50 kayıt gerekiyor. Mevcut sayı: {allInteractions.Count}" });
        }

        var success = await _recommendationService.TrainModelAsync(allInteractions);

        if (success)
        {
            return Ok(new { success = true, message = $"Model başarıyla eğitildi. Eğitim veri sayısı: {allInteractions.Count}" });
        }
        else
        {
            return StatusCode(500, new { success = false, message = "Model eğitimi sırasında bir hata oluştu." });
        }
    }

    [HttpGet("status")]
    public IActionResult GetModelStatus()
    {
        return Ok(new 
        { 
            isReady = _recommendationService.IsModelReady,
            message = _recommendationService.IsModelReady 
                ? "ML.NET görev öneri modeli aktif ve hazır." 
                : "Model henüz hazır değil. Eğitim gerekli (en az 50 etkileşim kaydı sonrasında '/api/recommendation/train' tetiklenmeli)." 
        });
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/reports")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class ReportsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IWeeklyReportReadRepository _reportReadRepository;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskReadRepository;

    public ReportsController(IWeeklyReportReadRepository reportReadRepository, IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskReadRepository)
    {
        _reportReadRepository = reportReadRepository;
        _userTaskReadRepository = userTaskReadRepository;
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyReports()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        var reports = await _reportReadRepository.Table
            .Where(r => r.AppUserId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.WeekEndDate)
            .Take(10)
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, reports });
    }

    [HttpGet("daily-breakdown")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetDailyBreakdown()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);

        // Son 7 günün başı (Yerel saat ve UTC farkından etkilenmemek için .Date kullanıyoruz)
        var today = DateTime.UtcNow.Date;
        var startDay = today.AddDays(-6);

        var userTasks = await _userTaskReadRepository.Table
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed && ut.CompletedAt != null && ut.CompletedAt >= startDay)
            .ToListAsync();

        var dailyData = new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>();

        for (int i = 6; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var day = today.AddDays(-i);
            var completedThatDay = userTasks
                .Where(ut => ut.CompletedAt.HasValue && ut.CompletedAt.Value.Date == day.Date)
                .ToList();

            dailyData.Add(new
            {
                date = day.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                XPKazanci = completedThatDay.Sum(ut => ut.EarnedXp),
                Tamamlanan = completedThatDay.Count
            });
        }

        return Ok(new { success = true, breakdown = dailyData });
    }

    [HttpPost("trigger-weekly-report")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TriggerWeeklyReport()
    {
        var userReadRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IUserTaskReadRepository>();
        var reportWriteRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<IWeeklyReportWriteRepository>();
        var notificationService = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<Application.Abstractions.Notifications.IAppNotificationService>();
        var behaviorService = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<Application.Abstractions.IUserBehaviorAnalysisService>();

        var weekEnd = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var weekStart = weekEnd.AddDays(-7);

        var users = await userReadRepo.GetAll(false).ToListAsync();

        int generatedCount = 0;
        foreach (var user in users)
        {
            var thisWeekTasks = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
                .Include(ut => ut.AppTask)
                .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == user.Id && ut.AssignedAt >= weekStart)
                .ToListAsync();

            if (!thisWeekTasks.Any()) continue;

            var completedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed).ToList();
            var failedTasks = thisWeekTasks.Where(t => t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Abandoned
                || t.Status == Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Expired
                || (t.DueDate < DateTime.UtcNow && t.Status != Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Completed)).ToList();

            var totalXpEarned = completedTasks.Sum(t => t.EarnedXp);

            string insight = "Bu hafta harika bir iş çıkardın!";
            string recommendation = "Önümüzdeki hafta Sağlık kategorisine daha fazla odaklanabilirsin.";

            var categoryGroups = completedTasks
                .Where(t => t.AppTask != null)
                .GroupBy(t => t.AppTask.CategoryId)
                .Select(g => new { CategoryId = g.Key, Count = g.Count() })
                .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count)
                .ToList();

            var report = new Domain.Entities.WeeklyReport
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                AppUserId = user.Id,
                WeekStartDate = weekStart,
                WeekEndDate = weekEnd,
                TasksCompleted = completedTasks.Count,
                TasksFailed = failedTasks.Count,
                TotalXPEarned = totalXpEarned,
                StreakDays = 0,
                StrongestCategory = categoryGroups.FirstOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                WeakestCategory = categoryGroups.LastOrDefault()?.CategoryId.ToString() ?? "N/A",
                AIInsight = insight,
                AIRecommendation = recommendation,
                OverallPerformanceScore = (thisWeekTasks.Count > 0) ? ((float)completedTasks.Count / thisWeekTasks.Count * 100) : 0,
                CategoryBreakdownJson = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(categoryGroups),
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await reportWriteRepo.AddAsync(report);
            generatedCount++;

            await notificationService.SendNotificationAsync(
                user.Id, 
                "Haftalık Raporun Hazır! 📊", 
                $"Bu hafta {completedTasks.Count} görev tamamladın ve toplam {totalXpEarned} XP kazandın.", 
                "Report");

            try { await behaviorService.AnalyzeAndUpdateUserBehaviorAsync(user.Id); }
            catch { }
        }

        await reportWriteRepo.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = $"{generatedCount} kullanıcı için haftalık rapor başarıyla üretildi!" });
    }
}

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Email;

[Route("api/social")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class SocialController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IFriendshipReadRepository _friendshipRead;
    private readonly IFriendshipWriteRepository _friendshipWrite;
    private readonly IChallengeReadRepository _challengeRead;
    private readonly IChallengeWriteRepository _challengeWrite;
    private readonly IAppUserReadRepository _userRead;
    private readonly IAppUserWriteRepository _userWrite;
    private readonly IAppTaskReadRepository _appTaskRead;
    private readonly IUserTaskReadRepository _userTaskRead;
    private readonly IUserTaskWriteRepository _userTaskWrite;
    private readonly IEmailService _emailService;
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public SocialController(
        IFriendshipReadRepository friendshipRead,
        IFriendshipWriteRepository friendshipWrite,
        IChallengeReadRepository challengeRead,
        IChallengeWriteRepository challengeWrite,
        IAppUserReadRepository userRead,
        IAppUserWriteRepository userWrite,
        IAppTaskReadRepository appTaskRead,
        IUserTaskReadRepository userTaskRead,
        IUserTaskWriteRepository userTaskWrite,
        IEmailService emailService,
        IMediator mediator)
    {
        _friendshipRead = friendshipRead;
        _friendshipWrite = friendshipWrite;
        _challengeRead = challengeRead;
        _challengeWrite = challengeWrite;
        _userRead = userRead;
        _userWrite = userWrite;
        _appTaskRead = appTaskRead;
        _userTaskRead = userTaskRead;
        _userTaskWrite = userTaskWrite;
        _emailService = emailService;
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    // ================================================================
    // ARKADAŞLIK
    // ================================================================

    [HttpGet("friends")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetFriends()
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendships = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(f => (f.RequesterId == userId || f.AddresseeId == userId) && f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted)
            .Include(f => f.Requester)
            .Include(f => f.Addressee)
            .ToListAsync();

        var friends = friendships.Select(f =>
        {
            var friend = f.RequesterId == userId ? f.Addressee : f.Requester;
            return new
            {
                friendshipId = f.Id,
                friendId = friend.Id,
                name = friend.Name,
                surname = friend.Surname,
                fullName = friend.FullName,
                userName = friend.UserName,
                level = friend.GeneralLevel,
                totalXP = friend.TotalXP,
                avatarId = friend.AvatarId,
                acceptedAt = f.AcceptedAt
            };
        });

        return Ok(new { success = true, friends });
    }

    [HttpGet("friend-requests")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetFriendRequests()
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var requests = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(f => f.AddresseeId == userId && f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Pending)
            .Include(f => f.Requester)
            .OrderByDescending(f => f.CreatedAt)
            .Select(f => new
            {
                requestId = f.Id,
                requesterId = f.RequesterId,
                requesterName = f.Requester.Name,
                requesterSurname = f.Requester.Surname,
                requesterUserName = f.Requester.UserName,
                requesterLevel = f.Requester.GeneralLevel,
                sentAt = f.CreatedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, requests });
    }

    [HttpPost("friend-request/{targetUserId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SendFriendRequest(Guid targetUserId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (userId == targetUserId)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Kendinize istek gönderemezsiniz." });

        var targetUser = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());
        if (targetUser == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." });

        var existing = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f =>
                (f.RequesterId == userId && f.AddresseeId == targetUserId) ||
                (f.RequesterId == targetUserId && f.AddresseeId == userId));

        if (existing != null)
        {
            var msg = existing.Status == FriendshipStatus.Accepted
                ? "Zaten arkadaşsınız."
                : "Zaten bir istek gönderilmiş veya mevcut.";
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = msg });
        }

        var friendship = new Friendship
        {
            RequesterId = userId.Value,
            AddresseeId = targetUserId,
            Status = FriendshipStatus.Pending
        };

        await _friendshipWrite.AddAsync(friendship);
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık isteği gönderildi!" });
    }

    [HttpPatch("friend-request/{requestId}/accept")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AcceptFriendRequest(Guid requestId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(requestId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "İstek bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        if (friendship.Status != FriendshipStatus.Pending)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Bu istek artık beklemede değil." });

        friendship.Status = FriendshipStatus.Accepted;
        friendship.AcceptedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık isteği kabul edildi! 🎉" });
    }

    [HttpPatch("friend-request/{requestId}/reject")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RejectFriendRequest(Guid requestId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(requestId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "İstek bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        friendship.Status = FriendshipStatus.Rejected;
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "İstek reddedildi." });
    }

    [HttpPost("block/{targetUserId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> BlockUser(Guid targetUserId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (userId == targetUserId) return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Kendinizi engelleyemezsiniz." });

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f =>
                (f.RequesterId == userId && f.AddresseeId == targetUserId) ||
                (f.RequesterId == targetUserId && f.AddresseeId == userId));

        if (friendship == null)
        {
            friendship = new Friendship
            {
                RequesterId = userId.Value,
                AddresseeId = targetUserId,
                Status = FriendshipStatus.Blocked
            };
            await _friendshipWrite.AddAsync(friendship);
        }
        else
        {
            friendship.Status = FriendshipStatus.Blocked;
            // Engelleyen her zaman requester gibi davranırız (basitlik için)
            friendship.RequesterId = userId.Value;
            friendship.AddresseeId = targetUserId;
            _friendshipWrite.Update(friendship);
        }

        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();
        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Kullanıcı engellendi." });
    }

    [HttpPost("unblock/{targetUserId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UnblockUser(Guid targetUserId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetAll(false)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(f =>
                f.RequesterId == userId && f.AddresseeId == targetUserId && f.Status == FriendshipStatus.Blocked);

        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Engellenmiş kullanıcı bulunamadı." });

        _friendshipWrite.Remove(friendship);
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Engelleme kaldırıldı." });
    }

    [HttpDelete("friends/{friendshipId}")]

        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var friendship = await _friendshipRead.GetByIdAsync(friendshipId.ToString());
        if (friendship == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Arkadaşlık bulunamadı." });

        if (friendship.RequesterId != userId && friendship.AddresseeId != userId)
            return Unauthorized();

        _friendshipWrite.Remove(friendship);
        await _friendshipWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Arkadaşlık sonlandırıldı." });
    }

    [HttpGet("users/search")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SearchUsers([FromQuery] string query)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query) || query.Length < 2)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "En az 2 karakter girin." });

        var users = await _userRead.GetAll(false)
            .Where(u => u.Id != userId &&
                   (u.UserName.Contains(query) || u.Name.Contains(query) || u.Surname.Contains(query)))
            .Take(10)
            .Select(u => new
            {
                id = u.Id,
                name = u.Name,
                surname = u.Surname,
                userName = u.UserName,
                level = u.GeneralLevel,
                totalXP = u.TotalXP,
                avatarId = u.AvatarId
            })
            .ToListAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, users });
    }

    /// <summary>SP-05: Mücadeleyi iptal et</summary>
    [HttpDelete("challenges/{challengeId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CancelChallenge(Guid challengeId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var challenge = await _challengeRead
            .GetWhere(c => c.Id == challengeId && c.ChallengerId == userId, tracking: true)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        if (challenge == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Mücadele bulunamadı." });

        if (challenge.Status == ChallengeStatus.Completed)
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Tamamlanmış mücadele iptal edilemez." });

        challenge.Status = ChallengeStatus.Cancelled;
        _challengeWrite.Update(challenge);
        await _challengeWrite.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Mücadele iptal edildi." });
    }

    /// <summary>P4-T2: Mücadele detaylarını ve katılımcı sıralamasını getir</summary>
    [HttpGet("challenges/{challengeId}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetChallengeDetails(Guid challengeId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var challenge = await _challengeRead.Table.AsNoTracking()
            .Include(c => c.Challenger)
            .Include(c => c.Opponent)
            .Include(c => c.Participants)
                .ThenInclude(p => p.User)
            .Include(c => c.TargetCategory)
            .Include(c => c.TargetAppTask)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == challengeId);

        if (challenge == null)
            return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Mücadele bulunamadı." });

        var participants = challenge.Participants
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.CurrentProgress)
            .Select(p => new
            {
                userId = p.UserId,
                userName = p.User.UserName,
                fullName = p.User.FullName,
                avatarId = p.User.AvatarId,
                score = p.CurrentProgress,
                isWinner = challenge.WinnerId == p.UserId
            });

        return Ok(new
        {
            success = true,
            challenge = new
            {
                challenge.Id,
                challenge.Title,
                challenge.Description,
                challenge.Status,
                challenge.ChallengeType,
                challenge.StartDate,
                challenge.EndDate,
                challenge.TargetValue,
                targetCategory = challenge.TargetCategory?.Name,
                targetTask = challenge.TargetAppTask?.Title,
                challengerProgress = challenge.ChallengerProgress,
                opponentProgress = challenge.OpponentProgress,
                winnerId = challenge.WinnerId,
                participants
            }
        });
    }

    // ================================================================
    // YARDIMCI
    // ================================================================

    /// <summary>SP-05: Görevi e-posta ile arkadaşınla veya bir kullanıcıyla paylaş</summary>
    [HttpPost("share-task")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ShareTask([FromBody] ShareTaskBody body)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        if (userId == null) return Unauthorized();

        var user = await _userRead.GetByIdAsync(userId.Value.ToString());
        if (user == null) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Kullanıcı bulunamadı." });

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(body.RecipientEmail))
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = "Geçerli bir e-posta adresi giriniz." });

        var task = await _appTaskRead.GetSingleAsync(t => t.Id == body.TaskId || t.Title == body.TaskTitle);
        if (task == null) return NotFound(new { success = false, message = "Paylaşılmak istenen görev sistemde bulunamadı." });

        var recipientUser = await _userRead.GetAll(false).FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email.ToLower() == body.RecipientEmail.ToLower());

        string frontendUrl = Request.Headers["Origin"].ToString();
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(frontendUrl))
        {
            frontendUrl = "http://localhost:5173";
        }

        string actionLink;
        string inviteText;
        if (recipientUser != null)
        {
            actionLink = $"{frontendUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/login?acceptTask={task.Id}";
            inviteText = $@"<p>Bu görev <strong>{user.FullName}</strong> tarafından seninle paylaşıldı!</p>
                            <p>Daha fazlası için <a href='{actionLink}'>LifeQuest'e giriş yapın</a> ve gelişiminize hemen başlayın!</p>";

            // Gerçekten görevi paylaşıyoruz: Eğer kullanıcıda bu görev bugün yoksa, onlara atayalım.
            var existingUserTask = await _userTaskRead.GetAll(false)
                .AnyAsync(ut => ut.AppUserId == recipientUser.Id && ut.AppTaskId == task.Id && ut.AssignedAt.Date == DateTime.UtcNow.Date);

            if (!existingUserTask)
            {
                var userTask = new UserTask
                {
                    AppUserId = recipientUser.Id,
                    AppTaskId = task.Id,
                    Status = AppTaskStatus.Suggested,
                    AssignedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                };
                await _userTaskWrite.AddAsync(userTask);
                await _userTaskWrite.SaveAsync();
            }
        }
        else
        {
            actionLink = $"{frontendUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/register?acceptTask={task.Id}";
            inviteText = $@"<p>Bu heyecan verici görev <strong>{user.FullName}</strong> tarafından seninle paylaşıldı!</p>
                            <p>Hemen <a href='{actionLink}'>LifeQuest'e kaydolun</a> ve gelişiminize hemen başlayın!</p>";
        }

        var subject = $"LifeQuest Görev Paylaşımı: {task.Title}";
        var htmlMessage = $@"
            <h2>Merhaba!</h2>
            {inviteText}
            <hr />
            <h3>GÖREV DETAYI:</h3>
            <p><strong>Başlık:</strong> {task.Title}</p>
            <p><strong>Açıklama:</strong> {task.Description}</p>
            <p><strong>Zorluk Seviyesi:</strong> {task.Difficulty}</p>
            <p><strong>Kazanılacak XP:</strong> {task.BaseXP} XP</p>
            {(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(body.Message) ? $"<p><strong>Kullanıcı Mesajı:</strong> {body.Message}</p>" : "")}
        ";

        await _emailService.SendEmailAsync(body.RecipientEmail, subject, htmlMessage);

        return Ok(new
        {
            success = true,
            message = $"{body.RecipientEmail} adresine '{task.Title}' görevi başarıyla e-posta ile paylaşıldı! ✉️"
        });
    }

    private Guid? GetUserId()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return null;
        return Guid.Parse(userIdString);
    }
}

    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdatePreferences(Guid id, [FromBody] UpdatePreferencesBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString) || Guid.Parse(userIdString) != id) return Unauthorized();

        var user = await _userReadRepository.GetByIdAsync(id.ToString(), tracking: true);
        if (user == null) return NotFound();

        if (body.Goals != null) user.UserGoals = body.Goals;
        if (body.DailyAvailableMinutes.HasValue) user.DailyAvailableMinutes = body.DailyAvailableMinutes;
        if (body.Strengths != null) user.Strengths = body.Strengths;
        if (body.Weaknesses != null) user.Weaknesses = body.Weaknesses;
        if (body.MotivationFactor != null) user.MotivationFactor = body.MotivationFactor;
        if (body.PreferredTasksPerWeek.HasValue) user.PreferredTasksPerWeek = body.PreferredTasksPerWeek;
        if (body.DifficultyPreference != null) user.DifficultyPreference = body.DifficultyPreference;
        if (body.Bio != null) user.Bio = body.Bio;
        if (body.Location != null) user.Location = body.Location;
        if (body.Interests != null) user.Interests = body.Interests;

        user.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        _userWriteRepository.Update(user);
        await _userWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Tercihleriniz başarıyla güncellendi." });
    }

using MediatR;

using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.SelectTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PostponeTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.PauseResumeTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.ShareUserTask;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Queries.GetSharedTaskByToken;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Controllers;

[Route("api/user-tasks")]
[ApiController]
[Authorize]
public class UserTasksController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;

    public UserTasksController(IMediator mediator)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
    }

    [HttpGet("available-tasks")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAvailableTasks()
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var userReadRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories.IAppUserReadRepository>();
        var taskReadRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories.IAppTaskReadRepository>();
        var userTaskReadRepo = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories.IUserTaskReadRepository>();

        var userId = Guid.Parse(userIdString);
        var user = await userReadRepo.Table.FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == userId);
        if (user == null) return NotFound();

        var assignedTaskIds = await userTaskReadRepo.Table
            .Where(ut => ut.AppUserId == userId && ut.Status != Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Expired && ut.Status != Domain.Enums.AppTaskStatus.Abandoned)
            .Select(ut => ut.AppTaskId)
            .ToListAsync();

        var tasks = await taskReadRepo.Table
            .Include(t => t.Category)
            .Where(t => t.IsActive && t.MinLevel <= (int)Math.Floor(user.GeneralLevel) && !assignedTaskIds.Contains(t.Id))
            .ToListAsync();

        var result = tasks.Select(t => new
        {
            Id = t.Id,
            Title = t.Title,
            Description = t.Description,
            BaseXP = t.BaseXP,
            EstimatedMinutes = t.EstimatedMinutes.HasValue && t.EstimatedMinutes.Value > 0 
                ? t.EstimatedMinutes.Value 
                : (t.BaseXP > 0 ? (int)Math.Ceiling(t.BaseXP / 5.0) : 15),
            CategoryName = t.Category?.Name ?? "Genel",
            CategoryIcon = t.Category?.IconPath ?? "🎯",
            Difficulty = t.Difficulty.ToString(),
            MinLevel = t.MinLevel,
            WhyThisTask = t.WhyThisTask
        });

        return Ok(result);
    }

    /// <summary>Havuzdan görev seç (Suggested → Selected)</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/select")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> SelectTask([FromRoute] Guid id, [FromQuery] bool forceOverLimit = false)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        try
        {
            var response = await _mediator.Send(new SelectTaskCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
                UserTaskId = id,
                ForceOverLimit = forceOverLimit
            });
            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message, limitReached = ex.Message.Contains("limite") });
        }
    }


    /// <summary>Görevi ertele</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/postpone")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> PostponeTask([FromRoute] Guid id, [FromBody] PostponeTaskBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        try
        {
            var response = await _mediator.Send(new PostponeTaskCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
                UserTaskId = id,
                PostponeTo = body.PostponeTo ?? DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(1)),
                SkipReason = body.SkipReason
            });
            return Ok(response);
        }
        catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Görev ertelemesini iptal et</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/cancel-postpone")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CancelPostponeTask([FromRoute] Guid id)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        try
        {
            var success = await _mediator.Send(new LifeQuestAPI.Application.Features.UserTasks.Commands.CancelPostponeTask.CancelPostponeTaskCommandRequest
            {
                UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
                UserTaskId = id
            });
            return Ok(new { success });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            return BadRequest(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Görevi duraklat</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/pause")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> PauseTask([FromRoute] Guid id)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var response = await _mediator.Send(new PauseTaskCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            UserTaskId = id
        });
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>Görevi devam ettir</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/resume")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ResumeTask([FromRoute] Guid id)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var response = await _mediator.Send(new ResumeTaskCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            UserTaskId = id
        });
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>Görevden vazgeç</summary>
    [HttpPost("{id}/abandon")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AbandonTask([FromRoute] Guid id, [FromBody] AbandonTaskBody body)
    {
        var userIdString = User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userIdString)) return Unauthorized();

        var response = await _mediator.Send(new AbandonTaskCommandRequest
        {
            UserId = Guid.Parse(userIdString),
            UserTaskId = id,
            Reason = body.Reason
        });
        return Ok(new { success = response });
    }

    /// <summary>Manuel olarak bugünün görev dağıtımını tetikle</summary>
    [HttpPost("trigger-daily-quests")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TriggerDailyQuests()
    {
        var dailyQuestService = HttpContext.RequestServices.GetRequiredService<LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.DailyQuest.IDailyQuestService>();
        await dailyQuestService.DistributeDailyQuestsAsync();
        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Günlük görev dağıtımı başarıyla manuel olarak tetiklendi." });
    }

    /// <summary>Ekstra görev ve rozet seed verilerini yükle</summary>
    [HttpPost("seed")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> TriggerSeed()
    {
        await LifeQuestAPI.Persistence.Contexts.SeedData.SeedData.Initialize(HttpContext.RequestServices);
        return Ok(new { success = true, message = "Seed verileri başarıyla yüklendi!" });
    }
}

using System;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Hubs;

[Authorize]
public class NotificationHub : Hub
{
    private readonly ILogger<NotificationHub> _logger;

    public NotificationHub(ILogger<NotificationHub> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public override Task OnConnectedAsync()
    {
        var userId = Context.User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
        {
            // Kullanıcıyı kendi Id'sine sahip bir gruba al
            Groups.AddToGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, userId);
            _logger.LogInformation($"SignalR: User connected: {userId} ({Context.ConnectionId})");
        }
        
        return base.OnConnectedAsync();
    }

    public override Task OnDisconnectedAsync(Exception? exception)
    {
        var userId = Context.User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId))
        {
            Groups.RemoveFromGroupAsync(Context.ConnectionId, userId);
            _logger.LogInformation($"SignalR: User disconnected: {userId}");
        }

        return base.OnDisconnectedAsync(exception);
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Text.Json;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Exceptions;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Middlewares;

public class GlobalExceptionMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware> _logger;

    public GlobalExceptionMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<GlobalExceptionMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task Invoke(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Sunucuda beklenmeyen bir hata oluştu: {Message}", ex.Message);

            await HandleExceptionAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }

    private static Task HandleExceptionAsync(HttpContext context, Exception exception)
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";

        if (exception is FluentValidation.ValidationException validationException)
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;

            var validationResponse = new
            {
                IsSuccess = false,
                Message = "Doğrulama hataları oluştu. Lütfen bilgilerinizi kontrol edin.",
                ErrorCode = "VALIDATION_ERROR",
                Errors = validationException.Errors.Select(e => new
                {
                    Property = e.PropertyName,
                    Error = e.ErrorMessage
                })
            };

            var validationJsonResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(validationResponse, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });
            return context.Response.WriteAsync(validationJsonResponse);
        }

        if (exception is BusinessException businessException)
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;

            var businessResponse = new
            {
                IsSuccess = false,
                Message = businessException.Message,
                ErrorCode = businessException.ErrorCode
            };

            var businessJsonResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(businessResponse, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });
            return context.Response.WriteAsync(businessJsonResponse);
        }

        context.Response.StatusCode = (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError;

        var response = new
        {
            IsSuccess = false,
            Message = "Sunucuda beklenmeyen bir teknik hata oluştu. Mühendislerimiz bilgilendirildi.",
            ErrorCode = "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR"
        };

        var jsonResponse = JsonSerializer.Serialize(response, new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase });
        return context.Response.WriteAsync(jsonResponse);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Abstractions.Notifications;
using LifeQuestAPI.Application.Repositories;
using LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;

namespace LifeQuestAPI.API.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Bu servis hem veritabanına log düşer hem de SignalR Hub'ını kullanarak anlık push yapar.
/// </summary>
public class AppNotificationService : IAppNotificationService
{
    private readonly INotificationWriteRepository _notificationWriteRepository;
    private readonly IHubContext<Hubs.NotificationHub> _hubContext;

    public AppNotificationService(
        INotificationWriteRepository notificationWriteRepository,
        IHubContext<Hubs.NotificationHub> hubContext)
    {
        _notificationWriteRepository = notificationWriteRepository;
        _hubContext = hubContext;
    }

    public async Task SendNotificationAsync(Guid userId, string title, string message, string? type = null)
    {
        // 1. Veritabanına kaydet
        var notification = new Notification
        {
            AppUserId = userId,
            Title = title,
            Message = message,
            Type = Enum.TryParse<LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums.NotificationType>(type, true, out var parsedType) ? parsedType : LifeQuestAPI.Domain.Enums.NotificationType.SystemMessage,
            IsRead = false,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        try
        {
            await _notificationWriteRepository.AddAsync(notification);
            await _notificationWriteRepository.SaveAsync();

            // 2. Anlık olarak (çevrimiçiyse) gönder
            // Grup adı olarak userId kullanıyoruz (Hub içerisinde öyle tanımladık)
            await _hubContext.Clients.Group(userId.ToString()).SendAsync("ReceiveNotification", new 
            {
                Id = notification.Id,
                Title = title,
                Message = message,
                Type = notification.Type.ToString(),
                CreatedAt = notification.CreatedAt
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Loglanabilir
            Console.WriteLine($"Bildirim gönderilirken hata oluştu: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
